name: 青根温泉
location: 宮城県 柴田郡川崎町
sales_point: 花房山の山裾に位置する温泉地。仙台藩主の伊達家の湯治場として古くから利用されてきた。落ち着いた雰囲気が漂う。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Hanabusa Mountain, historically used as a healing place for the Date clan, the lords of Sendai. It has a calm and serene atmosphere.

name: 秋保温泉
sales_point: 仙台市西部の名取川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。仙台藩主伊達家の浴館が設置され歴史が永く、仙台の奥座敷として賑わう。秋保大滝や秋保工芸の里等、見所も多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Natori River gorge in the western part of Sendai City. It has a long history as a bathing place for the Date clan and is bustling as a retreat for Sendai. There are many attractions nearby, including Akiu Great Falls and Akiu Craft Village.

name: 泉温泉
sales_point: 仙台市の最北、泉ヶ岳の南東側山麓に位置する温泉地。藤沢川沿いの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this spa offers a wide variety of baths, including numerous carbonated springs and natural hot springs, as well as three types of saunas. They also highlight the clean facilities, comfortable relaxation areas, and delicious food, making it ideal for a full day of relaxation.

Some reviews mention the staff can be unprofessional and impolite.
sales_point_en: Located at the northeastern edge of Sendai City, on the southeastern foothills of Izumigatake. It offers a quiet environment along the Fujisawa River, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 今宿温泉
location: 宮城県 柴田郡川崎町
sales_point: 笹谷ICのすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。目の前にはスキー場が広がる好立地。山形観光の足場としても好適。
review_summary:
People say this public bath offers a pleasant hot spring experience with a mild water quality that warms the body, and provides body soap and shampoo. They also highlight the affordable 400 yen entry fee, the clean facilities, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the bathing area can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located very close to the Sasaya IC, with a ski resort right in front. It is also a great base for sightseeing in Yamagata.

name: 牛野森温泉
location: 宮城県 黒川郡大衡村
sales_point: 大衡村の西部に位置する温泉地。すぐ近くにゴルフ場がある。湯治客が多く、療養・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the western part of Ohiwa Village, near a golf course. It is popular among guests seeking healing and recuperation.

name: 大森温泉
location: 宮城県 加美郡加美町
sales_point: 陶芸の里である宮崎町の静かな山あいに位置する一軒宿の温泉地。山菜取りや紅葉狩りの拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and open-air options, a sauna, and a cold plunge. They also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A secluded hot spring inn located in the quiet mountains of Miyazaki Town, known for its pottery. It is a great base for mountain vegetable picking and autumn leaf viewing.

name: 鬼首（鳴子温泉郷）
sales_point: 荒雄岳の南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。間歇泉や荒湯地獄などは絶景。ゴルフ場やスキー場もあり、四季を通して楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southwestern foothills of Arao Mountain. It features stunning sights like geysers and hot steam vents. With golf courses and ski resorts, it can be enjoyed year-round. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 小原温泉
sales_point: 白石川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。風光明媚で静かな環境にある。古くから眼病に特効あると伝えられる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Shiroishi River gorge, known for its scenic beauty and tranquil environment. It has been traditionally recognized for its effectiveness in treating eye ailments.

name: 鎌先温泉
sales_point: 蔵王連峰の東南側山麓に位置する温泉地。「キズは鎌先」と言われ切り傷に効く。弥治郎系こけしの里としても有名。白石うーめんが名産品として好評。
sales_point_en: Situated on the southeastern foothills of the Zao mountain range, this hot spring is known for its healing properties for cuts, as the saying goes, 'Kizu wa Kamasaki.' It is also famous as the home of Yajirokko dolls, and Shiroishi Umen is a popular local product.

name: 釜房湖温泉
location: 宮城県 柴田郡川崎町
sales_point: 仙台の水瓶、釜房湖北岸に位置する温泉地。蔵王山や周りの山々の眺望が良い。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located on the northern shore of Lake Kamaebako, known as Sendai's water reservoir. It offers great views of Mount Zao and the surrounding mountains, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation in a quiet environment.

name: 川渡（鳴子温泉郷）
sales_point: 鳴子温泉郷の表玄関にあたる温泉地。鳴子温泉郷の中で最も早く開湯され、古くから｢脚気可波多比｣と称された名湯。今なお湯治場の素朴な雰囲気を残す。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: The main entrance to the Naruko Onsen area, this hot spring was one of the first to open and has been renowned since ancient times as 'Kyakkekahatahi.' It retains a rustic atmosphere as a healing place and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 神ケ根温泉
sales_point: 名取川の渓谷沿いの鴻の巣温泉の対岸に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。自炊専門の為、療養・長期滞在に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a quiet and relaxing atmosphere, delicious and plentiful meals, and a hot spring bath with a gentle feel on the skin.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be small and there can be only one washing station.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located across from Kono's Nest Onsen along the Natori River gorge. It is a self-catering facility, making it suitable for long-term stays and recuperation.

name: 峩々温泉
location: 宮城県 柴田郡川崎町
sales_point: 蔵王山の山麓、標高850メートルに位置する温泉地。濁川の深い谷あいにある一軒宿の秘湯。胃腸の名湯として知られ、独特のかけ湯の湯治方法があり、飲泉もできる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers a quiet, relaxing stay with delicious, simple, and satisfying meals, including flavorful local vegetables and excellent rice. They also highlight the effective hot spring baths, the digital detox experience due to limited cell service, and the professional, friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the bathing facilities can be inconvenient.
sales_point_en: A hidden hot spring located at an elevation of 850 meters on the foothills of Mount Zao, nestled in the deep valley of the Daku River. Known for its therapeutic properties for gastrointestinal issues, it features a unique method of pouring hot water and allows for drinking the spring water.

name: 切込温泉
location: 宮城県 加美郡加美町
sales_point: ふるさと陶芸館の近くに位置する温泉地。自炊施設やテニスコートが完備されている。療養・長期滞在にも好適。
sales_point_en: Located near the Furusato Pottery Museum, this hot spring area is equipped with self-catering facilities and tennis courts, making it suitable for long-term stays and recuperation.

name: 鴻の巣温泉
sales_point: 名取川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。自炊施設が完備され、療養・長期滞在に好適。
review_summary: People say this guesthouse offers traditional Japanese accommodation with a spacious onsen and clean Japanese-style rooms. They also highlight the friendly management who speaks perfect English and provides helpful local tips, as well as the sweet and friendly dogs. Guests mention the relaxing atmosphere, with river sounds and stargazing opportunities, making it a perfect place to unwind.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Natori River gorge, equipped with self-catering facilities, making it ideal for long-term stays and recuperation.

name: 黄金川温泉
location: 宮城県 刈田郡蔵王町
sales_point: 蔵王連峰の東側に位置する温泉地。「老人いこいの家」などの温泉入浴施設もある。
review_summary:
People say this public bath offers a unique, hot, reddish-brown, iron-rich spring water that leaves skin smooth and warm. They also highlight the affordable entry fee, free parking, and the availability of local vegetables for purchase.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded with impolite guests.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern side of the Zao mountain range, featuring facilities like 'Elderly Rest House' for hot spring bathing.

name: 駒の湯温泉
sales_point: 国定公園栗駒山の懐に抱かれた温泉地。栗駒高原では登山、スキー、キャンプ、散策などが楽しめる。紅葉は絶景。くりこま高原温泉郷と呼ばれることもある。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the embrace of the national park of Kurikoma Mountain, this hot spring area offers activities like hiking, skiing, camping, and walking in the Kurikoma Highland, which is also famous for its stunning autumn foliage.

name: 作並温泉
sales_point: 広瀬川上流の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。1300年の歴史を誇り、仙台の奥座敷として古くから親しまれている。
sales_point_en: Located along the gorge upstream of the Hirose River, this hot spring boasts a history of 1300 years and has long been cherished as a retreat for Sendai.

name: 七郷温泉
sales_point: 仙台市東部地区に位置する温泉地。約3.5キロ東方には深沼海水浴場があり、夏には海水浴客で賑わう。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options, plus diverse saunas and multiple types of ganbanyoku. Visitors also highlight the clean and luxurious interior, extensive relaxation areas with many books, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the service can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the eastern part of Sendai City. About 3.5 kilometers to the east is the Funama Beach, which is bustling with beachgoers in the summer.

name: 白石温泉
sales_point: 白石川畔の高台に位置する温泉地。蔵王連峰を遠望する静かな環境にある。リウマチ・神経痛・婦人病に効果がある。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring features a unique cave-like rock bath with natural hot spring water, and many highlight the invigoratingly hot water, typically around 43-47°C. They also appreciate the affordable 200 yen entrance fee, with some mentioning a 100 yen discount with an AEON card. Guests like the rustic, traditional atmosphere and the friendly local patrons.
sales_point_en: Situated on a hill overlooking the Shiroishi River, this hot spring area offers a quiet environment with distant views of the Zao mountain range. It is effective for rheumatism, neuralgia, and women's diseases.

name: 神次郎温泉
sales_point: 角田市北部の阿武隈川河畔に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the banks of the Abukuma River in the northern part of Kakuda City.

name: 谷山温泉
location: 宮城県 柴田郡村田町
sales_point: 荒川沿いの田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。レース場のあるレジャー施設スポーツランドＳＵＧＯや村田ダムなどが近くにある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring situated amidst rural scenery along the Arakawa River. Close to leisure facilities like Sportsland SUGO and Murata Dam.

name: 台ケ森温泉
location: 宮城県 黒川郡大和町
sales_point: 七ツ森の西側山麓、吉田川の支流沿いに位置する温泉地。静かな環境に恵まれ、休養・保養に好適。船形連峰と泉ヶ岳を遠望することができる。
sales_point_en: Located along a tributary of the Yoshida River at the western foothills of Nanatsumori, this hot spring offers a tranquil environment ideal for relaxation and recuperation, with views of the Funagatake mountain range and Izumigatake.

name: 遠刈田温泉
location: 宮城県 刈田郡蔵王町
sales_point: 蔵王連峰の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。景観に恵まれ蔵王観光の拠点に好適。冬季は宮城蔵王の各スキー場が近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the eastern foothills of the Zao mountain range, making it a great base for Zao tourism, with beautiful scenery and proximity to various ski resorts in winter.

name: 中山平（鳴子温泉郷）
sales_point: 鳴子温泉郷の中で最も湯量が豊富な温泉地。峡谷や山並みの自然景観が美しい。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: The most abundant hot spring in the Naruko Onsen area, surrounded by beautiful natural landscapes of canyons and mountains. Designated as a national health resort, it is ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 鳴子（鳴子温泉郷）
sales_point: 鳴子温泉郷の中心となる温泉地。鳴子温泉駅を中心に温泉街が広がる。永い歴史があり、豊富な湯量と多種の泉質を誇る。「鳴子こけし」の産地としても有名。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen town offers a variety of hot springs, including alkaline, acidic, and sulfur springs, which leave skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the charming, retro atmosphere of the town, with its traditional buildings and unique kokeshi doll displays. Guests mention the convenient free parking near the station for short visits.
sales_point_en: The central hot spring of the Naruko Onsen area, with a hot spring town expanding around Naruko Onsen Station. It has a long history and boasts abundant hot water and various types of spring quality. Also famous as the birthplace of Naruko Kokeshi dolls.

name: 温湯温泉
sales_point: 花山三湯の中心地でもあり、大自然の中に位置する温泉地。湯の歴史は古く、仙台藩寒湯番所跡が今も残る。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious grilled iwana fish and a variety of hot spring baths with clear, warming chloride spring water. They also highlight the reasonable prices, the clean rooms, and the kind, helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the hot spring water can be thin.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the heart of the Hanayama Three Springs, surrounded by nature. The hot spring has a long history, with remnants of the Sendai Domain's cold water station still present.

name: 野蒜温泉
sales_point: 日本三景のひとつ、松島の一角を占める奥松島の北方に位置する温泉地。松島観光や釣り、マリンスポーツの基地に好適。
review_summary: People say this multi-functional facility offers delicious lunch sets and tasty soup, and the bathing area and changing rooms are spotless. They also highlight the warm and friendly staff, saying they provide excellent service. Guests mention the relaxing atmosphere, with plenty of seating and books, and appreciate the reasonable prices.
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Okumatsushima, which is part of one of Japan's three scenic views, Matsushima. Ideal as a base for Matsushima tourism, fishing, and marine sports.

name: 東鳴子（鳴子温泉郷）
sales_point: 鳴子温泉郷の一角。650年の湯治場の歴史を誇る温泉地。荒雄川沿いの静かな環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen town offers a variety of hot springs, including alkaline, acidic, and sulfur springs, which leave skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the charming, retro atmosphere of the town, with its traditional buildings and unique kokeshi doll displays. Guests mention the convenient free parking near the station for short visits.
sales_point_en: A part of the Naruko Onsen area, boasting a 650-year history as a hot spring resort. Located in a quiet environment along the Arao River, it is suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 南川温泉
location: 宮城県 黒川郡大和町
sales_point: 七ツ森湖西側湖畔に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、休養・保養に好適。七ツ森山ハイキングや七ツ森湖探勝基地に最適。森林浴にも良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the lakeside of Nanatsumori Lake. Surrounded by a rich natural environment, it is ideal for relaxation and recuperation, as well as a base for hiking and exploring Nanatsumori Lake.

name: 南蔵王温泉
sales_point: 蔵王連峰の開拓地に位置する温泉地。白石牧場の近くで豊かな大自然を堪能できる。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring offers a large, dynamic open-air bath with water that warms you to the core and keeps you warm long after. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff who ensure a comfortable experience. Guests mention the reasonable prices for admission and the unique, homemade feel of the facilities.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in a developed area of the Zao mountain range, near Shiroishi Farm, allowing visitors to enjoy the rich natural surroundings.

name: 茂庭温泉
sales_point: 仙台南ICすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。大浴場からは名取川の渓谷や豊かな自然を眺望できる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility is very clean and features a wide variety of baths, including two types of saunas and unique bedrock baths with engaging events. They also highlight the delicious food, comfortable relaxation spaces with charging ports, and the convenient cashless payment system.

Some reviews mention the admission fees can be expensive.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located very close to Sendai Minami IC. The large public bath offers views of the Natori River gorge and abundant nature.

name: 文字温泉
sales_point: 栗駒ダムの南方約2キロの山間に位置する温泉地。静かな土地で保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located about 2 kilometers south of Kurikoma Dam, in a quiet mountainous area, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 薬莱温泉
location: 宮城県 加美郡加美町
sales_point: 薬莱山の北側山麓、鳴瀬川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。付近では山菜採りや渓流釣りを楽しむことができる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and open-air options, a sauna, and a cold plunge. They also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: Located along the clear stream of the Naruse River at the northern foothills of Mount Yakurai, this hot spring offers a quiet environment suitable for recuperation and relaxation, with opportunities for wild vegetable picking and stream fishing nearby.

name: 湯ノ倉温泉
sales_point: 花山三湯のひとつに数えられる温泉地。歴史があり、ひなびた木造の宿は今もランプを灯す。日常を忘れくつろげる。近くの花山渓谷の辺りは秋は紅葉が美しい。冬期休業。
sales_point_en: Counted among the Hanayama Three Springs, this hot spring has a long history, with rustic wooden lodges still using lamps. A place to forget daily life and relax, with beautiful autumn foliage in the nearby Hanayama Gorge. Closed in winter.

name: 湯ノ原温泉
location: 宮城県 宮城郡松島町
sales_point: 松島海岸の山の手に位置する温泉地。自炊設備もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the hills of Matsushima Coast, with self-catering facilities available.

name: 湯浜温泉
sales_point: 花山三湯の一角に数えられる温泉地。栗駒山の雄大な自然の中にある秘湯。登山やイワナ釣りの基地に好適。冬期間は休業。ランプも使用。
sales_point_en: A hot spring counted among the Hanayama Three Springs, located in the majestic nature of Mount Kurikoma. Ideal as a base for mountain climbing and iwana fishing. Closed in winter, also uses lamps.

name: 赤倉温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡最上町
sales_point: 最上小国川上流に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、保養に好適。松尾芭蕉が名句を残した地としても知られる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located upstream of the Mogami Oguni River, in a quiet environment suitable for recuperation. Also known as the place where Matsuo Basho left famous haikus.

name: 赤湯温泉
sales_point: 源義家の弟、義綱の発見と伝えられ、開湯900年の歴史を誇る温泉地。神経痛やリウマチに効果があり、美人の湯としても知られる。米沢牛を中心とした名産品でもてなしてくれる。
sales_point_en: Believed to have been discovered by Yoshitsuna, the younger brother of Minamoto no Yoshiie, this hot spring boasts a 900-year history. Known for its effectiveness against neuralgia and rheumatism, it is also famous as a beauty spring, offering local specialties centered around Yonezawa beef.

name: 朝日温泉
location: 山形県 西村山郡朝日町
sales_point: 大朝日岳の東側山麓、標高540メートルの山あいに位置する温泉地。温泉から約10キロ北東にスキー場もある。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a unique "mall spring" with a distinctive oily, smoky aroma and a smooth, skin-softening texture, and they appreciate the apples floating in the bath. Visitors also highlight the affordable 300 yen entrance fee and the clean, well-maintained facilities. They also like the friendly staff and the spacious, comfortable tatami resting area.
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 540 meters on the eastern foothills of Mount Oasahi, with a ski resort about 10 kilometers northeast of the hot spring.

name: あつみ温泉
sales_point: 海岸から2キロほど山手に入った所に位置する温泉地。温海川の両岸に宿が建ち並ぶ。250年続く朝市や日本海の新鮮な幸が人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers inland from the coast. Accommodations line both banks of the Atsumigawa River. The 250-year-old morning market and fresh seafood from the Sea of Japan are popular.

name: 左沢温泉
location: 山形県 西村山郡大江町
sales_point: 山形県の母なる川、最上川の河畔に位置する温泉地。町の中心地に程近く、町内観光の拠点として利用できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the banks of the Mogami River, the mother river of Yamagata Prefecture. It is close to the town center and can be used as a base for local sightseeing.

name: 荒谷温泉
sales_point: 宿泊施設が合宿所となっている山形を代表するスポーツ拠点。陸上競技場、総合体育館をはじめ、サッカー、ラグビー場等が整っている。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers a wide variety of craft beers brewed on-site, along with diverse alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, and delicious meals including local specialties. They also highlight the all-inclusive plan, which provides excellent value, and the relaxing atmosphere with amenities like private onsen and a bonfire. Visitors appreciate the attentive and helpful staff, who contribute to a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
sales_point_en: A representative sports base of Yamagata, where the accommodation facilities serve as training camps. Equipped with an athletic field, a gymnasium, and soccer and rugby fields.

name: 泡の湯温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡小国町
sales_point: 飯豊山の山側山麓に位置する温泉地。この辺りの集落はマタギの林で熊肉を山菜などと一緒に楽しめる。湯に炭酸ガスを含むのでこの名が付けられたとされる。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a large, milky white, open-air mixed bath with a pleasant sulfur scent, and also offers indoor baths with both warm and cooler spring water. They also highlight the delicious and plentiful meals, including a unique onsen rice porridge. Guests mention the attentive staff and the traditional, relaxing atmosphere, with women appreciating the provided bathing attire for the mixed bath.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Iide. The nearby village offers bear meat enjoyed with wild vegetables. It is said to be named for the carbon dioxide contained in the water.

name: 飯田温泉
sales_point: 国道13号線山形バイパス近くに位置する温泉地。山形駅に一番近い温泉で保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the Yamagata Bypass on National Route 13. It is the closest hot spring to Yamagata Station, making it ideal for relaxation.

name: 飯豊温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡小国町
sales_point: 飯豊山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。玉川沿いの豊かな自然や渓谷美、紅葉が堪能できる。保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northern foothills of Mount Iide. Enjoy the rich nature along the Tamagawa River, beautiful valleys, and autumn leaves. Ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: いいで添川温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡飯豊町
sales_point: 飯豊山麓育成牧場の北西側に位置する温泉地。近くには「道の駅いいで」もある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing, slightly brown hot spring bath, with a spacious changing room and 18 washing stations. They also highlight the reasonable prices, especially on special discount days, and the warm, welcoming staff.

Other reviews mention it can be crowded with locals.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located northwest of the Iide Mountain foothills. Nearby is the 'Roadside Station Iide'.

name: 飯森山温泉
sales_point: 酒田市の丘陵地に位置する温泉地。12種類のお風呂は「虹のお風呂」と呼ばれ親しまれている。周囲に土門記念館、美術館、宮野浦海水浴場などがある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a relaxing brown-colored hot spring, a jet bath, and a sauna with a cold water bath. They also highlight the reasonable entry fee, the delicious fried chicken set meal, and the availability of baby chairs.

Other reviews mention the dry cleaning can be weak.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the hilly region of Sakata City. It is known for its 12 types of baths, affectionately called 'Rainbow Baths'. Nearby attractions include the Domon Memorial Museum, art museum, and Miyanoura Beach.

name: 今神温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡戸沢村
sales_point: 長倉川の渓流沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。念仏を唱えながら入浴する温泉信仰の残る秘湯。冬期間は休業する。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Nagakuragawa River. It is a hidden hot spring where the faith of bathing while chanting sutras remains. Closed during the winter season.

name: 姥湯温泉
sales_point: 吾妻連峰の大日岳と薬師岳に挟まれた標高1230メートルの高地にある温泉地。露天風呂から眺める紅葉は素晴らしく、自然環境に恵まれている。一軒宿の秘湯。冬期間休業。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a truly exceptional open-air bath experience with stunning, wild mountain views and beautiful, milky-blue sulfur spring water. They also highlight the delicious meals, including local dishes like carp stew, and the warm, welcoming staff. Guests mention the option of free shuttle service from Touge Station, which is helpful given the challenging mountain road access.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 1230 meters, nestled between Mount Dainichi and Mount Yakushi of the Azuma Mountain Range. The view of autumn leaves from the outdoor bath is stunning, surrounded by a rich natural environment. A hidden hot spring with only one accommodation. Closed during the winter season.

name: 海老鶴温泉
location: 山形県 西村山郡河北町
sales_point: 河北町の北東部、最上川河畔に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。閑静な田園地帯の中にあり、保養・静養に好適。果物や肉そばが名物。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features two types of natural spring water, with one being notably hot and the other slightly less so, and both leave skin feeling smooth and warm for hours. They also highlight the affordable 400 yen entry fee, the availability of free hairdryers, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention regular patrons can claim bathing areas.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northeastern part of Kahoku Town, along the banks of the Mogami River. Situated in a quiet rural area, it is ideal for relaxation. Famous for its fruits and meat soba.

name: 大石田温泉
location: 山形県 北村山郡大石田町
sales_point: 最上川沿いに位置する温泉地。最上川を一望できる展望風呂の他に、様々なお風呂と露天風呂が完備される。季節の流れを肌で感じられる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Mogami River. It features a panoramic bath with a view of the river, along with various other baths and outdoor baths. Experience the flow of the seasons.

name: 大滝温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡小国町
sales_point: 小国町の市街地に近い温泉地。足をのばせば紅葉の美しい赤芝峡や神明山公園があり、観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area close to the city center of Oguni Town. Nearby are the beautiful autumn leaves of Akashiba Gorge and Shinmei Mountain Park, making it a suitable base for sightseeing.

name: 大平温泉
sales_point: 松川の美しい渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。深い森と険しい崖に囲まれ自然環境豊か。露天風呂から新緑や紅葉が堪能できる。冬期間休業。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the beautiful valley of Matsukawa. Surrounded by deep forests and steep cliffs, it offers a rich natural environment. Enjoy fresh greenery and autumn leaves from the outdoor bath. Closed during the winter season.

name: 大堀温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡最上町
sales_point: 最上小国川を彼方に望む高台に位置する温泉地。宿舎からの眺望は見事。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground overlooking the Mogami Oguni River. The view from the accommodation is spectacular.

name: 岡原温泉
sales_point: 米沢市の西南約13キロの山あいの位置する温泉地。リウマチや皮フ病によく効くと言われている。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a truly exceptional open-air bath experience with stunning, wild mountain views and beautiful, milky-blue sulfur spring water. They also highlight the delicious meals, including local dishes like carp stew, and the warm, welcoming staff. Guests mention the option of free shuttle service from Touge Station, which is helpful given the challenging mountain road access.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 13 kilometers southwest of Yonezawa City in the mountains. It is said to be effective for rheumatism and skin diseases.

name: 小野川温泉
sales_point: 大樽川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。小野小町にゆかりの深いことから美人の湯と言われ、女性に人気がある。米沢周辺の観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Otaru River. Known as the 'Beauty Hot Spring' due to its deep connection with Ono no Komachi, it is popular among women. Ideal as a base for sightseeing around Yonezawa.

name: おもだか温泉
location: 山形県 北村山郡大石田町
sales_point: 尾花沢市と隣接し、国道13号線沿いに位置する温泉地。昔の面影を色濃く残している。車の便が良い。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, traditional rooms and a relaxing onsen, with outdoor baths providing stunning views. They also highlight the delicious traditional Japanese meals and homemade burgers available. Visitors appreciate the friendly, welcoming staff who provide shuttle services to the Snow Monkey Park and train station.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 13, adjacent to Obanazawa City. It retains a strong sense of its historical charm. Convenient access by car.

name: 笠松温泉
sales_point: 羽黒川上流の河畔にひっそりたたずむ一軒宿の温泉地。バードウォッチングと渓流釣りが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A secluded hot spring area located along the upper reaches of the Haguro River. Enjoy birdwatching and stream fishing.

name: かみのやま(上山温泉郷)
sales_point: 蔵王のふもとに位置する温泉地。温町、新湯、十日町、河崎、高松などの地区に分かれた温泉街を総称して上山温泉郷と呼ぶ。詩人斉藤茂吉の生誕地でもある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Zao. The hot spring town is collectively referred to as Kaminoyama Onsen District, divided into areas such as Onsenmachi, Shinyu, Tokamachi, Kawasaki, and Takamatsu. It is also the birthplace of the poet Shigekichi Saito.

name: 川西温泉
location: 山形県 東置賜郡川西町
sales_point: 日本一のダリヤ園で知られる川西町の中心部に位置する温泉地。ダリヤ園を眼下に眺めることができ、眺望と心地よさを満喫することができる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a good quality, warm bath with a slightly green or light brown color, and features a sauna, cold bath, and spacious individual washing areas. Guests also highlight the affordable 400 yen entry fee, delicious breakfast, and convenient amenities like coin laundry.

Some reviews mention the water temperature can be too hot.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of Kawanishi Town, known for Japan's largest dahlia garden. Visitors can enjoy beautiful views and comfort while overlooking the garden.

name: 月山志津温泉
location: 山形県 西村山郡西川町
sales_point: 月山スキー場に隣接した温泉地。夏は新緑、秋は紅葉、冬は雪まつりと一年を通して豊かな自然やスポーツを楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to Gassan Ski Resort. Enjoy rich nature and sports throughout the year, with fresh greenery in summer, autumn leaves, and winter snow festivals.

name: 銀山温泉
sales_point: 渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。木造の高層旅館が建ち並ぶ町並みの景観は大正ロマンを感じさせる。ＮＨＫドラマ「おしん」の舞台となった。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along a mountain stream. The townscape with wooden high-rise ryokans evokes the romance of the Taisho era. It was the setting for the NHK drama 'Oshin' and is a national health resort.

name: 草薙温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡戸沢村
sales_point: 最上川の舟下りの終点に位置する温泉地。最上川の流れや、対岸の山の緑、紅葉などが見事な眺めを見せる。近くに白糸の滝がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the end of a boat ride on the Mogami River. It offers stunning views of the river's flow, the green mountains across the river, and autumn foliage. Nearby is Shiraito Falls.

name: 栗子温泉
sales_point: 山形と福島の県境、栗子峠の近隣に位置する温泉地。夏はプール、冬はスキーが楽しめるレジャーランドが好評。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring offers stunning views from its open-air baths, especially during autumn, and features a strong, white-colored sulfur spring that is very warming. They also highlight the reasonable 700 yen day-use fee and the option for hotel guests to arrange shuttle service from the nearest train station. Others also mention the staff are helpful, providing guidance for first-time visitors.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the border of Yamagata and Fukushima, close to Kuriko Pass. It is popular for its leisure facilities, offering a pool in summer and skiing in winter.

name: 黒鴨温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡白鷹町
sales_point: 周囲を山に囲まれたのどかな環境の温泉地。季節に応じた山菜料理が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area surrounded by mountains. Enjoy seasonal wild vegetable dishes.

name: 黒沢温泉
sales_point: 山形市を流れる須川沿いに位置する温泉地。東に蔵王を一望できる。周りはサクランボの名産地。
review_summary:
People say this place offers a wide variety of books, manga, and board games, along with free drinks like coffee and fruit-infused water. They also highlight the attentive staff and the relaxing atmosphere, making it ideal for families.

Some reviews mention the bathing areas can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Sukawa River in Yamagata City. It offers a panoramic view of Zao to the east, and the surrounding area is famous for cherries.

name: 黄金(肘折温泉郷)
location: 山形県 最上郡大蔵村
sales_point: 苦水川沿いに位置する温泉地。肘折温泉郷の一角で、日本有数の二酸化炭素泉（炭酸泉）が湧出する。村営の温泉利用施設あり、飲泉所も整備されている。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a unique cold carbonated spring for drinking and foot/hand baths, alongside warm indoor and outdoor baths. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, which includes shampoo, body soap, and free dryers. Guests mention the nostalgic atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy a relaxing time.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nigorisawa River. It is part of the Hijiori Onsen area, known for its abundant carbonated springs. There are village-operated hot spring facilities and drinking water stations. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 古寺温泉
location: 山形県 西村山郡大江町
sales_point: 東北のアルプス、朝日連峰の登山口に隣接する温泉地。深山の秘湯として登山客や釣り客がよく利用する。山菜や川魚などが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to the trailhead of the Asahi mountain range in the Tohoku Alps. It is frequently visited by climbers and anglers, offering wild vegetables and river fish.

name: 小林温泉
sales_point: 平田町の南方の静かな山あいに位置する温泉地。渓流釣りの基地としても好適。四季のさまざまな料理と共に迎えてくれる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a quiet mountain valley south of Hirata Town. It is also suitable as a base for stream fishing, welcoming guests with various seasonal dishes.

name: 五色温泉
sales_point: 西吾妻連峰の北側の山あいに位置する温泉地。子宝の湯として知られ、冬季はスキーが楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this campground offers excellent facilities, including spotless restrooms with bidets, well-maintained cooking areas with hot water, and a well-stocked shop. They also highlight the high-quality hot springs, which are available for unlimited use and include amenities like toothbrushes and razors. Guests mention the staff are very kind, attentive, and provide a warm welcome.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains on the northern side of the Nishi-Azuma mountain range. Known as a hot spring for fertility, it offers skiing in winter.

name: 碁点温泉
sales_point: 最上川畔の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。多目的温泉保養館のクアハウスがある。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious and clean bathing areas, including a sauna and tiered open-air baths with scenic views of the Mogami River. They also highlight the reasonable prices for day-use bathing and the complimentary drink bar at the restaurant.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be exposed.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the rural area along the Mogami River. It features a multi-purpose hot spring health facility.

name: 酒田湊温泉
sales_point: 酒田市北部の高砂地区に位置する温泉地。簡易ベッドがあり、素泊まりもできる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers clean, functional rooms with large windows that provide excellent views, and appreciate the convenient on-site amenities like a library. They also highlight the delicious and varied breakfast buffet, the helpful staff, and the great value for the price.

Some reviews mention the soundproofing can be poor.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Takasago district in the northern part of Sakata City. It offers simple beds and is available for overnight stays.

name: 寒河江温泉
sales_point: 「日本一のさくらんぼの里」として有名な寒河江市の市街地に位置する温泉地。四季折々の郷土料理が味わえる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring facility offers three types of free-flowing hot springs, including "Kin-no-yu," "Gin-no-yu," and "Do-no-yu," along with two saunas. Visitors also highlight the affordable 350 yen admission fee and the convenient early morning operating hours. They also like the spacious bathing areas and the availability of amenities like shampoo and body soap.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Sakage City, famous for being 'the best cherry blossom town in Japan.' Enjoy seasonal local cuisine.

name: 蔵王温泉
sales_point: 蔵王連峰の北西中腹、標高900メートルの高所に位置する温泉地。1000年余りの歴史を有し、スキーと樹氷で有名。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 900 meters on the northwest slope of the Zao mountain range. With over 1000 years of history, it is famous for skiing and frost-covered trees.

name: 下山温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡白鷹町
sales_point: 白鷹温泉のすぐ近くの山あいに位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains, very close to Shirataka Onsen.

name: 白川温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡飯豊町
sales_point: 飯豊連峰の白川ダムの湖畔に位置する温泉地。四季折々の自然の美しさを満喫できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the lake of Shirakawa Dam in the Iide mountain range. Enjoy the beauty of nature throughout the seasons.

name: 白鷹温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡白鷹町
sales_point: 最上川沿いに位置する温泉地。荒砥駅の北側、国道287号線近くにある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Mogami River, north of Arato Station and near National Route 287.

name: 白布温泉
sales_point: 奥州三高湯の一つに数えられる名湯。標高900メートルに位置し、背後に吾妻山と雄大な天元台スキー場がある。温泉街の中心には昔ながらの茅葺き宿がある。
sales_point_en: A famous hot spring counted among the three great hot springs of Oshu. Located at an elevation of 900 meters, it is backed by Mount Azuma and the magnificent Tengen-dai Ski Resort.

name: 新飯豊温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡小国町
sales_point: 飯豊梅花皮荘から徒歩約5分の所に位置する温泉地。家庭的サービスが人気の一軒宿。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about a 5-minute walk from Iide Baikahiso. It is a family-run inn known for its homely service.

name: 新庄温泉
sales_point: 最上川近くの山あいにある温泉地。眺望が良く、新庄スキー場が近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains near the Mogami River, offering great views and close proximity to Shinjō Ski Resort.

name: 新高湯温泉
sales_point: 湯ノ入沢に沿った渓間に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。昔から登山者と湯治滞在者に愛好されている。湯量は豊富。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area situated along the Yunoirizawa valley, favored by climbers and those seeking therapeutic stays for many years. Abundant hot spring water.

name: 新真室川温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡真室川町
sales_point: 田園風景の中にある真室川沿いの一軒宿の温泉地。地元の山菜や、川魚を使った料理が好評。リウマチ、切り傷などに効果があると言われている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area along the Mamurogawa river, surrounded by rural scenery. Known for its local wild vegetables and river fish dishes, said to be effective for rheumatism and cuts.

name: 瀬見温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡最上町
sales_point: アユで有名な最上小国川沿いに位置する温泉地。源義経が発見したと伝えられ、歴史が永い。蒸し湯の共同浴場がある。
sales_point_en: Located along the Mogami Oguni River, famous for ayu fish. It is said to have been discovered by Minamoto no Yoshitsune, boasting a long history. Features a communal steam bath.

name: 高嶋温泉
sales_point: 家庭的で人情豊かなサービスが大好評。豊かな自然の中で、ゆったりとくつろげる温泉。
sales_point_en: Highly praised for its homely and warm-hearted service. A relaxing hot spring set in rich natural surroundings.

name: 鷹野湯温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡白鷹町
sales_point: 白鷹山や田園の中に位置する温泉地。周囲にレクリエーション施設やスポーツ施設がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located amidst Shirataka Mountain and rural landscapes, with recreational and sports facilities nearby.

name: 筍沢温泉
sales_point: 羽黒山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。筍沢という名からして山菜は豊富である。打ち身に特効があると伝えられている。
sales_point_en: Situated at the northern foot of Mount Haguro, this hot spring area is abundant in wild vegetables, as suggested by its name. Known for its effectiveness against bruises.

name: 辰ケ湯温泉
sales_point: 最上川沿いの丘陵に位置する温泉地。昔から湯治・療養客に親しまれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill along the Mogami River, cherished by therapeutic and recuperative guests for many years.

name: 玉庭温泉
location: 山形県 東置賜郡川西町
sales_point: 川西町の最南部、竹駒山南側山麓に位置する温泉地。スキー場とゴルフ場が隣接しており、自然と調和したリゾート温泉。
sales_point_en: Located at the southernmost part of Kawanishi Town, on the southern foothills of Takekoma Mountain. A resort hot spring harmonized with nature, adjacent to ski and golf facilities.

name: 台沢温泉
location: 山形県 西置賜郡飯豊町
sales_point: 田園に囲まれた静かな環境に位置する温泉地。泉色は薄茶色で、お湯はぬるっとした感触がありよく温まる。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area surrounded by rural landscapes. The water is light brown and has a smooth texture, providing a warming effect.

name: 大野目温泉
sales_point: 山形市北部の郊外に位置する温泉地。車の便がよい。山形市の施設や流通団地が近くにある。
sales_point_en: Located in the suburbs of northern Yamagata City, easily accessible by car. Close to facilities and distribution centers in Yamagata City.

name: 鳥海温泉
location: 山形県 飽海郡遊佐町
sales_point: 庄内砂丘の北端に位置する温泉地。東に鳥海山を仰ぎ眺望が良い。キャンプ場、コテージ村、海水浴場も近く若者から家族連れまで好評。
sales_point_en: Situated at the northern edge of the Shonai Sand Dunes, offering great views of Mount Chokai to the east. Popular among young people and families, with nearby camping sites, cottage villages, and swimming beaches.

name: 月の沢温泉
location: 山形県 東田川郡庄内町
sales_point: 月山の北側山麓の静かな山あいに位置する温泉地。勉強会や吹奏楽部の合宿などにも利用されており、若者から家族連れにも好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a quiet mountain valley on the northern foothills of Mount Gassan. Frequently used for study sessions and music club camps, well-received by both young people and families.

name: 鶴子温泉
sales_point: 最上川支流の丹生川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Niyukawa river, a tributary of the Mogami River. Set in a quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 天童温泉
sales_point: 天童の市街地に位置する温泉地。将棋の駒の産地として名高く、人間将棋が有名。周辺はサクランボを中心としたフルーツの産地で、桃、ブドウ、ラ・フランス等が年間を通じて楽しめる
sales_point_en: Located in the city center of Tendo, famous for its production of shogi pieces and the unique human shogi event. The surrounding area is known for its fruit production, especially cherries, peaches, grapes, and La France pears, available year-round.

name: 中桜田温泉
sales_point: 山形市の東南部、西蔵王高原の麓に位置する温泉地。総合スポーツ施設を併設している。夜景は見事。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of the West Zao Highlands in the southeastern part of Yamagata City. Features a comprehensive sports facility and offers stunning night views.

name: 長井温泉
sales_point: 長井市南部の最上川上流河畔に位置する温泉地。源義家が奥羽征伐で訪れた際に、この温泉を利用したと伝えられる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers enjoyable free-flowing hot springs, including both indoor and outdoor baths, and features a relaxing bedrock bath. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices and the clean resting areas.

Other reviews mention the outdoor baths can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Located along the upper reaches of the Mogami River in the southern part of Nagai City. It is said that Minamoto no Yoshiie used this hot spring during his campaign in the Oshu region.

name: 長沼温泉
sales_point: 庄内平野の藤島川畔に位置する温泉地。田園風景の閑静な環境。保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers two distinct spring qualities, including a unique, concentrated, and warming "oily" or "petroleum" scented water, along with a sauna and cold bath. Guests also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, the friendly staff, and the convenient on-site direct sales store.

Some reviews mention there can be a strong odor in the water.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Fujishima River in the Shonai Plain. A quiet environment surrounded by rural scenery, ideal for recuperation and therapy.

name: なの花温泉
location: 山形県 東田川郡三川町
sales_point: 国道7号線沿いの赤川河畔に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。昔ながらの大庄屋造りの建物が心を和ませてくれる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a highly concentrated, reddish-brown hot spring, a large bath, a sauna, and a cold water bath. They also highlight the affordable 500-yen entry fee, convenient early morning hours, and its location next to a roadside station with a supermarket.

Other reviews mention there can be no open-air bath.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Akagawa river, adjacent to National Route 7. The traditional architecture of an old farmhouse provides a soothing atmosphere.

name: 滑川温泉
sales_point: 前川沿い、標高850メートルの渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。220年もの歴史を持つ湯治場で、露天風呂も完備されている。登山の基地としても好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent quality hot springs, including milky white sulfur baths and a variety of indoor and outdoor options like rock and cypress baths. They also highlight the delicious and plentiful in-room meals, featuring local specialties. Guests mention the clean and well-maintained rooms, despite the building's age, and appreciate the tranquil, private atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Maekawa river at an elevation of 850 meters, this hot spring area has a history of 220 years as a therapeutic site, featuring outdoor baths. Ideal as a base for mountain climbing.

name: 新山温泉
sales_point: 金峰山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。神経痛、リウマチなどに効果の高い湯で、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northern foothills of Mount Kinpo. The water is highly effective for neuralgia and rheumatism, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 及位温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡真室川町
sales_point: 山あいに位置する温泉地。近くに及位わらび園があり、山菜取りが楽しめる。高血圧、動脈硬化に効果があると言われている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area situated in the mountains. Nearby is the Oii Warabi Garden, where visitors can enjoy foraging for wild vegetables. It is said to be effective for high blood pressure and arteriosclerosis.

name: 羽黒温泉
sales_point: 羽黒山参拝者が多く訪れることで知られる温泉地。予約の際に一言添えると精進料理を食べることもできる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths, a sauna with auto-löyly, and the delicious Yamabushi ramen. Guests also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, free amenities like shampoo and body soap, and convenient long operating hours.

Other reviews mention the water bath can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area known for attracting many visitors to Haguro Mountain. If you mention it when making a reservation, you can also enjoy shojin ryori (Buddhist vegetarian cuisine).

name: 羽黒山温泉
sales_point: 出羽三山神社のすぐ近くに位置する温泉地。大自然に囲まれ環境が良い。国民休暇村があり、冬はスキーも楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths, a sauna with auto-löyly, and the delicious Yamabushi ramen. Guests also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, free amenities like shampoo and body soap, and convenient long operating hours.

Other reviews mention the water bath can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Located very close to the Dewa Sanzan Shrine, this hot spring area is surrounded by nature and has a pleasant environment. There is a national holiday village, and skiing can be enjoyed in winter.

name: 波渡崎温泉
sales_point: 庄内海浜県立自然公園内の漁港に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a fishing port within the Shonai Coastal Prefectural Natural Park.

name: 羽根沢温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡鮭川村
sales_point: 出羽山地東側の曲川近くに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養に好適。天然ガスも多量に自噴し、客室に灯している宿もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the curved river on the eastern side of the Dewa Mountains. It is suitable for recuperation in a quiet environment. There are also accommodations that use natural gas for lighting.

name: 葉山(上山温泉郷)
sales_point: 上山温泉に隣接している温泉地で、上山温泉郷と称する場合もある。山腹に位置し、眺望が良く、静かな環境が特徴。6～11月まで果物狩りが楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers private in-room onsen baths with mountain views, and some rooms also feature foot baths. They also highlight the delicious and creative Japanese cuisine, including local specialties like Yamagata beef and "Tsuyahime" rice. Visitors appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, as well as the convenient complimentary shuttle service to the train station.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to Kaminoyama Onsen, this hot spring area is sometimes referred to as the Kaminoyama Onsen District. It is located on a mountainside, featuring good views and a tranquil environment. Fruit picking can be enjoyed from June to November.

name: 火打崎温泉
sales_point: 鶴岡市の南西の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。神経痛や打ち身に効果が高い。日帰り入浴も受付している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southwestern rural area of Tsuruoka City. It is highly effective for neuralgia and bruises. Day-use bathing is also available.

name: 東根温泉
sales_point: 田園の風景の中に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、サクランボの王様「佐藤錦」の発祥の地。色々な種類の果物狩りが、6月中旬～11月まで楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located amidst rural scenery. It has a quiet environment and is the birthplace of the king of cherries, 'Sato Nishiki.' Various types of fruit picking can be enjoyed from mid-June to November.

name: 肘折(肘折温泉郷)
location: 山形県 最上郡大蔵村
sales_point: 肘折温泉郷の中心となる温泉地。1200年前に発見され、600年ほど前に温泉場として開業したと伝えられる銅山川沿いに位置し、自然環境が良い。月山登山の足場としても賑わう。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring town offers excellent quality hot springs, with some mentioning the water feels like lotion and is carbonated. Visitors also highlight the delicious, mountain vegetable-focused meals and the charming, retro atmosphere. They appreciate the friendly staff and the morning market, which sells fresh local produce and handmade dishes.
sales_point_en: The central hot spring area of Hijiori Onsen District. It is said to have been discovered 1200 years ago and opened as a hot spring about 600 years ago, located along the Douzan River with a good natural environment. It is also popular as a base for climbing Mount Gassan. Designated as a national recuperation hot spring area, it is suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: ひまわり温泉
location: 山形県 東村山郡中山町
sales_point: 最上川沿いの「せせらぎ公園」に隣接した温泉地。一帯が「元気のさと」として整備され、温泉プールや体育館等がある。日帰り入浴施設も併設されている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers excellent quality hot springs with both hot and lukewarm baths, along with spacious saunas and outdoor baths. They also highlight the affordable prices, delicious food options like katsudon and meat soba, and the wide variety of local products available in the souvenir shop.

Other reviews mention the public baths can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to 'Seseragi Park' along the Mogami River. The area is developed as 'Genki no Sato' and features a hot spring pool and gymnasium. Day-use bathing facilities are also available.

name: 琵琶の沢温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡最上町
sales_point: 堺田駅の西側、約2キロの山あいに位置する温泉地。神経痛や冷え性によく効くと言われる。
review_summary:
People say this day use onsen offers a variety of baths, including indoor and outdoor options, with different sizes and temperatures. They also highlight the relaxing and spacious atmosphere, and the opportunity to make onsen tamago (hot spring eggs).

Other reviews mention the location can be remote.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers in the mountains west of Sakaita Station. It is said to be effective for neuralgia and cold sensitivity.

name: 舟形若あゆ温泉
location: 山形県 最上郡舟形町
sales_point: 最上川支流の小国川近くに位置する温泉地。総合レジャー施設を併設している。月山や鳥海山を見渡せる高台にある露天風呂は眺望が良い。キャンプ、テニスなど楽しめて家族連れに最適。日帰り入浴も人気。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including indoor and outdoor options with excellent views of the mountains and seasonal scenery. They also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the sauna can be unavailable in the morning.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the Oguni River, a tributary of the Mogami River. It features a comprehensive leisure facility. The open-air bath on a high ground offers a good view of Mount Gassan and Mount Chokai. It is ideal for families, with activities like camping and tennis available. Day-use bathing is also popular.

name: 冨本温泉
sales_point: 村山市南部の湯野沢地区に位置する温泉地。地元の人々に人気の湯である。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Yunosawa district in the southern part of Murayama City. It is a popular hot spring among local residents.

name: 松山温泉
sales_point: 最上川、月山、庄内平野を一望できる山あいに位置する温泉地。火傷に効くと言われる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers excellent views of the Shonai Plain and Mogami River from its baths and dining area. Guests also appreciate the reasonable 400 yen admission fee for day use and the availability of shampoo and body soap.

Some reviews mention the hot springs can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains with a panoramic view of the Mogami River, Mount Gassan, and the Shonai Plain. It is said to be effective for burns.

name: 宮内温泉
sales_point: 熊野大社や菊人形まつりの会場の近くに位置する温泉地。周りには沢山の果樹園があり、サクランボを始め、ぶどうやリンゴ、ラ・フランスを堪能できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Kumano Taisha Shrine and the Kiku Doll Festival venue. The surrounding area is filled with many orchards, where visitors can enjoy cherries, grapes, apples, and La France pears.

name: 宮海温泉
sales_point: 酒田市北西部の宮海地区に位置する温泉地。無料送迎バスが市内を一日数回循環しており、5名以上は無料送迎している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Miyau district in the northwestern part of Sakata City. A free shuttle bus circulates several times a day within the city, and free transportation is provided for groups of five or more.

name: 村山ゆざ温泉
sales_point: 楯岡駅の西北に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、江戸末期の建物を復元した宿がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located northwest of Tateoka Station. It has a quiet environment and features accommodations that have restored buildings from the late Edo period.

name: 柳川温泉
location: 山形県 西村山郡大江町
sales_point: 山間部の小さな集落に位置する温泉地。四季折々に変化する山里の景色を楽しみながら、ゆったりとくつろげる。また、毎週土曜日にはそば打ちも体験できる施設がある。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor rock baths, and offers drinkable spring water. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the clean, comfortable facilities. Others also say the staff are warm and provide good service.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a small mountain village. Visitors can relax while enjoying the changing scenery of the mountain village throughout the seasons. Additionally, there is a facility where visitors can experience soba making every Saturday.

name: 山形温泉
sales_point: 山形と上山の中間に位置する温泉地。住宅街の中の一軒宿で、蔵王観光の足場に適している。
review_summary: Visitors say this open-air bath offers a unique experience with its strong acidic sulfur spring water and expansive, natural setting along a river. They also highlight the refreshing atmosphere, surrounded by lush greenery and the sounds of nature. Guests mention the convenience of ample parking and the availability of lockers for valuables.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located between Yamagata and Kaminoyama. It is a single inn situated in a residential area, making it suitable as a base for sightseeing in Zao.

name: 山辺温泉
location: 山形県 東村山郡山辺町
sales_point: 山辺町の南東部、須川河畔に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・休養に好適。山形観光の拠点に最適。日帰り入浴も好評。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including three indoor baths with different temperatures, an outdoor bath, a sauna, and a waterfall tap. They also highlight the affordable 350 yen admission fee, the clean facilities, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the guests can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area located by the Sugawa River in the southeastern part of Yamabe Town, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It serves as a great base for sightseeing in Yamagata, and day-use bathing is also popular.

name: 湯田川温泉
sales_point: 庄内藩士の湯治湯として発展した歴史の永い温泉地。三方を山に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。孟宗竹の産地としても知られる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A historic hot spring area that developed as a healing spot for the Shonai clan. Nestled in a quiet environment surrounded by mountains, it is also known for its production of bamboo shoots. Recognized as a national health resort.

name: 湯殿山温泉
sales_point: 湯殿山奥ノ院の湯殿山神社入口に位置する温泉地。出羽三山めぐりの基地に好適。
sales_point_en: Located at the entrance of the Yudonoyama Shrine, this hot spring area serves as a great base for exploring the Dewa Sanzan mountains.

name: 湯沼温泉
location: 山形県 東置賜郡高畠町
sales_point: 高畠町の北部に位置する温泉地。のどかな田園の中で、自然環境が良い。町内に日本三大文殊の一つ、亀岡文殊がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Takahata Town, surrounded by peaceful rural scenery and excellent natural environment. The town is home to one of Japan's three great Monju, Kameoka Monju.

name: 湯ノ沢温泉
sales_point: 米沢盆地へ流れる羽黒川畔に湧く温泉地。近くに水窪ダムがある。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers exceptional Yonezawa beef kaiseki cuisine, featuring various cuts and cooking methods, with the beef sushi being a standout. They also highlight the quiet, adult-oriented atmosphere, perfect for couples, and the availability of private open-air baths. Visitors appreciate the attentive staff and the delicious breakfast, including local dishes like imoni.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area that springs forth by the banks of the Haguro River flowing into the Yonezawa Basin. Close to the Mizukubo Dam.

name: 湯の沢温泉
sales_point: 羽黒山の北側山裾に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of Mount Haguro, this hot spring area is ideal for relaxation and recuperation in a quiet environment.

name: 湯の瀬温泉
sales_point: 温海岳の東側山麓、五十川沿いに位置する一軒宿の温泉地。大きい露天風呂が好評。
review_summary:
People say this Japanese inn offers delicious seafood, mountain vegetables, and rice, and features a large, unique outdoor bath resembling a swimming pool. They also highlight the warm and welcoming service, and the relaxing, nostalgic atmosphere.

Some reviews mention there can be a presence of insects.
sales_point_en: A single inn hot spring area located along the Iigawa River at the eastern foot of Mount Umine. The large outdoor bath is highly praised.

name: 湯ノ田温泉
location: 山形県 飽海郡遊佐町
sales_point: 日本海沿いの国道7号線沿いに位置する温泉地。天気のいい日には、正面の海上彼方に飛島の姿も望まれる
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 7 by the Sea of Japan. On clear days, you can see the distant island of Tobishima.

name: 湯の台温泉
sales_point: 鳥海山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。登山客などの利用が多い。山の幸が美味。日帰りの利用もできる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this mountain resort offers delicious cuisine made with local ingredients and features a clear, smooth hot spring with scenic outdoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, the quiet and relaxing atmosphere, and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the bath area can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southern foot of Mount Chokai, popular among climbers. The local mountain delicacies are delicious, and day-use is available.

name: 湯野浜温泉
sales_point: 庄内砂丘の南端に位置する温泉地。亀にまつわる温泉発見の物語が伝えられ、海水浴場としても賑わう。日本海の幸が味わえる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southern end of the Shonai Sand Dunes. There is a legend about the discovery of the hot spring related to turtles, and it is also lively as a beach resort. Enjoy the seafood from the Sea of Japan.

name: 湯舟沢温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ線袖崎駅の東約2キロにある温泉地。閑静な山間に位置し、美肌効果があると言われている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a unique, thick, and slippery alkaline hot spring that leaves skin smooth and soft. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, including carp dishes and imoni, served in generous portions. Guests mention the reasonable prices and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers east of the JR Sodezaki Station. Situated in a quiet mountain area, it is said to have skin-beautifying effects.

name: 由良温泉
sales_point: 由良海岸の高台に位置する温泉地。隣接する海水浴場は「渚百選」「日本の海水浴場55選」に選定されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers stunning ocean views from the rooms and a wide variety of fresh seafood for dinner. They also highlight the warm hospitality from the staff and the convenient access to the beach.

Some reviews mention the food can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill overlooking Yura Beach, which has been selected as one of the 'Top 100 Beaches' and '55 Selected Beaches in Japan.'

name: 龍王（上山温泉郷）
sales_point: 上山市北部、須川の流れ近くの田園風景の中にある温泉地。近くに競馬場、リナワールド、齋藤茂吉記念館があり、若者から家族連れまで楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Kaminoyama City, amidst rural scenery near the flow of the Sugawa River. Close to a racetrack, Lina World, and the Shigekichi Saito Memorial Museum, it offers fun for both young people and families.

name: 安比温泉
sales_point: 安比高原スキー場の周辺に点在する温泉施設の総称。目的別で施設を選べる。自然の中で温泉に入り、心身共にくつろげる。
sales_point_en: A collective term for hot spring facilities scattered around the Appi Kogen Ski Resort. You can choose facilities based on your purpose, allowing you to relax both body and mind in nature.

name: 安比山麓温泉
sales_point: 保温効果が抜群の温泉。やわらかな肌触りが心地よさを誘う。
sales_point_en: A hot spring with excellent heat retention properties. Its soft texture invites comfort.

name: あづまね温泉
location: 岩手県 紫波郡紫波町
sales_point: 奥州街道の宿場町、紫波町の郊外に位置する温泉地。美人の湯とも言われ、日帰り入浴も好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the outskirts of Shiwa Town, a post town on the Oshu Highway. Known as a beauty hot spring, day-use bathing is also popular.

name: 網張温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 岩手山の南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。1300年もの歴史を持つ名湯。四季折々のスポーツを楽しむことができる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features high-quality sulfur hot springs, including an open-air bath with excellent views, and offers amenities like shampoo and body soap. They also highlight the clean, renovated facilities, free rest areas, and reasonable prices.

Some reviews mention the indoor bath can be a plain iron spring.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southwestern foot of Mount Iwate. A famous hot spring with a history of 1300 years, it offers seasonal sports activities.

name: 石鳥谷温泉
sales_point: 北上川支流の葛丸川渓流に位置する温泉地。麦飯石の砂風呂も楽しめ、素朴な風景の中でゆっくりできる。
review_summary:
Visitors praise this roadside station for its delicious gelato and hearty regional dishes, including hitsumi and soba. They also appreciate the clean and spacious restrooms, ample parking, and overall well-maintained facilities.

Other reviews mention there can be a limited product selection.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Katsumaru River, a tributary of the Kitakami River. Enjoy the sand bath made of barley stone and relax in a rustic landscape.

name: 入畑温泉
sales_point: 入畑ダムのすぐ近くの山間、奥深くに位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located deep in the mountains, very close to the Irihata Dam.

name: 岩手山焼走り温泉
sales_point: 岩手山の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。整備されたリゾート地で、冬はスキーも楽しめる。
review_summary: Visitors say this tourist destination features vast lava flows from Mount Iwate, offering stunning panoramic views. They also highlight the free parking and walking paths, making it an accessible experience. Others mention the unique, silent atmosphere, providing a sense of nature's power.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northeastern foot of Mount Iwate. A well-maintained resort area where you can enjoy skiing in winter.

name: 岩手湯本（湯田温泉郷）
location: 岩手県 和賀郡西和賀町
sales_point: 和賀川の上流に位置する温泉地。湯田温泉郷の中心的存在のひとつ。江戸時代に発見されたと伝えられ、歴史が永い。閑静な環境で静養・保養に好適。砂風呂もある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of the Waga River, one of the central spots of the Yuda Onsen District. It is said to have been discovered during the Edo period, boasting a long history. Ideal for relaxation and recuperation in a quiet environment, with sand baths available.

name: 大歩温泉
sales_point: 山懐深く原生林にはぐくまれ、大自然そのままの焼石岳を仰いで入れる湯けむりの里。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers a variety of baths, including a spacious outdoor bath, sauna, and electric bath, with many appreciating the quality of the spring water. They also highlight the delicious breakfast and dinner, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the changing rooms can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Nestled deep in the mountains, surrounded by primeval forests, this hot spring area offers views of the untouched nature of Mount Yaishi.

name: 鴬宿温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 開湯450年の歴史を誇る温泉地。湯治場の雰囲気と観光温泉の二面を合わせ持つ。その昔、ウグイスが温泉で傷を治していた事からこの名が付いた。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area boasting a history of 450 years. It combines the atmosphere of a hot spring resort with that of a tourist destination. The name comes from the legend that nightingales healed their wounds in the hot springs.

name: 大沢（花巻南温泉郷）
sales_point: 歴代著名人に好まれた昔からの名湯。豊沢川岸に造られた、露天風呂からの四季の風景は見事。日帰り入浴も好評。
review_summary: People say this onsen ryokan offers a variety of baths, including free private family baths and a scenic open-air bath with river views. They also highlight the delicious and plentiful meals, especially the local cuisine and buffet breakfast. Guests mention the staff are attentive and helpful, and appreciate the traditional, relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A renowned hot spring favored by many famous figures throughout history. The open-air baths offer stunning seasonal views along the banks of the Toyosawa River. Day-use bathing is also popular.

name: 鳳温泉
sales_point: 御所湖をはさみ、繋温泉の北に位置する温泉地。国道沿いなので盛岡観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located north of Tsunagi Onsen, across from Goshoko Lake, this hot spring area is conveniently situated along the national highway, making it a great base for sightseeing in Morioka.

name: 奥厳美温泉
sales_point: 国道342号線沿いに位置する温泉地。名勝厳美渓の奥座敷として親しまれている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this gorge offers beautiful scenery with emerald green water, unique rock formations, and a fun "flying dango" experience. They also highlight the delicious dango, the enjoyable walking trails, and the convenient parking.

Some reviews mention the area can be deserted.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located along National Route 342 and is cherished as a hidden retreat of the scenic Genbi Gorge.

name: 奥中山高原温泉
location: 岩手県 二戸郡一戸町
sales_point: 奥中山高原スキー場が隣接しており、冬はスキー客で賑わいを見せる。
sales_point_en: Adjacent to the Oku Nakayama Kogen Ski Resort, this hot spring area is bustling with ski enthusiasts in winter.

name: 小本温泉
location: 岩手県 下閉伊郡岩泉町
sales_point: 太平洋を望む小本地区に位置する温泉地。龍泉洞の伏流水が流れ込み薬効が高いと言われる。陸中海岸など観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located in the Obon area overlooking the Pacific Ocean, this hot spring is said to have high medicinal properties due to the underground water from Ryusendo Cave. It is also a great base for sightseeing in the Rikuchu Coast area.

name: 金矢（花巻温泉郷）
sales_point: 花巻広域公園内に位置する温泉地。自然に囲まれ、スポーツ施設も充実している。
sales_point_en: Situated within Hanamaki Wide Area Park, this hot spring area is surrounded by nature and offers excellent sports facilities.

name: 金ヶ崎温泉
location: 岩手県 胆沢郡金ヶ崎町
sales_point: 駒ヶ岳の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。「不老の泉」と言われ、肌に優しい泉質が特徴。付近一帯は広大な牧草地で開放感がある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers hot, soft, and skin-smoothing spring water, along with a spacious sauna and a deep cold bath. Guests also highlight the reasonable 600 yen entry fee, the availability of an on-site restaurant, and free lockers.

Other reviews mention there can be no open-air bath.
sales_point_en: Located on the western foothills of Mount Komagatake, this hot spring is known as the 'Furo no Izumi' (Spring of Immortality), featuring a gentle water quality that is kind to the skin. The surrounding area consists of vast pastures, providing a sense of openness.

name: 川尻（湯田温泉郷）
location: 岩手県 和賀郡西和賀町
sales_point: ＪＲほっとゆだ駅の北方約1キロ、和賀川河畔に位置する温泉地。すぐ近くに錦秋湖があり、観光や探勝基地に好適。湯田温泉郷のひとつ。
review_summary:
People say this onsen, located within a train station, offers three indoor baths with varying temperatures and provides complimentary shampoo and body soap. They also highlight the affordable 440 yen entrance fee and the free, spacious resting area on the second floor.

Some reviews mention the hottest bath can be too warm.
sales_point_en: Located about 1 kilometer north of JR Hotto Yuda Station, this hot spring area is situated along the banks of the Waga River. Close to Nishikiko Lake, it serves as a great base for sightseeing and exploration, being one of the Yuda Onsen Districts.

name: かんぽの宿盛岡温泉
sales_point: 盛岡ICの南西約6キロ、盛岡市郊外に位置する温泉地。手づくり村や小岩井農場が近く見所も多い。
review_summary: People say this hotel features a natural hot spring with a smooth, skin-softening water quality, along with a sauna, cold bath, and open-air baths. Guests also highlight the complimentary "Yonaki Soba" ramen, ice cream, and lactic acid beverages, as well as the diverse breakfast buffet including local specialties like Morioka reimen. They appreciate the clean, spacious rooms and the attentive staff.
sales_point_en: Located about 6 kilometers southwest of Morioka IC, this hot spring area is in the suburbs of Morioka City, with many attractions nearby, including a handmade village and Koiwai Farm.

name: 金田一温泉
sales_point: 岩手県の最北部、青森県境に近い馬渕川沿いに位置する温泉地。寛永年の開湯と伝えられ歴史が永い。折爪岳の北側にあり、閑静な環境。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。十和田湖・陸中海岸の観光拠点にも良い。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Mabu River near the northernmost part of Iwate Prefecture, close to the Aomori Prefecture border, this hot spring area has a long history dating back to the Kan'ei era. It is located in a quiet environment, designated as a national health resort, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy. It also serves as a good base for sightseeing at Lake Towada and the Rikuchu Coast.

name: 銀河高原温泉
location: 岩手県 和賀郡西和賀町
sales_point: 地ビール工場とビアレストランが併設されている温泉地。村内にそば打ち体験工房やトナカイ牧場などが整備され、家族で楽しめる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area features a craft beer factory and a beer restaurant. It also has a soba-making experience workshop and a reindeer farm, making it enjoyable for families.

name: 国見温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 秋田との県境、駒ヶ岳の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。効能が高く、湯治・静養向き。駒ヶ岳や千沼ヶ原への登山基地にもなっている。
sales_point_en: Located on the southern foothills of Mount Komagatake, near the border with Akita Prefecture, this hot spring area is known for its high efficacy, suitable for recuperation and therapy. It also serves as a base for climbing Mount Komagatake and Sennuma Plain.

name: 夏油温泉
sales_point: 栗駒国定公園内の標高700メートルの山間に位置する温泉地。ブナの原生林に囲まれた渓谷沿いで、自然環境が良い。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of 700 meters in the Kurikoma National Park, this hot spring area is located along a valley surrounded by beech primeval forests, offering a great natural environment. Designated as a national health resort, it is suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: 厳美渓温泉
sales_point: 景勝地「厳美渓」の河畔に位置する温泉地。厳美渓の探勝はもちろん、毛越寺、中尊寺観光足場にも最適。
review_summary:
People say this ryokan offers a variety of well-maintained hot spring baths, delicious Chinese cuisine, and attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the building can be old and neglected, and rooms can be noisy.
sales_point_en: Located along the riverbank of the scenic Genbi Gorge, this hot spring area is perfect for exploring Genbi Gorge and is also an excellent base for sightseeing at Mōtsū-ji and Chūson-ji temples.

name: 玄武温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 葛根田の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。小岩井農場にも近く、観光の拠点としても便利。自然に囲まれ、「若返りの湯」として親しまれている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent hot spring baths with comfortable temperatures and a wide variety of delicious, hearty meals. They also highlight the clean facilities, impressive views from the outdoor bath, and relaxing rest areas.

Other reviews mention the bath water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Katsukon River, this hot spring area is close to Koiwai Farm, making it convenient for sightseeing. Surrounded by nature, it is cherished as the 'Rejuvenating Hot Spring.'

name: 小川温泉
sales_point: 釜石市のほぼ中央部、日向ダムの西部山間に位置する温泉地。別名白水温泉と呼ばれている。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。紅葉や四季折々の風情を写し出す渓流美を満喫できる。
sales_point_en: Located in the central part of Kamaishi City, in the mountainous area west of Hinata Dam, this hot spring is also known as Shiramizu Onsen. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and therapy, allowing visitors to enjoy the beautiful streams reflecting autumn leaves and seasonal scenery.

name: 小田代温泉
sales_point: 田老駅の南西4キロに位置する温泉地。豊かな自然に囲まれ、閑静な環境にある。保養・療養に好適で、日帰りのリハビリも可能。付近では山菜採りや渓流釣りも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located 4 kilometers southwest of Taro Station, this hot spring area is surrounded by rich nature and offers a quiet environment. It is suitable for recuperation and therapy, with day-use rehabilitation also available. Nearby, visitors can enjoy mountain vegetable picking and stream fishing.

name: 小屋の沢温泉
sales_point: 安比高原に訪れる足場として人気の温泉地。静かな山あいで保養に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent milky white sulfur hot springs, with many highlighting the comfortable temperature of the open-air baths. Guests mention the delicious local cuisine, including dishes like Horo-horo chicken and Tan-kaku beef, and appreciate the attentive and friendly staff.
sales_point_en: A popular hot spring area serving as a base for visiting Appi Kogen. Ideal for relaxation in a quiet mountain setting.

name: 極楽野温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 小岩井農場の西方すぐの極楽野に位置する温泉地。「牧場の湯」とも呼ばれている。
review_summary:
Diners like this soba restaurant's delicious handmade soba noodles, tempura, and various small dishes, with many highlighting the satisfying texture and flavor. They also appreciate the calm atmosphere of the renovated old house and the efficient waiting system that allows guests to wait in their cars.

Some reviews mention the rice can be firm.
sales_point_en: Located just west of Koiwai Farm, this hot spring area is also known as 'Bokujou no Yu' (Farm's Bath).

name: 御在所温泉
sales_point: 大黒森、屋ノ棟岳などの南裾の高原に位置する温泉地。八幡平スキー場のすぐ近くで冬場も賑わう。
sales_point_en: Situated at the southern foothills of Daikokumori and Yano Mountain, this hot spring area is bustling in winter, close to Hachimantai Ski Resort.

name: 御所湖温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 御所湖の南岸に位置する温泉地。岩手山や御所湖の眺望が良い。入浴すると肌がつるつるするところから「美肌の湯」として人気がある。
sales_point_en: Located on the southern shore of Gosho Lake, this hot spring offers great views of Mount Iwate and the lake. Known as 'Bijin no Yu' (Beauty Bath) for its skin-smoothing properties.

name: 左草（湯田温泉郷）
location: 岩手県 和賀郡西和賀町
sales_point: 湯田ICの北方約5キロの山あいに位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。湯田温泉郷のひとつ。
review_summary: People say this sand bath facility offers a unique and relaxing experience, with the sand's warmth and weight providing a deeply comforting sensation. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the friendly, helpful staff who explain the process clearly. Visitors appreciate the opportunity to warm up thoroughly and reset from fatigue.
sales_point_en: Located about 5 kilometers north of Yuda IC, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation. One of the Yuda Onsen district.

name: 三陸山田温泉
location: 岩手県 下閉伊郡山田町
sales_point: 山田湾を望む船越家族旅行村に隣接している温泉地。リアス式海岸が美しく、自然環境に恵まれている。浦の浜海水浴場が近い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a clean facility with a variety of baths, including a sauna with löyly and a relaxing pot bath. They also highlight the comfortable lounge space and convenient adjacent supermarket.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be small.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to Funakoshi Family Travel Village overlooking Yamada Bay, this hot spring area is blessed with beautiful rias coastline and natural surroundings. Close to Ura no Hama Beach.

name: 雫石温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 雫石町ののどかな田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。雫石スキー場やゴルフ場に最も近く、スポーツ基地として最適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has smooth, skin-softening hot spring water, along with a sauna and an outdoor bath. They also highlight the affordable entry fee and the convenient connection to a roadside station with shops and dining.

Some reviews mention the bathing area can be neglected.
sales_point_en: Located in the tranquil rural landscape of Shizukuishi, this hot spring area is closest to Shizukuishi Ski Resort and golf courses, making it ideal for sports enthusiasts.

name: 雫石高倉温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 秀峰岩手山を一望できる雫石スキー場、雫石ゴルフ場の所に位置する温泉地。各種スポーツの基地として好評。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located near Shizukuishi Ski Resort and Shizukuishi Golf Course, offering a great view of the majestic Mount Iwate and is popular as a base for various sports.

name: 志戸平（花巻南温泉郷）
sales_point: 豊沢川の清流に臨む温泉地。多様な浴室からの豊かな自然美を堪能できる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers a wide variety of delicious buffet options, including fresh seafood and seasonal dishes, along with spacious and clean rooms. They also highlight the expansive onsen baths, kid-friendly facilities like pools and play areas, and the attentive, friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing the clear waters of the Toyosawa River, where you can enjoy the rich natural beauty from various bathing facilities.

name: 新安比温泉
sales_point: 七時雨山の西方、安代ICからすぐの所に位置する温泉地。海水の2倍以上の塩分濃度を持つ独特の泉質で、様々な効果があると言われている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers a unique, highly concentrated salt spring onsen with excellent warming and moisturizing properties, along with delicious and varied meals. They also highlight the friendly, accommodating staff and convenient amenities like laundry facilities and free welcome drinks.

Some reviews mention there can be a strong, unpleasant odor.
sales_point_en: Located just west of Nanajuurai Mountain and near the Aso IC, this hot spring has a unique mineral content with salt concentration more than double that of seawater, said to have various health benefits.

name: 新鉛（花巻温泉郷）
sales_point: 花巻温泉郷の最奥に位置する温泉地。渓流釣りの穴場で、渓谷美と共に楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located at the innermost part of Hanamaki Onsen District, known as a hidden spot for stream fishing, allowing you to enjoy the beauty of the gorge.

name: 新山根温泉
sales_point: 久慈市南部の山あいに位置する温泉地。県内最高のアルカリ性のお湯は硫黄の香りがし、湯触りはつるつる、すべすべする。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features high-quality, alkaline hot springs that leave skin feeling smooth, along with a sauna and cold bath. Guests also mention the clean facilities, delicious food, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention access can be difficult.
sales_point_en: Situated in the southern mountains of Kuji City, this hot spring boasts the highest alkalinity in the prefecture, with a sulfur scent and a smooth, silky touch.

name: 真湯温泉
sales_point: 栗駒山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。1846年の開湯と伝えられ、歴史が永い。泉質は弱アルカリ性の硫酸塩泉で、強酸性の須川温泉の「直し湯」として知られる。自然環境が良く、渓谷が美しい。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located at the northern foothills of Mount Kurikoma, this hot spring has a long history dating back to 1846. The water is a weak alkaline sulfate spring, known as a 'healing bath' for the strongly acidic Sukawa Onsen. The natural environment is beautiful, and it is designated as a national health resort, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 新湯本（花巻温泉郷）
sales_point: 湧出量毎分4000リットルという豊富な湯量を誇っている。湯治向きの温泉地。
review_summary:
Guests mention this resort offers access to three distinct hot spring baths, including open-air options, and a wide variety of delicious buffet dishes, especially crab. They also highlight the reasonable prices, attentive staff, and the beautiful adjacent rose garden.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: Boasting a rich water flow of 4000 liters per minute, this hot spring area is suitable for therapeutic bathing.

name: 巣郷（湯田温泉郷）
location: 岩手県 和賀郡西和賀町
sales_point: 秋田県境に近い国道107号線沿いに位置する温泉地。湯田温泉郷のひとつに数えられ、静かな環境にある。静養・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 107 near the Akita Prefecture border, this hot spring area is one of the Yuda Onsen district, set in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 瀬美温泉
sales_point: 夏油川の渓流沿いに位置する一軒宿の温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養に好適。ここから夏油温泉への道は山岳道路となる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen offers multiple types of hot springs, including a "beauty skin" bath with a smooth texture, and delicious, voluminous meals featuring local cuisine. They also highlight the excellent hospitality, quiet atmosphere, and good value for the price.

Some reviews mention the hot water can be slow.
sales_point_en: A solitary hot spring located along the summer oil river, in a tranquil environment, suitable for recuperation. The road from here to Yuzawa Onsen becomes a mountain road.

name: 千貫石温泉
location: 岩手県 胆沢郡金ヶ崎町
sales_point: 千貫石森林公園に隣接した所に位置する温泉地。恵まれた自然環境を背景に、くつろぐことができる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen has excellent quality hot springs with a pleasant, smooth texture, often noting the water is quite warm, and some areas offer saunas and outdoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, friendly staff, and well-maintained facilities, including clean changing rooms.

Some reviews mention the separate main bath and open-air bath can be inconvenient for some guests.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to Chikkanishi Forest Park, this hot spring area allows you to relax amidst a rich natural environment.

name: 大平山温泉
sales_point: 一関市から栗駒高原へ抜ける国道457号線沿いに位置する温泉地。広大な牧場の中にあり、自然に恵まれた環境。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including open-air baths with stunning views, and features free massage chairs and entertainment. They also highlight the reasonable prices, friendly staff, and long operating hours.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 457 leading from Ichinoseki City to Kurikoma Plateau, this hot spring area is set in a vast ranch, surrounded by nature.

name: 高倉山（花巻南温泉郷）
sales_point: 豊沢川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。湯治向きで自炊客のみ宿泊できる。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn features impressive traditional Japanese architecture and multiple hot springs with a unique, skin-softening water quality. They also highlight the delicious and varied cuisine, including unique dishes like wagyu shabu-shabu with corn soup. Visitors appreciate the attentive staff and the overall relaxing atmosphere, making it a great value.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Toyosawa River, this hot spring area is suitable for therapeutic bathing and only accommodates self-catering guests.

name: 滝の上温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 大松倉岳、三ッ岩山などの山々に囲まれた山深い地に位置する温泉地。紅葉時の「鳥越の滝」は絶景。湯は入るとつるつるする。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located deep in the mountains surrounded by Daisokuradake and Mitsu-iwayama. The 'Torigo Falls' during autumn foliage is a breathtaking sight. The water leaves your skin feeling smooth.

name: 田山温泉
sales_point: 国道282号線沿いに位置する温泉地。目の前には田山スキー場があり、スキー客に好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 282. It is popular among skiers as it is right in front of Tayama Ski Resort.

name: 台（花巻温泉郷）
sales_point: 台川沿いの山間に位置する温泉地。湯量の豊富さは花巻温泉郷随一で、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring village offers excellent quality sulfur hot springs, with many inns providing free-flowing hot spring baths and day-use options. They also highlight the nostalgic atmosphere, describing it as a quiet and charming place to relax.

Some reviews mention there can be a lack of vibrancy.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Dai River. It has the richest hot spring water supply in the Hanamaki Onsenkyo, making it ideal for recuperation and therapy.

name: 繋温泉
sales_point: 盛岡市西部、御所湖畔に位置する温泉地。岩手山など、景観に恵まれている。源義家が愛馬に石を繋いだことから名付けられたと伝えられる。盛岡の奥座敷として人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the shores of Goshoko in the western part of Morioka City. It boasts beautiful scenery, including views of Iwate Mountain.
