It is said to be named after Minamoto no Yoshiie, who tied his horse to a stone here. It is popular as a hidden retreat in Morioka.

name: 藤七（八幡平温泉郷）
sales_point: 八幡平頂上の南、標高1400メートルの高原に位置する温泉地。東北最高地にある一軒宿の秘湯で八幡平温泉郷の一つに数えられる。11月～4月は休業。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a unique open-air bathing experience with multiple pools featuring naturally bubbling, milky-white sulfur spring water and mud. Guests also highlight the delicious buffet-style meals, which include local ingredients and seasonal mountain vegetables. They also appreciate the attentive staff and the option to wear a bathing garment in the mixed-gender outdoor baths.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 1400 meters south of the summit of Hachimantai. It is a secret hot spring at the highest point in Tohoku and is counted among the Hachimantai Onsenkyo. Closed from November to April. Designated as a national health resort, it is suitable for recuperation and therapy.

name: とぴや温泉
sales_point: 安比高原に隣接する高原に位置する温泉地。美肌効果は抜群で効能があると言われている。露天風呂も完備。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a highland adjacent to Appi Kogen. It is said to have excellent skin beautifying effects. Outdoor baths are also available.

name: 永岡温泉
location: 岩手県 胆沢郡金ヶ崎町
sales_point: 栗駒国定公園の北東山麓に位置する温泉地。赤松林に囲まれ、自然環境が良い。隣接してゴルフ場がある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water that is free-flowing, with a pleasant, slightly slippery texture. They also highlight the affordable 600 yen entry fee, the calm atmosphere, and the availability of free rest areas.

Other reviews mention there can be no outdoor bath.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northeastern foothills of Kurikoma National Park. Surrounded by red pine forests, it offers a good natural environment. A golf course is adjacent.

name: 七時雨温泉
sales_point: 西根町北部の七時雨高原を流れる源川流域に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers two types of baths, including a medicinal spring bath with rich minerals, and allows guests to adjust the water temperature. They also highlight the free lockers, complimentary shampoo and body soap, and the quiet atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the water temperature can be too hot.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Nanjiu Plateau, flowing through the source river in the northern part of Nishine Town. It is situated in a quiet environment.

name: 鉛（花巻温泉郷）
sales_point: 豊沢川沿いに位置する山あいの温泉地。立ったまま入れる浴場もあり、独特の雰囲気を持つ。閑静な環境で、眺望が良い。
review_summary: People say this traditional Japanese inn offers a unique and deeply satisfying hot spring experience, especially highlighting the famous deep "Shirasaru no Yu" standing bath and the scenic riverside open-air baths. They also appreciate the delicious meals, often featuring local ingredients, and the attentive, friendly staff. Visitors mention the well-maintained, historic buildings and the overall relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A mountain hot spring area located along the Toyosawa River. It features unique bathing facilities where you can soak while standing. The tranquil environment offers great views.

name: 西根温泉
sales_point: 国道282号線沿いに位置する温泉地。24時間利用可能な大浴場と露天風呂をはじめ、様々な種類の風呂が好評。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality, pure hot spring water, a spacious sauna, and affordable admission, especially with the lunch set.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained and neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 282. It is popular for its large public bath and outdoor bath, which are available 24 hours, along with various types of baths.

name: ぬくもり温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 岩手高原と玄武温泉の中間に位置する温泉地。森に囲まれた静かな環境。休日や研修に利用できる。多目的施設も併設されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located between Iwate Kogen and Genbu Onsen. It is surrounded by forests in a quiet environment, suitable for holidays and training. It also has multipurpose facilities.

name: 東八幡平温泉郷
sales_point: 岩手県北部のスキー・キャンプ等楽しめる一大リゾート地。八幡平温泉郷と呼ばれることもある。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers excellent onsen facilities, including spacious indoor and outdoor baths with distinctive mineral-rich water, and a sauna. They also highlight the delicious and varied food, especially the meat dishes and lunch buffet options. Visitors consistently praise the staff for their warm, attentive, and friendly service, making for a pleasant and relaxing stay.
sales_point_en: A major resort area in northern Iwate Prefecture where you can enjoy skiing and camping. It is sometimes referred to as Hachimantai Onsenkyo.

name: 花巻（花巻温泉郷）
sales_point: 花巻市郊外に位置する温泉地。花巻温泉郷の中心で、バラ園には宮崎賢治設計の日時計花壇がある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this resort offers access to three distinct hot spring baths, including open-air options, and a wide variety of delicious buffet dishes, especially crab. They also highlight the reasonable prices, attentive staff, and the beautiful adjacent rose garden.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the outskirts of Hanamaki City. It is the center of Hanamaki Onsenkyo, featuring a rose garden with a sundial flower bed designed by Kenji Miyazawa.

name: ひめかゆ温泉
sales_point: 石淵ダムの近くにある温泉保養館。8種類の大風呂や、プールが好評。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a unique, slightly yellow, and slippery water quality that leaves skin smooth and warm. Visitors also highlight the clean facilities, reasonable pricing, and availability of JAF discounts.

Other reviews mention the washing area can be limited.
sales_point_en: A hot spring health facility near Ishibuchi Dam. It is popular for its eight large baths and swimming pool.

name: 姫神温泉
sales_point: 西方に岩手山、東方に姫神山を望む国道沿いの畑の中に位置する温泉地。眺望の良い露天風呂が人気。近くに啄木記念館もある。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hot spring facility for its variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options boasting scenic views of Mt. Iwate, as well as its pleasant sauna. They also highlight the delicious food featuring local produce and appreciate the special discounts offered to local residents.

Other reviews mention the layout can be difficult to navigate.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the national road in a field with views of Iwate Mountain to the west and Himekami Mountain to the east. The outdoor bath with a good view is popular. The nearby Takuboku Memorial Museum is also a point of interest.

name: 平泉温泉元湯
location: 岩手県 西磐井郡平泉町
sales_point: 平泉町唯一の温泉地。金色堂のある中尊寺が有名。奥羽藤原氏の歴史を肌で感じることができる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing hot spring experience with a spacious indoor bath and a sauna. Guests also highlight the reasonable entry fee, especially after 7 PM, and the convenient location near local attractions.

Other reviews mention the patrons can be impolite.
sales_point_en: The only hot spring area in Hiraizumi Town. It is famous for Chuson-ji Temple, which houses the Golden Hall. You can experience the history of the Oshu Fujiwara clan.

name: 宝竜温泉
sales_point: 一関市街から最も近い温泉地。栗駒山など高台から360度パノラマで見渡せ、其の雄姿は夕日に映え絶景。今年3月にリニューアルオープン。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious meals, including local specialties like Maesawa beef, and a complimentary evening tantanmen ramen service. They also highlight the welcoming lounge with free alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the areas can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: The closest hot spring area to Ichinoseki City. It offers a 360-degree panoramic view from a high point, with its majestic appearance beautifully illuminated by the sunset. It reopened in March this year after renovations.

name: 松川温泉
sales_point: 松川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。原生林に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。わが国で最初に設置された地熱発電所がある。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring inn offers excellent quality sulfur hot springs with milky white water, and many highlight the impressive volume of food served. They also appreciate the reasonable prices, especially during holiday weekends, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Matsukawa River. It is situated in a quiet environment surrounded by primeval forests. The first geothermal power plant in Japan is located here.

name: 松倉（花巻南温泉郷）
sales_point: 豊沢川沿いに連なる温泉の玄関口にあたる一軒宿。高村記念館の近く。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers comfortable rooms, delicious seasonal cuisine, and a relaxing hot spring with both indoor and outdoor baths. They also highlight the staff's warm hospitality and the excellent value for the price.

Some reviews mention the food can be cold.
sales_point_en: A single inn that serves as the gateway to the hot springs along the Toyosawa River. It is located near the Takamura Memorial Museum.

name: 祭畤温泉
sales_point: 祭畤山の山麓に位置する温泉地。紅葉は絶景スポットとなっている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers delicious Japanese-French cuisine featuring local ingredients, and guests can enjoy a relaxing soak in the soft, skin-smoothing hot springs. They also highlight the attentive and friendly staff, along with the clean, stylish, and comfortable atmosphere. Visitors appreciate the complimentary drinks and baked goods, as well as the option to wear kimonos for dinner.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Matsurihira Mountain. The autumn foliage here is a spectacular sight.

name: 水神温泉
sales_point: 豊かな自然に囲まれた温泉地。すぐ近くに水神スキー場がある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a wide, deep bath with hot, smooth, and bubbly water, and offers shampoo, conditioner, and body soap. They also highlight the affordable 400 yen entry fee and convenient early morning hours.

Other reviews mention it can be crowded with day-use visitors.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area surrounded by rich nature, located near the Suijin Ski Resort.

name: 水沢石田温泉
sales_point: 水沢市の市街地に位置する温泉地。ナトリウムイオンの濃度が濃く、「美人の湯」と言われている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers delicious and varied food, including Washington curry, and features a relaxing hot spring with a smooth water quality, as well as a sauna.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained and the bathing area can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Mizusawa, known for its high sodium ion concentration and referred to as 'beauty hot spring.'

name: 南網張ありね温泉
location: 岩手県 岩手郡雫石町
sales_point: 平成11年2月にオープンした、日帰り施設併設の温泉地。眺望の良い展望風呂はもちろん、ギャラリー、散策コース等もあり、新しい休日を提案してくれる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features excellent quality, milky-white sulfur spring water and offers stunning views from the open-air bath. They also highlight the reasonable admission fees and the availability of a sauna and a spacious, quiet tatami resting area. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and appreciate the long operating hours.
sales_point_en: Opened in February 1999, this hot spring area features day-use facilities, scenic baths, galleries, and walking trails, offering a new way to enjoy your holidays.

name: 南花巻渡り（花巻温泉郷）
sales_point: 志戸平と大沢の中間に位置する温泉地。渓流釣りや様々なタイプの温泉を楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located between Shidodaira and Osawa, where you can enjoy stream fishing and various types of hot springs.

name: 宮田温泉
location: 岩手県 二戸郡一戸町
sales_point: 一戸駅の南西、県道210号線沿いに位置する温泉地。のどかな雰囲気を持ち、静養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located southwest of Ichinoseki Station along Prefectural Road 210, this hot spring area has a tranquil atmosphere, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 薬師堂温泉
sales_point: 水沢市の市街地に位置する温泉地。岩手県下で一番塩分濃度が濃い泉質と言われている。施設には露天風呂も完備されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers a variety of baths, including a spacious outdoor bath, sauna, and electric bath, with many appreciating the quality of the spring water. They also highlight the delicious breakfast and dinner, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the changing rooms can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Mizusawa, known for having the highest salt concentration in Iwate Prefecture, with outdoor baths available.

name: 矢巾温泉
location: 岩手県 紫波郡矢巾町
sales_point: 南昌山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。南昌山神社が近い。南昌山や幣懸の滝などのハイキングの基地に良い。日帰り入浴施設もある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a clear, skin-friendly hot spring that leaves visitors feeling warm and refreshed, and offers delicious meals at its restaurant. They also highlight the spotless facilities, friendly staff, and reasonable prices for day-use and accommodations.

Other reviews mention the washing area can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Situated at the eastern foothills of Mount Nansho, near Nansho Shrine, this hot spring area is a great base for hiking to Mount Nansho and the Chikake Falls, with day-use bathing facilities.

name: 矢びつ温泉
sales_point: 山王山を背に栗駒岳の山麓に位置する温泉地。山王山は昔、慈覚大師が居住したと伝えられている。矢びつダムが近い。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including hot and lukewarm indoor pools, cold springs, and open-air rotenburo with scenic views. They also highlight the reasonable prices, attentive staff, and delicious meals, especially the Maesawa beef.

Other reviews mention the futons can be thin.
sales_point_en: Located at the foothills of Mount Kurikoma, backed by Mount Sanno, which is said to have been home to the monk Jikaku Daishi. Close to Yabitsu Dam.

name: 山の神（花巻南温泉郷）
sales_point: 大沢温泉から約1キロ上流へさかのぼった豊沢川畔にある温泉地。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn features impressive traditional Japanese architecture and multiple hot springs with a unique, skin-softening water quality. They also highlight the delicious and varied cuisine, including unique dishes like wagyu shabu-shabu with corn soup. Visitors appreciate the attentive staff and the overall relaxing atmosphere, making it a great value.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Toyosawa River, about 1 kilometer upstream from Osawa Onsen.

name: 湯川（湯田温泉郷）
location: 岩手県 和賀郡西和賀町
sales_point: 和賀川の支流、湯川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。湯田温泉郷の中心のひとつに数えられ、古くからの湯治場として知られている。自然環境が良く、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen, located within a train station, offers three indoor baths with varying temperatures and provides complimentary shampoo and body soap. They also highlight the affordable 440 yen entrance fee and the free, spacious resting area on the second floor.

Some reviews mention the hottest bath can be too warm.
sales_point_en: Located along the valley of the Yukawa River, this hot spring area is one of the centers of Yuda Onsenkyo, known as a traditional hot spring resort with a good natural environment, ideal for recuperation.

name: 湯田薬師（湯田温泉郷）
location: 岩手県 和賀郡西和賀町
sales_point: 自然林に囲まれた静寂境の中に位置する温泉地。近くを流れる和賀川は釣り人で賑わう。湯田温泉郷のひとつ。
review_summary:
People say this onsen, located within a train station, offers three indoor baths with varying temperatures and provides complimentary shampoo and body soap. They also highlight the affordable 440 yen entrance fee and the free, spacious resting area on the second floor.

Some reviews mention the hottest bath can be too warm.
sales_point_en: Nestled in a tranquil setting surrounded by natural forests, this hot spring area is popular among anglers due to the nearby Yukagawa River.

name: 須川温泉
location: 岩手県／秋田県 一関市／雄勝郡東鳴瀬村
sales_point: 栗駒山の北側山腹、標高1125メートルに位置する温泉地。岩手・秋田両県にまたがり、雄大な眺望を誇る。硫化水素を含んだ強酸性の泉質が特徴で、古くは酢川と記された。湯量が豊富で千人風呂や天然蒸し風呂などもある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features excellent quality, strongly acidic sulfur spring water that leaves skin smooth and warm, with large indoor and outdoor baths. They also highlight the stunning mountain views from the outdoor baths and the delicious, hearty meals. Guests mention the staff are kind and helpful, and the facilities are spotless and well-maintained.
city_ja: 一関市／雄勝郡東鳴瀬村
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 1,125 meters on the northern slope of Mount Kurikoma, this hot spring area spans Iwate and Akita Prefectures, boasting magnificent views and featuring strong acidic waters rich in hydrogen sulfide.

name: 相川温泉
sales_point: 一戸川を望む高台に位置する温泉地。飯豊連峰を眺望でき、眺望が良い。そばや釣りが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Perched on a hill overlooking the Ichinokawa River, this hot spring area offers great views of the Iide Mountain Range and opportunities for soba and fishing.

name: 会津湯野上温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡下郷町
sales_point: 県立自然公園大川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。深い浸食を受けた河原には混浴の露天風呂がある。清流に臨む山々の緑が素晴らしく、自然に恵まれている。近くには奇勝「塔のへつり」がある。
sales_point_en: Located along the Ozeki Valley in a prefectural natural park, this hot spring area features a mixed-gender outdoor bath on a riverbank with stunning views of the surrounding mountains.

name: 赤湯温泉
sales_point: 鬼面山の北西側山麓に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、保養・療養に好適。冬期は休業している。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers two distinct types of hot springs, a clear, iron-rich red bath and a milky, sulfurous white bath, both with fresh, free-flowing spring water. Guests also highlight the delicious, handmade meals and the clean, renovated rooms. They also appreciate the reasonable day-trip bathing fee and the comfortable amenities like air conditioning and Wi-Fi.
sales_point_en: Situated on the northwest foothills of Onimen Mountain, this hot spring area is blessed with a good natural environment, ideal for recuperation, and is closed during winter.

name: 芦ノ牧温泉
location: 福島県 会津若松市
sales_point: 大川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。会津若松の南玄関口で歴史が永い。県立公園大川の中心地で、景観が良い。会津地方の観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the Ozeki Valley, this hot spring area serves as the southern gateway to Aizuwakamatsu and has a long history, being the center of the prefectural park with beautiful scenery.

name: 小豆温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡南会津町
sales_point: 会津駒ヶ岳の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。山峡の閑静な環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。二重滝、鱒滝などの見所が近く、高畑スキー場も近い。
sales_point_en: Located on the northeastern foothills of Mount Aizu Komagatake, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain valley, ideal for relaxation and recuperation, with nearby attractions like the Futatsu Falls and Masu Falls.

name: 安達太良温泉
location: 福島県 安達郡大玉村
sales_point: 安達太良山南東側山麓に位置位置する温泉地。「ふくしま県民の森」の中にあり、自然環境に恵まれている。
sales_point_en: Situated on the southeastern foothills of Mount Adatara, this hot spring area is located within the 'Fukushima Prefectural Forest' and is blessed with a good natural environment.

name: 熱塩温泉
sales_point: 阿賀野川の支流、押切川上流沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で、古くから子宝の湯として親しまれている。名の通り、湯は熱く塩分が強い。
sales_point_en: Located along the upstream of the Oshikiri River, a tributary of the Agano River, this hot spring area has a quiet environment and has long been cherished as a hot spring for fertility, known for its hot and salty waters.

name: 飯坂温泉
sales_point: 県都福島市の西部に位置する温泉地。2000年前の発見と伝えられ、松尾芭蕉も立ち寄った歴史を持つ。古くは「鯖子の湯」と呼ばれていた。阿武隈川の支流、摺上川に沿って80軒にも及ぶ宿が建ち並ぶ。温泉情緒豊かな県下一の観光温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located in the western part of Fukushima City, this hot spring area is said to have been discovered 2,000 years ago and has a historical connection with Matsuo Basho. Once known as 'Sabako no Yu,' it features around 80 inns along the Surugami River, making it the most famous hot spring resort in the prefecture.

name: 飯豊温泉
sales_point: 一ノ戸川上流の川入民宿地の中に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。飯豊山登山だけでなく、山菜採り、渓流釣りにも好評。
sales_point_en: A secluded onsen located in the river inn area upstream of the Ichinotogawa River. Popular for not only climbing Mount Iide but also for wild vegetable picking and stream fishing.

name: 一ノ木温泉
sales_point: 一ノ戸川沿いの木立の中に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、お湯が自慢の一軒宿。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring inn offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths with natural spring water, leaving skin smooth. They also highlight the affordable entry fees, quiet atmosphere, and comfortable rest areas with complimentary tea.

Some reviews mention the location can be far.
sales_point_en: An onsen situated among trees along the Ichinotogawa River. It boasts a quiet environment and is known for its excellent hot springs.

name: 猪苗代（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 川桁山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。豪華なホテルの中にプールやジャグジーの設備があり、ハーブガーデンやスキー場などの施設もある。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen hotel features spacious rooms, each with a large private open-air bath, and offers delicious in-room dining for both breakfast and dinner. They also highlight the attentive and kind staff, who provide excellent hospitality. Visitors appreciate the quiet atmosphere, allowing for a truly relaxing and private stay.
sales_point_en: Located at the western foot of Mount Kawageta, this onsen features luxurious hotels with pools and jacuzzis, as well as facilities like herb gardens and ski resorts.

name: 岩井戸鉱泉
location: 福島県 双葉郡富岡町
sales_point: 阿武隈山地の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、静養・療養に好適。神経痛・リウマチなどに特効のある冷泉。
sales_point_en: An onsen located on the eastern foothills of the Abukuma Mountains. It offers a tranquil environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation, with a cold spring known for its effectiveness against neuralgia and rheumatism.

name: いわき蟹洗温泉
sales_point: 太平洋を展望する環境にある温泉地。天然温泉と海水を使ったバラエティー豊かなお風呂が整備されている。
sales_point_en: An onsen with a view of the Pacific Ocean, featuring a variety of baths utilizing natural hot spring water and seawater.

name: いわき藤間温泉
sales_point: 松の緑に囲まれたビーチサイドに位置する温泉地。豊富な湯量を誇る。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers stunning ocean views from all rooms and a wide variety of buffet options, including all-you-can-eat crab and salmon roe. They also highlight the excellent value, complimentary drinks in the lounge and room, and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the food offerings can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Located by the beach surrounded by pine trees, this onsen boasts a rich supply of hot spring water.

name: いわき湯本温泉
spa_quality: 含硫黄－ナトリウム－塩化物・硫酸塩泉(低張性弱アルカリ性高温泉)
sales_point: いわき湯本温泉は「三箱の御湯」とも呼ばれ、道後温泉、有馬温泉と並ぶ日本の三古泉のひとつ（927年の延喜式神名帳に記載）。源泉は、地区内の地下約50メートルから汲み上げた毎分5.5トンの湧出量を誇る摂氏58度の天然温泉で、完全放流式で町内の地下を通して各施設に配湯している。正式な泉質名は、【含硫黄－ナトリウム－塩化物・硫酸塩温泉】で、「美人の湯」（美肌作用・解毒作用・末梢血管拡張作用）、「心臓の湯」（血圧を低下させる～動脈硬化、高血圧に効く）、「熱の湯」（高齢者向き～保温効果が高い）を始め数々の効能を併せ持つ。
spa_quality_en: 含硫黄－ナトリウム－塩化物・硫酸塩泉(低張性弱アルカリ性高温泉)
sales_point_en: Known as 'Mihako no Yu', this onsen is one of Japan's three ancient springs alongside Dogo Onsen and Arima Onsen (mentioned in the Engi Shiki in 927). The source is a natural hot spring at 58 degrees Celsius, with a flow rate of 5.5 tons per minute, distributed to various facilities through underground pipes. It has multiple health benefits, including beauty effects, heart health, and warmth retention.

name: 岩瀬温泉
sales_point: ゴルフ＆リゾート施設。クラブハウス、ホテル、天然温泉ＳＰＡ施設（屋外、屋内、プール含む）、トレーニングジムスタジオを設置。常時トレーニング可能。
sales_point_en: A golf and resort facility featuring a clubhouse, hotel, natural hot spring spa (including outdoor and indoor baths and a pool), and a training gym studio, available for training at all times.

name: 岩瀬湯本温泉
location: 福島県 岩瀬郡天栄村
sales_point: 二俣川と鶴沼川の合流点付近に位置する温泉地。ブナの原生林に囲まれ、自然環境が良い。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located near the confluence of Futamata River and Tsurunuma River, this onsen is surrounded by beech forests, providing a great natural environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 裏磐梯温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡北塩原村
sales_point: 磐梯山北側山麓、裏磐梯高原に位置する温泉地。自然豊かで周辺には大小さまざまな沼や、キャンプ場もある。
sales_point_en: Situated on the northern foothills of Mount Bandai, in the Ura Bandai highlands, this onsen is rich in nature, with various ponds and campgrounds nearby.

name: 大塩温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡金山町
sales_point: 弘法大師が発見したと伝えられる温泉地。古くから、美人の湯として親しまれてきた。かつては温泉水で製塩をしたことがあるという。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers a unique, warm, reddish-brown carbonated and iron-rich water that promotes long, relaxing soaks. Visitors also highlight the reasonable 400 yen entry fee and the clean, well-maintained facilities, including free lockers. Guests mention the scenic outdoor bath overlooking the Tadami River and the friendly, welcoming staff.
sales_point_en: An onsen believed to have been discovered by Kobo Daishi. It has long been cherished as a beauty hot spring and was once used for salt production.

name: 大塩裏磐梯温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡北塩原村
sales_point: 大塩川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。裏磐梯高原の山峡にあり、自然環境に恵まれている。磐梯観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the clear stream of the Oshio River, this onsen is nestled in the mountain gorge of Ura Bandai highlands, blessed with a rich natural environment, making it a great base for Bandai sightseeing.

name: 大玉温泉
location: 福島県 安達郡大玉村
sales_point: 安達太良連峰の麓に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: An onsen located at the foot of the Adatara Mountain Range.

name: 翁島（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 大正初期に開湯された一軒宿の温泉地。静かな環境にあり、冬はスキー、夏は観光の拠点として好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing hot spring experience with a comfortable water temperature, and provides body soap and rinse-in shampoo. Guests also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, and the clean, tatami-floored changing rooms.

Other reviews mention the indoor bath can be small.
sales_point_en: An onsen established in the early Taisho era, it offers a quiet environment and serves as a great base for skiing in winter and sightseeing in summer.

name: 尾瀬檜枝岐温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡檜枝岐村
sales_point: 尾瀬沼の福島側登山口に位置する温泉地。平家の落人伝説が残された山里にあり、尾瀬探勝のの基地に好適。ソバ粉100％で打つ「裁ちそば」が名物。
review_summary: People say this inn offers delicious local "sanjin ryori" cuisine, including hearty soba noodles and grilled iwana fish, and features two types of natural hot spring baths. They also highlight the warm and attentive staff, who provide excellent hospitality. Guests mention the clean and well-maintained facilities, including spotless rooms and convenient laundry machines.
sales_point_en: Located at the Fukushima side trailhead of Oze Marsh, this onsen is in a mountain village with legends of the Heike clan's fugitives, making it a great base for exploring Oze. The specialty is 'Tachi Soba', made from 100% buckwheat flour.

name: 押立（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 磐梯山の西南側山麓に位置する温泉地。標高620メートル近くの高原にあり、眼下に猪苗代湖を一望でき眺望が良い。素朴な環境の中でくつろぐことができる。
sales_point_en: An onsen located on the southwestern foothills of Mount Bandai, at an elevation of nearly 620 meters, offering a panoramic view of Lake Inawashiro below, providing a relaxing environment.

name: 小名浜スプリングス温泉
sales_point: ゴルフ場に併設された温泉地。太平洋を望みながらプレーできる環境にある。リゾートホテル。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms with stunning ocean views and a wide variety of delicious buffet options for dinner and breakfast, including fresh seafood and local dishes. They also highlight the excellent value, attentive staff, and well-maintained hot springs with ocean-view open-air baths.

Some reviews mention the golf course can be crowded.
sales_point_en: An onsen adjacent to a golf course, providing a setting where you can play while enjoying views of the Pacific Ocean. It features a resort hotel.

name: 表磐梯（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 磐梯山の西南側山麓に位置する温泉地。眼下に猪苗代湖を一望でき、眺望が良い。スキー場が併設されている。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen hotel features spacious rooms, each with a large private open-air bath, and offers delicious in-room dining for both breakfast and dinner. They also highlight the attentive and kind staff, who provide excellent hospitality. Visitors appreciate the quiet atmosphere, allowing for a truly relaxing and private stay.
sales_point_en: An onsen located on the southwestern foothills of Mount Bandai, offering a great view of Lake Inawashiro below and featuring a ski resort.

name: 折木鉱泉
location: 福島県 双葉郡広野町
sales_point: 宝永元年（1704年）の開湯と伝えられ、湯治場として親しまれ特に神経系の病気に特効があると言われる。近くには紅葉の見事な五社山があり、心やすらぐ閑静な環境。
sales_point_en: Believed to have been opened in the first year of the Hoei era (1704), this onsen is cherished as a healing place, particularly effective for neurological diseases. Nearby is the beautiful Momiji Mountain, providing a tranquil environment.

name: 鏡石温泉
location: 福島県 岩瀬郡鏡石町
sales_point: 国道4号線沿いに位置する温泉地。鏡石駅から近く福島中通り地方の観光拠点に好適。のどかな環境にあり、休養や保養にも適している。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a golden, high-alkaline carbonated spring that leaves skin smooth and allows for long, relaxing soaks. They also highlight the reasonable price and the option for overnight stays.

Some reviews mention the carbonated spring claim can be misleading.
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 4, this onsen is close to Kagamiishi Station, making it a great base for sightseeing in the Fukushima Nakadori region. It offers a peaceful environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 甲子温泉
location: 福島県 西白河郡西郷村
sales_point: 阿武隈川の上流沿いに位置する温泉地。温泉の歴史は永く、600年程前甲子（きのえね）の年に発見されたと伝えられる。自然環境に恵まれた秘湯。猿ヶ鼻の探勝や甲子山・旭岳の登山にも好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn features a famous mixed-gender "Giant Rock Bath" that is spacious, deep, and has a high ceiling, offering a unique, open-air feel. They also highlight the delicious, locally sourced meals, including river fish and seasonal vegetables, and the reasonable prices for a high-quality stay. Guests mention the staff are attentive and polite, and the overall atmosphere is clean and relaxing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the upper reaches of the Abukuma River. The history of the hot spring is long, believed to have been discovered about 600 years ago in the year of the Metal Rat. A hidden hot spring blessed with a rich natural environment, ideal for exploring Sarugahana and climbing Mount Koshi and Asahi.

name: 神白温泉
sales_point: 浴用・飲用として、昔から「胃腸の名湯」として知られる温泉地。サツキを中心とした庭園アヤメ園が見事。
review_summary: People say this inn offers delicious and plentiful meals, with highlights including fresh sashimi, large abalone, and excellent simmered red snapper. Guests also mention the high-quality, free-flowing hot spring water, which leaves skin feeling smooth. They also like the clean, stylish facilities and the friendly, approachable staff.
sales_point_en: Known since ancient times as a 'famous hot spring for gastrointestinal health,' this hot spring area features a stunning garden centered around azaleas.

name: 片海温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡南会津町
sales_point: 鹿水川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。宮床湿原の探勝に好適。冬季はスキー場が近い。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a comfortable water temperature, showers, and a spacious resting area. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, along with the convenient 300-yen pass for access to four different onsen. Visitors appreciate the excellent water quality, noting it leaves their skin feeling smooth.
sales_point_en: Located along the stream of the Kamimizu River, this hot spring area is ideal for exploring the Miyadoko Wetlands. It is also close to ski resorts in winter.

name: 要田温泉
sales_point: 磐越東線線路沿いに位置する温泉地。源泉のある場所だけ雪が積もらなかったことから10年程前に発見された。黄金色がかった湯は効能が高く、体が温まることで知られている。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Ban'etsu East Line, this hot spring was discovered about 10 years ago when it was noted that only the source area was free of snow. The golden-hued water is known for its high efficacy and warming properties.

name: 蒲庭温泉
sales_point: 蒲庭海岸の近くの小高い丘に位置する温泉地。太平洋の眺望が良く、静かな環境にある。文豪徳富蘇峰が湯治をしたと伝えられる。
sales_point_en: Located on a small hill near Kaminoya Beach, this hot spring offers a great view of the Pacific Ocean in a tranquil environment. It is said that the literary figure Tokutomi Sohō visited for healing.

name: 川上温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 磐梯山の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。周辺は静かな高原で、自然環境が良い。磐梯山への登山口もある。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn features unique, spacious baths, including a large cave bath and a pool-sized main bath with deep sections. Guests also appreciate the delicious, healthy meals and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Some reviews mention the bath floors can be slippery.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located at the northeastern foot of Mount Bandai, surrounded by a quiet highland with a good natural environment. It also serves as a trailhead for climbing Mount Bandai.

name: 河東温泉
location: 福島県 会津若松市
sales_point: 会津河東カントリークラブにある温泉で、プレーのあとのひとときを心安らぐ磐梯山の雄姿を見ながら楽しめる。ゴルフ客専用となっており、一般開放なし。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers clean, spacious rooms with great views of the city and mountains, along with expansive open-air baths. They also highlight the delicious and varied buffet, featuring local Aizu dishes, fresh sushi, and excellent desserts like soft-serve ice cream and pudding. Guests mention the staff are consistently friendly, helpful, and provide warm hospitality.
sales_point_en: Located within the Aizu Kawauchi Country Club, this hot spring allows guests to relax while enjoying views of the majestic Mount Bandai after a round of golf. It is exclusive to golf guests and not open to the general public.

name: 喜多方温泉
sales_point: 大仏山南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。数寄屋づくりの館内は総漆塗り。喜多方観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths with comfortable water temperatures, and a wide variety of food options. Guests also mention the affordable entry fees, especially after 5 PM, and the clean, well-maintained restrooms.

Other reviews mention that impolite regulars can negatively affect the atmosphere.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located at the southwestern foot of Mount Daibutsu. The interior features a sukiya-style building with all lacquered finishes, making it a great base for sightseeing in Kitakata.

name: 県民の森温泉
location: 福島県 安達郡大玉村
sales_point: 安達太良山の南東に位置する「ふくしま県民の森」内に所在する温泉地。オートキャンプ場「フォレストパークあだたら」は平成10年のオープン。700ヘクタールの広大な森の中にあるビジターセンター内に入浴施設があり、日帰りでも楽しめる。宿泊施設は、コテージ20棟のほか、キャンピングトレーラー10台が常設されている。四季折々の自然実感できる快適空間。
review_summary: People say this campground offers well-maintained facilities, including clean restrooms and a variety of camping options like individual sites with power and wooden furniture. They also highlight the excellent on-site hot spring, noting its smooth, alkaline water that leaves skin feeling soft. Guests appreciate the availability of camping gear rentals and food items for purchase, making it convenient for those without their own equipment.
sales_point_en: Located within 'Fukushima Kenmin no Mori' southeast of Mount Adatara, this hot spring area features a visitor center with bathing facilities, open since 1998. It is set in a vast 700-hectare forest, offering a comfortable space to enjoy nature throughout the seasons.

name: 月光温泉
sales_point: 郡山駅の南方、住宅街の中に位置する温泉地。国道4号線沿いで車の便がよい。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of spacious baths, including indoor and open-air options, with a unique "torotoro" (slimy) alkaline spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the delicious and plentiful meals, especially the breakfast, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: Situated south of Koriyama Station in a residential area, this hot spring is conveniently located along National Route 4, making it easily accessible by car.

name: 源田温泉
sales_point: 三森峠の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。｢子授けの湯｣とも言われている。
sales_point_en: Located on the northern foot of Mimori Pass, this hot spring is in a quiet environment, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy. It is also known as the 'Childbearing Hot Spring.'

name: 高野温泉
sales_point: 300年の歴史があると伝えられる温泉地。合掌造りの宿と、歌人高萩尊風で知られる宿がある。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is said to have a history of 300 years. It features a gassho-style inn and a lodging known for the poet Takahagi Sonpu.

name: こおり温泉
location: 福島県 伊達郡桑折町
sales_point: 産ヶ沢川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。福島観光、歴史散策、自然探勝の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located along the clear stream of the Sanagasawa River, this hot spring area is a great base for sightseeing in Fukushima, historical exploration, and nature appreciation.

name: 郡山温泉
sales_point: 郡山駅の西方約8.5キロの市街地に位置する温泉地。県道6号線経由で猪苗代湖の舟津浜へ出ることができる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a good quality hot spring, with a variety of baths including indoor, open-air, and sleeping baths, plus a sauna. They also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and convenient payment options.

Other reviews mention the atmosphere can be noisy due to other guests.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located about 8.5 kilometers west of Koriyama Station in the city center. It provides access to Funatsu Beach on Lake Inawashiro via Prefectural Route 6.

name: 小町温泉
location: 福島県 田村郡小野町
sales_point: 小野新町駅の南東に位置する温泉地。小野小町生誕の地と伝えられることから名付けられた温泉地。「美人の湯」と言われる。
sales_point_en: Located southeast of Ono Shinmachi Station, this hot spring is named after the birthplace of Ono no Komachi. It is known as the 'Beauty Hot Spring.'

name: 斎藤温泉
location: 福島県 田村郡三春町
sales_point: 阿武隈山系の山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、静養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the mountains of the Abukuma Mountain Range, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: さかい温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡南会津町
sales_point: 伊南川の渓流を見おろす高台に位置する温泉地。夏季は宮床湿原の探勝、冬季はスキーが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Perched on a high point overlooking the Inan River, this hot spring area is ideal for exploring the Miyadoko Wetlands in summer and skiing in winter.

name: 塩沢温泉
sales_point: 安達太良山麓の鉄山の東側に位置する温泉地。夏は涼しく、冬はスキーが楽しめる。名所の湯川渓谷、三階滝が近い。
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern side of Tetsuzan at the foot of Mount Adatara, this hot spring is cool in summer and offers skiing in winter. It is close to the scenic Yudagawa Gorge and the Sanbaku Falls.

name: 信夫温泉
sales_point: 須川沿いに位置する温泉地。吊り橋を渡った山峡にあり、閑静な環境。保養・休養に好適。「若返りの湯」とも言われる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Sugawa River, this hot spring is located in a quiet mountain valley accessed by crossing a suspension bridge. It is ideal for recuperation and relaxation, also known as the 'Rejuvenating Hot Spring.'

name: 志保の湯温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡塙町
sales_point: 阿武隈山地の山あい、標高500メートルに位置する温泉地。付近は原生林に囲まれており、眺望が良く、閑静な環境にある。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 500 meters in the mountains of the Abukuma Range, this hot spring area is surrounded by primeval forests, offering great views and a tranquil environment, making it suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 渋沢温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡桧枝岐村
sales_point: 燧ヶ岳の北側山麓のぶな林に囲まれた山間の静かな温泉地。徒歩でないと行けないので注意。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a simple sulfur hot spring with a subtle "boiled egg" aroma, and highlight the clean facilities, including spacious indoor and outdoor baths. They also appreciate the hot spring's skin-softening qualities and the beautiful mountain views from the open-air bath. Guests mention the convenient early morning opening hours and the availability of returnable 100-yen lockers for shoes and valuables.
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area surrounded by beech forests at the foot of Mount Hiuchigatake. Note that it can only be accessed on foot.

name: 清水平温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡磐梯町
sales_point: 磐梯ゴールドラインの磐梯町側のゲート周辺に位置する温泉地。霊峰磐梯山と猪苗代湖、那須連山などの眺望が良い。
review_summary:
People say this resort offers delicious buffet meals, including grilled steak, soba, Kitakata ramen, and wappa meshi, along with a wide variety of engaging activities. They also highlight the staff's warm, attentive, and professional service.

Some reviews mention the buffet can be repetitive.
sales_point_en: Located near the gate on the Bandai Town side of the Bandai Gold Line, this hot spring offers great views of the sacred Mount Bandai, Lake Inawashiro, and the Nasu mountain range.

name: 昭和温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡昭和村
sales_point: 本州唯一、最後のからむしの生涯地｢からむし織りの里｣で知られる昭和村に位置する温泉地。黒鉱を掘っているうちに湧きだした温泉である。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious and plentiful meals, with many highlighting the quality of the white rice and seasonal dishes. They also appreciate the comfortable, quiet atmosphere, the hot spring baths with fresh, free-flowing water, and the attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the indoor bath can be too hot.
sales_point_en: Located in Showa Village, known as the only place in Honshu where the last of the karamushi (a type of plant) is cultivated. This hot spring emerged while digging for black ore.

name: 白岩温泉
sales_point: 昔から「不思議な湧き水」として知られている温泉地。穏やかな気分になれる静かないで湯。
sales_point_en: Known as a 'mysterious spring' since ancient times, this hot spring offers a tranquil atmosphere for relaxation.

name: しらさわ温泉
sales_point: 白沢村の中央部北寄りに位置する温泉地。のどかな田園地帯の中にあり、保養・休養に好適。安達太良連峰の眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Shirakawa Village, this hot spring is set in a peaceful rural area, ideal for recuperation and relaxation, with great views of the Adatara mountain range.

name: 白鳥温泉
sales_point: いわき湯本温泉の南方、少し山手に入った丘陵地に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。近くに「馬の温泉」（中央競馬会温泉療養所）がある。
sales_point_en: Situated in a hilly area south of Iwaki Yumoto Onsen, this hot spring is in a quiet environment, perfect for recuperation and therapy. Nearby is the 'Horse Onsen' (Central Horse Racing Association Hot Spring Resort).

name: 白米温泉
sales_point: 古くから「鶴の湯」と呼ばれている温泉地。打ち身や消化器系の病気にも効き、全国から湯治客が来る。
sales_point_en: Known as 'Tsuru no Yu' (Crane's Bath) for a long time, this hot spring is effective for bruises and digestive disorders, attracting visitors from all over the country.

name: 新おおたま温泉
location: 福島県 安達郡大玉村
sales_point: 安達太良と大玉との中間に位置する温泉地。村営の宿泊施設となっている。
sales_point_en: Located between Adatara and Otama, this hot spring features village-operated accommodation facilities.

name: 新甲子温泉
location: 福島県 西白河郡西郷村
sales_point: 甲子山の麓に位置する温泉地。甲子温泉の豊富な温泉を引湯している。那須観光にも便利。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Mount Kōshi, this hot spring draws abundant water from Kōshi Onsen. It is convenient for sightseeing in Nasu and is a national health resort.

name: 新野地温泉
sales_point: 土湯峠からやや東に下がった所に位置する秘湯。新緑や紅葉の時期は特に美しい。自然環境に恵まれている。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent milky, free-flowing sulfur hot springs, including indoor and outdoor baths, with some bath areas recently renovated. They also highlight the delicious and abundant dinner, often featuring local specialties like horse sashimi. Visitors appreciate the clean and comfortable rooms, despite the building's age, and the friendly staff.
sales_point_en: A hidden hot spring located slightly east of the Tsuchiyu Pass, particularly beautiful during the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons, blessed with a natural environment.

name: 新舞子温泉
sales_point: 太平洋を一望できる景観の良い温泉地。展望風呂やウォータースライダー等の各種プールのある施設。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel for its spacious rooms, delicious meals featuring fresh seafood, and large public baths that boast ocean views. Furthermore, reviewers highlight the reasonable prices and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A scenic hot spring with a panoramic view of the Pacific Ocean, featuring facilities such as an observation bath and various pools with water slides.

name: 新湯岐温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡塙町
sales_point: 湯岐温泉の南東0.5キロ地点の山あいに位置する温泉地。湯量は豊富。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent hot spring water, with many highlighting the unique foot-filling rock bath and its smooth, skin-softening qualities. They also appreciate the delicious meals, especially the breakfast, and the wide selection of Japanese sake. Visitors like the friendly staff and the relaxing, quiet atmosphere, noting the convenient free coffee and the option of free lunch for consecutive stays.
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains 0.5 kilometers southeast of Yugi Onsen, this hot spring has abundant water supply.

name: 須賀川温泉
sales_point: 風光明媚で、広大な自然森林に包まれている。日帰り入浴も可。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a wide variety of saunas, including barrel saunas, and features a range of baths with smooth, skin-softening water. They also highlight the delicious and reasonably priced food, the extensive manga collection, and the convenient early morning opening hours.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unprofessional.
sales_point_en: Surrounded by picturesque scenery and vast natural forests, this hot spring also offers day-use bathing.

name: 洲走温泉
location: 福島県 河沼郡会津坂下町
sales_point: 飯豊連峰や磐梯山の眺望がよい温泉地。春から秋にかけて、山菜取りや川前でのヘラ鮒釣りが楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a strong alkaline, smooth, and warm water that leaves skin feeling soft, and the showers also use the same spring water. They also highlight the reasonable 500 yen entry fee and the friendly management.

Some reviews mention the women's bathroom can be cool.
sales_point_en: This hot spring offers great views of the Iide mountain range and Mount Bandai. Enjoy mountain vegetable picking and fishing for carp in the river from spring to autumn.

name: 銅谷温泉
sales_point: 化膿症や毒消しに特効があるところから「まむしの湯」とも呼ばれる。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers excellent hot springs with smooth, skin-softening water and a variety of baths, including a rooftop open-air bath. Guests also highlight the delicious and abundant breakfast buffet, the convenient location near a station and convenience store, and the kind, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the baths can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Known as 'Mamushi no Yu' (Viper's Bath) due to its effectiveness against infections and detoxification.

name: 芹沢温泉
sales_point: 山並みに囲まれた温泉は、湯量も豊富。閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: This hot spring, surrounded by mountains, has abundant water supply and is located in a quiet environment.

name: 相馬松川浦温泉
sales_point: 松川浦のほとり、小高い丘の上に位置する温泉地。松川浦を一望でき、眺望が良い。名所長州の磯も近い。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious local cuisine, including A5-grade Soma beef and fugu dishes, with many enjoying the scenic views of Matsukawaura from their rooms and the open-air baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices for day-use hot springs and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Located on a small hill by Matsukawaura, this hot spring offers a panoramic view of the bay and is close to the famous Choshu coast.

name: たかつえ温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡南会津町
sales_point: 七ヶ岳の南西側山麓に広がる会津高原たかつえスキー場の中に位置する温泉地。冬季のスキーはもちろん、森林浴など通年楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Situated within the Aizu Takatsue Ski Resort, located on the southwestern foothills of the Nanukayama mountains, this hot spring can be enjoyed year-round with skiing in winter and forest bathing.

name: 高湯温泉
sales_point: 吾妻山の東裾に位置する温泉地。源泉の数が多く、湯量がとても豊富。山々を見ながら露天風呂を満喫できる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located at the eastern foot of Mount Azuma, this hot spring has many sources and an abundant water supply, allowing guests to enjoy outdoor baths while viewing the mountains. It is a national health resort.

name: 滝沢温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡金山町
sales_point: 滝ダムの入口に位置する温泉地。山々に囲まれ自然環境が良い。保養・休養に好適。森林浴や登山が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located at the entrance of Taki Dam, this hot spring is surrounded by mountains and offers a great natural environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation, with opportunities for forest bathing and hiking.

name: 滝の沢温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡矢祭町
sales_point: 矢祭山の北東、八溝山の山麓に位置する温泉地。久慈川河畔に近く閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located to the northeast of Yamatsuriyama, at the foot of the Yatsumizuyama, near the banks of the Kuji River in a quiet environment.

name: 滝ノ原温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡南会津町
sales_point: 荒海川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にある。七ヶ岳登山の基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Arakawa River in a tranquil mountain setting, ideal as a base for climbing the Nanagatake.

name: 棚倉温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡棚倉町
sales_point: 現代人の健康の為に科学的に開発された各種の入浴プログラムが利用できる。乗馬やテニスなども楽しめる総合スポーツリゾート温泉地。
sales_point_en: A comprehensive sports resort hot spring area with various scientifically developed bathing programs for modern health, offering activities like horseback riding and tennis.

name: 玉梨温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡金山町
sales_point: 野尻川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。八町温泉が野尻川を挟んで川向かいにある。閑静な環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。フェアリーランド金山スキー場が近い。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers rare natural carbonated hot springs, including private baths, and delicious, abundant local cuisine like horse sashimi and peach tempura. They also highlight the friendly, family-run atmosphere and good value.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nojiri River gorge, opposite the Hachicho Onsen. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for relaxation and recuperation, and close to the Fairyland Kaneyama Ski Resort.

name: 玉の湯温泉
location: 福島県 双葉郡大熊町
sales_point: 国道288号線沿い、日隠山北側山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。周辺はナメコ・フルーツの産地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 288, at the foot of Mount Higakuzan. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and therapy, with the surrounding area known for its nameko mushrooms and fruits.

name: 玉山温泉
sales_point: 250年ほど昔、平藩主の奥方の夢のお告げで発見されたと伝えられる温泉地。飲んで胃腸病に効く。あたりは松茸の産地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area believed to have been discovered about 250 years ago due to a dream of the wife of the lord of the Hirai clan. It is known for its effectiveness in treating gastrointestinal diseases, and the area is famous for its matsutake mushrooms.

name: 岳温泉
sales_point: 安達太良山の東側山麓、標高600メートルの高原に位置する温泉地。国民保養温泉地に指定され、自然環境が良い。スキー場などのスポーツ施設も充実している。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 600 meters on the eastern foothills of Mount Adatara. It is designated as a national health resort with a good natural environment and well-equipped sports facilities, including ski resorts.

name: 津尻温泉
location: 福島県 河沼郡会津坂下町
sales_point: 飯豊連峰や磐梯山の眺望がよい温泉地。春から秋にかけて、山菜取りや川前でのヘラ鮒釣りが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with great views of the Iide Mountains and Mount Bandai. From spring to autumn, visitors can enjoy mountain vegetable picking and fishing for carp in the nearby river.

name: 土湯温泉
sales_point: 吾妻小富士の東南側山麓に位置する温泉地。荒川の渓谷沿いにあり、山あいの静かな環境。平安時代の開湯と伝えられ、歴史が永い。土湯こけしの産地としても有名。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring resort offers a variety of hot springs, including free foot baths, and is known for its traditional Kokeshi dolls. They also highlight the peaceful, quiet atmosphere and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the area can be small with few sights.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southeastern foothills of Mount Azuma Kompira. It is situated along the Arakawa gorge in a quiet mountain environment, with a long history dating back to the Heian period. It is also famous for its Doi Kokeshi dolls and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 天栄温泉
location: 福島県 岩瀬郡天栄村
sales_point: 羽鳥湖へ向かう鳳坂峠の登り口に位置する温泉地。渓谷沿いの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。バラ風呂を楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the entrance of the Hōzaka Pass leading to Lake Hatori. It is in a quiet environment along the gorge, suitable for recuperation and relaxation, and offers a rose bath experience.

name: 天鏡台（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 磐梯山の南側山麓に位置する新しい温泉地。静かな林に囲まれている。スキー場にも近く、磐梯高原の観光拠点として便利。
review_summary: Visitors say this park offers stunning views of Lake Inawashiro and Mount Bandai, with well-maintained walking paths and lush greenery. They also highlight the spacious grounds, making it feel uncrowded even on busy days, and mention it's a great spot for picnics and forest bathing. Others appreciate the opportunity to observe wildlife, such as Japanese serows, and enjoy the peaceful, quiet atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A new hot spring area located on the southern foothills of Mount Bandai, surrounded by quiet forests. It is close to ski resorts and serves as a convenient base for sightseeing in the Bandai Highlands.

name: 天神岬の湯温泉
location: 福島県 双葉郡楢葉町
sales_point: 楢葉町の中心部近くに位置する温泉地。温泉施設が公園内にあり、サイクリング、キャンプ、オートキャンプなども楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor baths, jet baths, and open-air rotenburo with stunning ocean views. They also highlight the high-quality, slightly salty, reddish-brown water that leaves skin feeling smooth. Guests mention the reasonable prices, ample parking, and friendly, attentive staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the center of Naraha Town, with facilities situated in a park where visitors can enjoy cycling, camping, and auto camping.

name: 木賊温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡南会津町
sales_point: 西根川沿いに位置する温泉地。トクサの群生地だったことから名付けられたと伝えられる。野趣豊かな川に面した露天風呂がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nishine River, named after the area that was once a habitat for horsetail plants. It features an open-air bath facing a rich natural river.

name: 中津川温泉
sales_point: 郡山市南東部の阿武隈山地に位置する温泉地。山深く自然環境に恵まれている、閑静な山のいで湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southeastern part of Koriyama City, in the Abukuma Mountains. It is a quiet mountain hot spring blessed with a rich natural environment.

name: 中ノ沢温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 安達太良山の西南側山麓、標高740メートルの高原に位置する温泉地。湯量豊富な沼尻山の源泉を引湯している。猪苗代・磐梯高原等の観光とスキーの拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 740 meters on the southwestern foothills of Mount Adatara, drawing abundant water from the Numajiri Mountain spring. It is an ideal base for sightseeing and skiing in Inawashiro and the Bandai Highlands.

name: 中の湯温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡磐梯町
sales_point: 磐梯山の頂上に程近い山中に位置する温泉地。裏磐梯の湖沼群や吾妻連峰などの眺望が良い。ゴールドラインは冬期間閉鎖となる。
review_summary:
People say this public bath is a clean and well-maintained facility with both indoor and outdoor baths, and private baths are also available. Visitors also highlight the reasonable 500 yen entry fee and the friendly, helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the baths can be small and crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains near the summit of Mount Bandai, offering great views of the lakes and marshes of Urabandai and the Azuma mountain range. The Gold Line is closed during winter.

name: 中ノ湯（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 箕輪山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。高原の静かないで湯。保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mount Minowa, featuring a quiet hot spring in the highlands, suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 成田温泉
sales_point: 阿武隈川の支流、笹原川沿いに位置する温泉地。住宅街の中にあり、地元の人々に好評。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers high-quality, smooth-feeling hot spring water in both indoor and outdoor baths, along with a sauna. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, convenient early morning and late-night operating hours, and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the locker rooms can be inconvenient.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Sasahara River, a tributary of the Abukuma River, situated in a residential area and popular among locals.

name: 新鶴温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡会津美里町
sales_point: 会津盆地を一望できる高台に位置する温泉地。薬用人参浴等、10種類の入浴方法が楽しめる。日帰り入浴も好評。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including hot, lukewarm, jacuzzi, and medicinal options, with clear signage explaining their benefits. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, delicious meals, and the availability of private onsen baths.

Other reviews mention the hot springs can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill with a panoramic view of the Aizu Basin, offering ten different bathing methods including medicinal ginseng baths. Day-use bathing is also popular.

name: 西会津温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡西会津町
sales_point: 飯豊山南側の阿賀野川沿いに位置する温泉地。北方約6キロには紅葉の名所、銚子ノ口もあり、登山客や観光客で賑わいを見せている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious open-air baths, jacuzzis, and saunas, with a unique salty spring water that leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the affordable prices, clean facilities, and the warm, friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the main bath can be too hot.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Agano River on the southern side of Mount Iide. About 6 kilometers to the north is the famous autumn foliage spot, Choshinokuchi, bustling with climbers and tourists.

name: 西久保（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 国道49号線近くに位置する温泉地。野口英世生家、猪苗代湖に近い。会津観光の拠点として便利。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near National Route 49, close to the birthplace of Hideyo Noguchi and Lake Inawashiro. Convenient as a base for Aizu sightseeing.

name: 西ノ沢（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 磐梯山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。静かな一軒宿で湯治宿として人気がある。観光の拠点としても便利。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water, featuring a milky white, sulfur-scented, highly acidic, and undiluted source. They also highlight the welcoming staff and the charming, traditional atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the facilities can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern foothills of Mount Bandai. A quiet inn popular for therapeutic stays, also convenient as a base for sightseeing.

name: 西山温泉
location: 福島県 河沼郡柳津町
sales_point: 只見川支流の滝合川と東川の渓谷沿いにある温泉地。湯量が豊富で素朴な環境にある。歴史も古く、効能も高い名湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area along the Takiai River and Higashikawa gorge. Abundant hot spring water in a rustic environment. A historic and renowned hot spring with high efficacy.

name: 日中温泉
sales_point: 徳川時代末期に発見された温泉地。近年ダムの建設により、日中ダム堰の下の草原に移転した。一軒宿の秘湯。
review_summary: People say this public bath offers excellent quality hot spring water that is free-flowing and salty, with many highlighting its therapeutic benefits for joint pain and skin conditions. They also mention the bath is very hot, but visitors quickly adjust to the temperature. Guests appreciate the affordable 200 yen fee and the traditional, retro atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area discovered in the late Tokugawa period. Recently relocated to a meadow below the Nichu Dam due to dam construction. A hidden hot spring with a single inn.

name: 入道の湯温泉
location: 福島県 石川郡古殿町
sales_point: 阿武隈山地の三株山西側山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、かくれ湯の雰囲気を持った素朴ないで湯。お忍びで来ているような気分に浸ることができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mikakubuyama in the Abukuma Mountains. A quiet environment with a rustic atmosphere, perfect for a secret getaway.

name: 沼沢温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡金山町
sales_point: 紅葉の名所、沼沢湖の北西に位置する温泉地。只見川河畔にあり、水と緑豊かな環境。休養・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located northwest of Lake Numazawa, a famous spot for autumn leaves. Situated by the Tadami River, surrounded by water and greenery, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 沼尻温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 安達太良山の西南側山麓に位置する温泉地。標高740メートルの高原にあり、湯量豊富。沼尻スキー場に近く、夏季は登山の基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southwestern foothills of Mount Adatara, at an elevation of 740 meters. Abundant hot spring water, close to Numajiri Ski Resort, and suitable as a base for summer mountain climbing.

name: 微温湯温泉
spa_quality: 硫黄泉、含アルミニウム泉
sales_point: 吾妻小富士東側山腹に位置する温泉地。標高930メートルの高地にあり、開湯300年の歴史を有する。古くから眼病の名湯と伝えられている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a unique "lukewarm" bathing experience with highly concentrated spring water, and guests appreciate the option of a warmer bath for contrast. They also highlight the reasonable day-use fees and the charming, friendly cats that roam the property.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern slope of Azuma Kompira. At an elevation of 930 meters, it has a history of 300 years and is traditionally known for its efficacy in treating eye diseases.

name: 猫啼温泉
location: 福島県 石川郡石川町
sales_point: 北須川に位置する温泉地。和泉式部の愛猫が病を治したことに由来することから名付けられたといわれている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious, elaborate meals with many small dishes, and features a unique radioactive hot spring that provides a relaxing experience. They also highlight the attentive staff and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Some reviews mention the dryers can be ineffective.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Kitakusa River. It is said to be named after the beloved cat of Izumi Shikibu, which cured its illness.

name: 野地温泉
sales_point: 鬼面山の北西側山麓に位置する温泉地。標高1200メートルの高地にあり、自然環境が良い。吾妻・安達太良の登山基地としても人気がある。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen hotel offers a wide variety of baths with excellent milky, sulfurous hot spring water, and many highlight the open-air baths and the option to enjoy snow views. They also mention the delicious and satisfying meals, with some noting the healthy and well-balanced options. Guests appreciate the welcoming and kind staff, as well as the convenient free shuttle bus service from Fukushima Station.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northwestern foothills of Onimen Mountain, at an elevation of 1200 meters. Known for its beautiful natural environment, popular as a base for climbing Azuma and Adatara.

name: 八町温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡金山町
sales_point: 野尻川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。玉梨温泉と野尻川を挟み川向かいにある。湯は飲用もでき、特に胃腸病に効能が高い。閑静な環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。
review_summary: People say this communal bath offers a unique atmosphere and features a hot, carbonated spring with a distinct iron taste. Visitors also highlight the reasonable 300 yen donation for entry and the 24-hour access. They also mention the friendly local staff and the option of a footbath for those who find the main bath too hot.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nojiri River gorge, across from Tamagiri Onsen. The water can be consumed and is particularly effective for gastrointestinal diseases. A quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 羽鳥湖温泉
location: 福島県 岩瀬郡天栄村
sales_point: 羽鳥湖の近くに位置する温泉地。総合リゾート施設の中にあり、カヌー、キャンプ、クロスカントリースキーなどが楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a variety of baths, including indoor and outdoor options, along with both dry and wet saunas. Visitors also highlight the convenient access for campers and the option to use the pool with a swimsuit. Guests mention the facility is clean and comfortable, with senior and JAF discounts available.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Hatori Lake, within a comprehensive resort facility where you can enjoy canoeing, camping, and cross-country skiing.

name: 早戸温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡三島町
sales_point: 早戸駅の近く、沼沢湖の東方に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。鶴が発見したと言われており、別名鶴の湯とも呼ばれる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a natural, free-flowing medicinal hot spring with a unique reddish-brown, slightly cloudy water that warms the body deeply. They also highlight the stunning views of the Tadami River from both the indoor and outdoor baths, which are especially beautiful during autumn foliage and winter snow. Guests mention the reasonable day-use fees and the friendly, helpful staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Hayato Station, east of Lake Numazawa. A quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation. It is said to have been discovered by a crane, also known as Crane's Bath.

name: はやま（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 磐梯山のほぼ真南に位置する温泉地。猪苗代湖が一望でき、磐梯山への登山口もある。また、冬はスキー場がすぐそばにある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located almost directly south of Mount Bandai. Offers a panoramic view of Lake Inawashiro and has a trailhead for climbing Mount Bandai. In winter, a ski resort is nearby.

name: 原木田温泉
sales_point: 白く濁ったお湯が特徴の温泉地。イオウを含むため、特に循環器系の病気やじんま疹に良く効く。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area characterized by its milky white water. Contains sulfur, particularly effective for circulatory diseases and hives.

name: 馬場の湯温泉
location: 福島県 田村郡三春町
sales_point: 阿武隈山地の丘陵に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the hills of the Abukuma Mountains. A quiet environment, ideal for recuperation and therapy.

name: 坂下温泉
location: 福島県 河沼郡会津坂下町
sales_point: 飯豊連峰や磐梯山の眺望がよい温泉地。春から秋にかけて、山菜取りや川前でのヘラ鮒釣りが楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a strong alkaline, smooth, and warm water that leaves skin feeling soft, and the showers also use the same spring water. They also highlight the reasonable 500 yen entry fee and the friendly management.

Some reviews mention the women's bathroom can be cool.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with great views of the Iide Mountains and Mount Bandai. Enjoyable for mountain vegetable picking and fishing for crucian carp in the river from spring to autumn.

name: 磐梯熱海温泉
sales_point: 郡山市北西部に位置する温泉地。阿武隈川支流の五百川沿いにあり、磐梯高原などの観光拠点に好適。郡山の奥座敷とも言われている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northwest part of Koriyama City. Situated along the Iwaki River tributary, it is a convenient base for sightseeing in the Bandai Highlands and is also referred to as the hidden retreat of Koriyama.

name: 磐梯（表磐梯温泉郷）
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 磐梯山の南側山麓に位置する新しい温泉地。静かな林に囲まれている。スキー場にも近く、磐梯高原の観光拠点として便利。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen hotel features spacious rooms, each with a large private open-air bath, and offers delicious in-room dining for both breakfast and dinner. They also highlight the attentive and kind staff, who provide excellent hospitality. Visitors appreciate the quiet atmosphere, allowing for a truly relaxing and private stay.
sales_point_en: A new hot spring area located on the southern foothills of Mount Bandai, surrounded by quiet forests. Close to ski resorts and convenient as a base for sightseeing in the Bandai Highlands.

name: 東舘温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡矢祭町
sales_point: 清流久慈川にほど近く、自然環境に恵まれた風光明媚な温泉地。久慈川は鮎でも有名。
sales_point_en: A picturesque hot spring area blessed with a natural environment, located near the clear Kuzu River, which is also famous for its sweetfish.

name: 東山温泉
location: 福島県 会津若松市
sales_point: 湯川沿いに位置する歴史の永い温泉地。橋が多く情緒豊かな温泉街を形成している。会津若松の奥座敷として栄え、会津地方の観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A historic hot spring area located along the Yukawa River, featuring many bridges that create a charming onsen town. Flourished as a retreat for Aizuwakamatsu, it serves as an excellent base for tourism in the Aizu region.

name: 桧原温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡北塩原村
sales_point: 桧原湖北部付近に位置する温泉地。桧原湖の観光や、磐梯山登山の基地に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers good quality spring water and provides body soap and shampoo. They also highlight the affordable price and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Some reviews mention the bath water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the northern part of Lake Hibara, ideal for sightseeing at Lake Hibara and as a base for climbing Mount Bandai.

name: 深沢温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡只見町
sales_point: 会津朝日連峰の南側山麓、只見駅近くに位置する温泉地。田子倉ダムの遊覧船、伊南川での魚釣りなど、奥会津を楽しむ拠点として最適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features a spacious bath with a high iron content and a slightly hot temperature, offering views of the mountains and river. They also highlight the delicious and reasonably priced ramen and the availability of complimentary water and roasted green tea. Guests mention the relaxing atmosphere and the friendly local staff.
sales_point_en: Located at the southern foot of the Aizu Asahi Mountains, near Tadami Station. It serves as a perfect base for enjoying the Oku-Aizu area, with activities like boat rides on the Tagokura Dam and fishing in the Inan River.

name: 藤沼温泉
sales_point: 福島県の真ん中、藤沼湖畔に位置する温泉地。一帯が藤沼湖自然公園として整備され、自然環境が良い。湖畔には藤の名所で知られる藤沼神社や、コテージ村とキャンプ場などがある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has hot, skin-softening spring water in both indoor and outdoor baths, and delicious soba noodles. Guests also highlight the affordable entry fee and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention guests can enter the bath without washing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the shores of Lake Fujinuma in the center of Fukushima Prefecture. The area is developed as Fujinuma Lake Natural Park, offering a pleasant natural environment. Nearby are the famous Fujinuma Shrine and a cottage village with a campground.

name: 二岐温泉
location: 福島県 岩瀬郡天栄村
sales_point: 二岐山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。二岐川の渓谷沿いの閑静な環境にある。ブナの原生林に囲まれた山峡の秘湯。渓谷沿いの野趣あふれる露天風呂や、岩盤から湯が湧いている。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the eastern foot of Mount Niki, in a quiet environment along the Niki River gorge. Surrounded by a beech primeval forest, it is a hidden hot spring in a mountain valley, featuring rustic outdoor baths along the gorge and natural hot springs bubbling from the rocks, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 母畑温泉
location: 福島県 石川郡石川町
sales_point: 阿武隈山中、北須川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。以前は療養客の多い湯治場だったが、近年大規模な宿もでき、観光の拠点ともなっている。
sales_point_en: Located along the clear stream of the Kitakuzawa River in the Abukuma Mountains. Once a popular hot spring for therapeutic guests, it has recently developed large accommodations, becoming a hub for tourism.

name: 舞子温泉
sales_point: 潮騒の音が聞こえる温泉地。夏には海水浴や釣りの客で賑わう。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel for its spacious rooms, delicious meals featuring fresh seafood, and large public baths that boast ocean views. Furthermore, reviewers highlight the reasonable prices and the friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area where you can hear the sound of the waves. It is bustling with beachgoers and fishing enthusiasts in the summer.

name: 幕川温泉
sales_point: 土湯峠の北方、荒川沿いの谷間に位置する温泉地。ブナやダケカンバの樹海の中にある秘湯。幕川渓谷が近く自然環境に恵まれている。冬期休業。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent quality hot springs, including milky white, cloudy open-air baths with great views. They also highlight the delicious and hearty meals, such as Fukushima beef shabu-shabu and grilled char, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
sales_point_en: Located in a valley along the Arakawa River, north of the Tsuchiyu Pass. A hidden hot spring in a beech and birch forest, blessed with a rich natural environment near the Makukawa Gorge. Closed during winter.

name: 三穂田温泉
sales_point: 郡山南ICからすぐの所に位置する温泉地。車の便が良く郡山近辺の観光拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a high-quality, thick, and smooth hot spring water that leaves skin feeling soft, and many enjoy the clean, spacious sauna with self-löyly. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, especially for overnight stays, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be an additional charge.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located just off the Koriyama South IC, making it a convenient base for sightseeing around Koriyama.

name: 宮下温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡三島町
sales_point: 只見川と支流の大谷川が合流する付近の高台に位置する温泉地。静かな山あいの温泉で、湯治客や行楽客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: Situated on a high ground near the confluence of the Tadami River and its tributary, the Otani River. A quiet mountain hot spring popular with both therapeutic and leisure guests.

name: 向山温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡棚倉町
sales_point: 磐城棚倉駅の東方に位置する温泉地。市街地の眺めが良く。桜の名所として知られる棚倉城跡など見所も多い。
review_summary: People say this traditional Japanese inn, a registered tangible cultural property, offers a unique atmosphere with its well-maintained historic architecture and beautiful garden. Guests mention the delicious local cuisine, especially the famous stewed carp, and appreciate the relaxing hot spring baths, including private options. They also highlight the attentive and warm service from the staff, who provide meals in guest rooms.
sales_point_en: Located east of Iwaki Tanakura Station, offering great views of the city. It is known for the historic Tanakura Castle ruins, which are a popular sightseeing spot.

name: 守山温泉
sales_point: 郡山盆地南側の田園地帯に位置する温泉地。のどかな環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。地元の人々からも親しまれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the rural landscape on the southern side of the Koriyama Basin. It offers a peaceful environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation, and is beloved by local residents.

name: 休石温泉
sales_point: 三森峠の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。多田野川の渓谷沿いの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent quality hot spring baths with a pleasant sulfur aroma, and many appreciate the delicious, handmade meals. They also highlight the clean facilities, reasonable prices, and the kind, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the washing area can be limited.
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern foot of the Mimori Pass, in a quiet environment along the valley of the Tadano River, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 柳津温泉
location: 福島県 河沼郡柳津町
sales_point: 只見川沿いに位置する温泉地。川畔に宿が建ち、閑静で温泉情緒もたっぷり残っている。天然記念物に指定されているウグイの群生地としても知られる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Tadami River, with accommodations by the riverside, retaining a tranquil atmosphere and rich onsen charm. It is also known as a natural monument for the congregation of Ugui fish.

name: 矢吹町松房温泉
location: 福島県 西白河郡矢吹町
sales_point: 福島空港まで約25分、自然に恵まれた田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located about 25 minutes from Fukushima Airport, this hot spring area is set in a picturesque rural landscape blessed with nature.

name: 湯倉温泉
location: 福島県 大沼郡金山町
sales_point: 只見川の本名ダム湖畔に位置する温泉地。御神楽岳の登山基地にも良い。渓流釣りも楽しめる。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring features a rich, hot, and cloudy green-brown water with a salty, iron taste, and appreciate the continuously flowing spring water. They also highlight the reasonable 300 yen fee and the clean, well-maintained facilities, including restrooms and a resting area. Guests mention the friendly local atmosphere, with many enjoying conversations with other bathers.
sales_point_en: Situated by the Honmyo Dam Lake along the Tadami River, this hot spring area is also a good base for climbing Mount Mikagura. Enjoy fishing in the nearby streams.

name: 湯沢温泉
location: 福島県 田村郡小野町
sales_point: 県立の自然公園矢大臣山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located on the southern foot of Mount Yadaijin, a prefectural natural park. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯岐温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡塙町
sales_point: 久慈川の上流、標高500メートルに位置する温泉地。歴史が古く、ぬるめの湯に長い時間入浴する「低温長時間浴」の習慣がある。むかしから中風の湯と言われている。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent hot spring water, with many highlighting the unique foot-filling rock bath and its smooth, skin-softening qualities. They also appreciate the delicious meals, especially the breakfast, and the wide selection of Japanese sake. Visitors like the friendly staff and the relaxing, quiet atmosphere, noting the convenient free coffee and the option of free lunch for consecutive stays.
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of 500 meters upstream of the Kuji River, this hot spring area has a long history and is known for its 'low-temperature long bathing' practice in warm waters. It has been referred to as a remedy for strokes since ancient times.

name: 湯の田温泉
location: 福島県 東白川郡鮫川村
sales_point: 山峡の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。古くから湯治場として名高い。せせらぎの音を聞きながらの入浴は心が洗われる。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: People say this day-use hot spring features clean and stylish facilities, including a sauna and a unique spring-fed cold bath. They also highlight the affordable 600-yen entry fee, which includes access to a comfortable lounge area with free Wi-Fi, where outside food and drinks are permitted. Guests mention the staff are welcoming and provide excellent service, making for a relaxing and enjoyable experience.
sales_point_en: Located along a mountain stream in a valley, this hot spring area has been famous as a therapeutic spot since ancient times. Bathing while listening to the sound of the flowing water is refreshing. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯ノ花温泉
location: 福島県 南会津郡南会津町
sales_point: 湯岐川沿いに位置する温泉地。川床から温泉が湧出する。川原の露天風呂は昔ながらの素朴な風情がある。保養・静養に好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a comfortable water temperature, showers, and a spacious resting area. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, along with the convenient 300-yen pass for access to four different onsen. Visitors appreciate the excellent water quality, noting it leaves their skin feeling smooth.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yuki River, where hot springs bubble up from the riverbed. The outdoor baths by the river have a rustic charm reminiscent of old times, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 横向温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡猪苗代町
sales_point: 箕輪山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。標高1080メートルの高原のいで湯。紅葉が美しく、冬季はスキーも楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers a unique hot spring experience with three distinct temperature zones in its foot-source fed bath, perfect for extended, private soaks. They also highlight the delicious, locally sourced cuisine, including seasonal wild vegetables and homemade dishes. Visitors appreciate the warm hospitality from the staff and the quiet, secluded atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mount Minowa at an elevation of 1,080 meters. Known for its beautiful autumn foliage and winter skiing.

name: 夜ノ森サクラ温泉
location: 福島県 双葉郡富岡町
sales_point: 夜ノ森駅近くに位置する温泉地。東に富岡海水場、西に紅葉の名所滝川渓谷と見所も多い。いろいろなお風呂を楽しみながらくつろげる。
review_summary: Visitors say this tourist destination features impressive cherry blossom trees and extensive canola flower fields. They also highlight the mostly flat terrain, making it very accessible, and the availability of several free parking lots.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Yonamori Station, with attractions such as Tomioka Seaside and the famous Takigawa Valley for autumn leaves.

name: 鷲倉温泉
sales_point: 土湯峠から約500メートル、福島県下で最高地に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にある秘湯。裏手には安達太良山の縦走路もある。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen ryokan offers two distinct hot spring sources, including milky white sulfur springs and clear, iron-rich acidic springs, with both indoor and open-air baths. They also highlight the delicious and plentiful meals, featuring local mountain vegetables, and the reasonable prices. Others appreciate the attentive and hospitable staff, as well as the clean and well-maintained facilities.
sales_point_en: Located about 500 meters from the Tsuchiyu Pass, this hot spring is the highest in Fukushima Prefecture, set in a quiet environment with access to the Adatara Mountain trail.

name: 早稲沢温泉
location: 福島県 耶麻郡北塩原村
sales_point: 裏磐梯高原、大早稲沢山西側山麓に位置する温泉地。桧原湖の観光や、磐梯山登山の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mount Dawasedazawa in the Urabandai Highlands, ideal for sightseeing at Lake Hibara and as a base for climbing Mount Bandai.

name: 相野々温泉
sales_point: 鶴ヶ池公園内に位置する温泉地。素晴らしい眺望、酒蔵風の酒房、和・洋風の日替わり大浴場など、ゆったりとくつろげる。
sales_point_en: Located within Tsurugaike Park, this hot spring offers stunning views, a sake brewery-style tavern, and a relaxing atmosphere with changing large baths.

name: 赤石温泉
sales_point: 目の前が日本海という眺望の良い温泉地。保養センターの建物は新しく明るい雰囲気。日本海の幸が人気。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers a very good hot spring experience, with both cold and heated baths, and a scenic outdoor bath. They also highlight the accommodating staff, who provide meals even for late arrivals and store personal beverages.

Other reviews mention the indoor bath can be shared.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a great view of the Sea of Japan right in front. The health resort building is new and bright, popular for its seafood.

name: 秋田温泉
sales_point: 秋田市の北郊、旭川の上流に位置し、山と川に恵まれた閑静な温泉地。スキー、秋田市内の観光拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring hotel offers a wide variety of natural hot springs, including open-air baths and pot baths, along with a spacious sauna and mist sauna. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, complimentary gym access, and free night-time ramen service.

Other reviews mention the showers can be non-working.
sales_point_en: Located in the northern suburbs of Akita City, upstream of the Asahikawa River, this quiet hot spring area is blessed with mountains and rivers, ideal for skiing and sightseeing in Akita City.

name: 鷹の湯（秋の宮温泉郷）
sales_point: 高松岳の西側山麓に位置する温泉郷。役内川に沿って点在する湯ノ岱、稲住、鷹ノ湯、湯ノ又などの秘湯群を総称して秋の宮温泉郷と呼んでいる。秋の紅葉は絶景。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers a variety of baths, including a 130cm deep standing bath and scenic riverside open-air baths. Guests also highlight the delicious iwana sashimi and Minase beef steak, and appreciate the well-maintained facilities.

Some reviews mention the day-use hours can be limited.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mount Takamatsu, known collectively as Akinomiya Onsen, featuring hidden hot springs along the Yakunai River. The autumn foliage is breathtaking.

name: アルパス温泉
sales_point: 花輪スキー場の中に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located within the Hanawa Ski Resort.

name: 安楽温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本荘市
sales_point: 本荘市の南側に位置する温泉地。本荘公園に近く、杉木立に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。
review_summary:
