Guests mention this inn offers excellent hot springs, with some rooms featuring private, free-flowing baths, and delicious, hearty meals including local specialties. They also highlight the clean facilities, relaxing bamboo grove views, and the staff's attentive service.

Some reviews mention there can be noise issues.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern side of Honjo City, near Honjo Park, surrounded by cedar groves in a quiet environment.

name: 岩倉温泉
sales_point: 湯元川と荒沢川が合流するひなびた山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers outstanding hot spring water that is clear, warm, and promotes deep sleep. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, featuring Akita regional foods and a variety of local sake. Guests mention the inn is clean, quiet, and has a charming, traditional atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a secluded mountain valley where the Yumoto River and Arasawa River converge, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 岩見温泉
sales_point: 岩見ダムの約6キロ下流、岩見川河畔に位置する温泉地。近くには紅葉の名所、岨谷峡があり、自然環境に恵まれている。
sales_point_en: Located about 6 kilometers downstream from Iwami Dam along the Iwami River, this hot spring area is blessed with natural beauty and is near the famous autumn foliage spot, Sogadani Gorge.

name: 羽州温泉
sales_point: 象潟町北部に位置する温泉地。「奥の細道」最北の地である蚶満寺が近い。自然環境に恵まれ景観が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Kisakata Town, close to Kanmanji Temple, the northernmost point of the 'Oku no Hosomichi' path, with beautiful scenery.

name: 打当温泉
sales_point: 森吉山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。「マタギの里」として知られている。スキー、渓流釣り、ハイキングなども楽しむことができる。
review_summary:
People say this inn offers delicious gibier cuisine, including bear hot pot, and features spacious indoor and open-air hot spring baths. Guests also highlight the well-maintained facilities, warm service, and the interesting Matagi Museum.

Some reviews mention the location can be inconvenient.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern foothills of Mount Moriyoshi, known as 'Matagi no Sato.' Enjoy skiing, stream fishing, and hiking.

name: 鵜ノ崎温泉
sales_point: 男鹿半島南端の鵜ノ崎に位置する温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this coast is very shallow, making it safe and enjoyable for children, and features unique "devil's washboard" rock formations visible at low tide. They also highlight the availability of free parking, clean restrooms, and a washing area. Others mention it's a beautiful spot to watch the sunset and is ideal for dog walking.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southern tip of the Oga Peninsula.

name: 大潟温泉
location: 秋田県 南秋田郡大潟村
sales_point: 八郎潟調整地の北側に位置する温泉地。温泉源は500万年前の海水が地層水になったといわれる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a unique dark brown "moor" spring with a smooth texture, along with a sauna, cold bath, and various other baths. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, the clean restrooms, and the convenient early morning opening hours.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northern side of the Hachirogata adjustment area, said to have hot spring sources from seawater 5 million years ago.

name: 大釜(乳頭温泉郷)
sales_point: 乳頭温泉郷の一角。宿舎は昔の校舎を改造したもので趣深い。乳頭山登山の基地に好適。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features good quality, reddish-brown, cloudy water, with a spacious indoor bath and an open-air bath that's great for enjoying the seasonal breeze.

Other reviews mention the hot spring water can be cold or inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Part of the Nyuto Onsen area, the accommodation is a renovated old school building, making it charming. Ideal as a base for climbing Mount Nyuto.

name: 大葛温泉
sales_point: 八幡平の北西側山麓に位置する温泉地。犀川の渓谷沿いの閑静な環境にあり、自然環境に恵まれている。保養・休養に好適。町営の入浴施設もあり、日帰りの入湯も楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this public bath offers a very gentle and warming hot spring experience, with many highlighting the pleasant, slightly hot water. Visitors appreciate the affordable 200 yen entry fee and the unique, traditional washing area where water is scooped from a flowing channel. They also mention the soft, faintly scented, and clear hot spring water, noting it's great for warming up.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northwestern foothills of Hachimantai, in a quiet environment along the Saigawa Valley, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. There are also municipal bathing facilities for day-use.

name: 大滝温泉
sales_point: 大館市の東南端に位置する温泉地。米代川沿いにあり、秋田藩主の湯治湯として利用された歴史を持つ。十和田湖等の探勝基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southeastern tip of Odate City, along the Yoneshiro River, with a history of being used as a healing hot spring for the Akita feudal lord.

name: おおだて温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ大館駅前とＪＲ東大館駅前に位置する温泉地。ビジネス、観光拠点に最適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen offers a relaxing experience with a large main bath, a slightly warmer bath, and a sauna, along with complimentary shampoo and body soap. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen entrance fee and convenient long operating hours from early morning to late evening.

Other reviews mention the amenities can be limited.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in front of JR Odate Station and JR Higashi-Odate Station, ideal for business and tourism.

name: 大沼(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平温泉郷の一角。大沼の前に位置する温泉地。ブナ林に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: Visitors say this scenic spot offers stunning autumn foliage, especially around Ōnuma Pond, with a short, accessible trail that takes about 10-30 minutes to complete. They also highlight the convenient parking available at the visitor center. Others mention that the area is beautiful when the weather is good.
sales_point_en: Located in a corner of the Hachimantai Onsen area, this hot spring is situated in a quiet environment surrounded by beech forests, right in front of Onuma. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 大深(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。アスピーテライン沿いにあり八幡平温泉郷のひとつに数えられる。広葉樹に囲まれ、森林浴も併せて楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located at the foot of the western side of Hachimantai, along the Aspite Line, and is counted as one of the Hachimantai Onsen. Surrounded by broadleaf trees, it offers a chance to enjoy forest bathing as well. It is a national health resort.

name: 大森公園温泉
sales_point: 大森町総合運動公園内に位置する温泉地。湯量豊富で加温、加水なしの100％天然温泉。
sales_point_en: Situated within the Omori Town Comprehensive Sports Park, this hot spring boasts abundant hot water and is 100% natural without heating or dilution.

name: 大湯温泉
sales_point: 皆瀬川と大湯沢の合流合流点付近に位置する温泉地。渓畔からは湯煙が立ち上る。栗駒山への登山口となっている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent hot springs, including scenic open-air baths and a unique natural steam bath. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, especially the Minase beef steak, and the reasonable day-use fee of 500 yen. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the inn is well-maintained and clean.
sales_point_en: Located near the confluence of the Minase River and Oyu River, this hot spring features rising steam from the riverbank and serves as a trailhead for climbing Mount Kurikoma.

name: 男鹿温泉
sales_point: 男鹿半島の北寄りに位置する温泉地。男鹿観光の基地に好適で男鹿温泉郷と称することもある。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located in the northern part of the Oga Peninsula, making it an ideal base for Oga tourism, and is sometimes referred to as the Oga Onsen area.

name: 小倉温泉
location: 秋田県 南秋田郡五城目町
sales_point: 馬場目川支流の富津内川に臨む丘陵にある温泉地。古くから湯治場として親しまれている。
sales_point_en: Perched on a hill overlooking the Futatsuuchi River, this hot spring has been cherished as a healing spot for many years.

name: 親川温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本荘市
sales_point: 国道7号線沿いの親川地区に位置する温泉地。親川沿いの閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 7 in the Oyakawa area, this hot spring is set in a tranquil environment by the Oyakawa River.

name: 小安温泉
sales_point: 小安峡に沿いに位置する温泉地。熱湯が噴出する小安峡大噴湯に加え、断崖絶壁の渓谷美と見所も多い。冬はスキー、夏はアウトドア、キャンプと一年中楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent hot springs, including scenic open-air baths and a unique natural steam bath. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, especially the Minase beef steak, and the reasonable day-use fee of 500 yen. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the inn is well-maintained and clean.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is situated along the Koyasu Gorge, featuring the Koyasu Great Geyser that erupts hot water, along with stunning cliffside views. It offers year-round activities such as skiing in winter and outdoor camping in summer.

name: 貝の沢温泉
sales_point: 県道28号線から少し山あいに入った所に位置する温泉地。自然に恵まれており、入浴した後森林浴も満喫できる。
review_summary: People say this onsen has excellent quality hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth and moisturized, with many highlighting the 100% natural, free-flowing spring. They also mention the facility is clean, well-maintained, and offers a quiet, relaxing atmosphere. Guests appreciate the reasonable prices for day use and the option to enjoy simple, satisfying meals.
sales_point_en: Located a bit up the mountain from Prefectural Route 28, this hot spring is surrounded by nature, allowing visitors to enjoy forest bathing after their soak.

name: 角館温泉
sales_point: 秋田市へ向かう国道46号線沿いに位置する温泉地。武家屋敷の町を散策したあとの心地よい疲労感をバラエティに富んだお風呂でリフレッシュする事ができる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a spacious bathing area with a large indoor bath, complimentary shampoo and body soap, and a sauna. They also highlight the friendly staff and the convenient early morning operating hours.

Other reviews mention the water can be too hot.
sales_point_en: Situated along National Route 46 heading towards Akita City, this hot spring offers a refreshing experience after exploring the samurai district with a variety of baths.

name: 角間川温泉
sales_point: 雄物川と横手川の合流点近くに位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features spacious indoor and open-air baths with salty sodium chloride spring water, along with a sauna and cold plunge pool. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen admission fee and convenient long operating hours until 9 PM.

Other reviews mention that bathing can require cash.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located near the confluence of the Omorogawa and Yokotekawa rivers.

name: かすみ温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本庄市
sales_point: 芋川支流の小さな流れに沿いに位置する温泉地。かすみ桜が有名。素朴な雰囲気があり、静かな環境にある。
sales_point_en: Nestled along a small stream of the Imokawa tributary, this hot spring is famous for its Kasumi cherry blossoms and offers a rustic atmosphere in a quiet setting.

name: 金ケ崎温泉
sales_point: 男鹿半島西側に位置する温泉地。眺望が良く露天風呂からは日本海が一望できる。
sales_point_en: Located on the western side of the Oga Peninsula, this hot spring offers great views, with the open-air bath providing a panoramic view of the Sea of Japan.

name: 神岡温泉
sales_point: 神岡町中心部に位置する温泉地。西方に清流雄物川が流れる閑静な環境にある。大曲観光拠点にも好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features spacious indoor and open-air baths with salty sodium chloride spring water, along with a sauna and cold plunge pool. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen admission fee and convenient long operating hours until 9 PM.

Other reviews mention that bathing can require cash.
sales_point_en: Situated in the center of Kamioka Town, this hot spring is in a quiet environment with the clear Omorogawa River flowing to the west, making it a suitable base for sightseeing in Omagari.

name: 加茂温泉
sales_point: 男鹿半島西側に位置する温泉地。加茂青砂海岸に面し、風光明媚な地にある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers stunning views of the Sea of Japan from the rooms, restaurant, and open-air baths, with many highlighting the beautiful sunsets. They also appreciate the delicious local cuisine, the abundant hot spring water, and the staff's welcoming hospitality.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be cool.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located on the western side of the Oga Peninsula, facing the Kamo Aoyaka Coast, in a picturesque area.

name: 川口温泉
sales_point: 山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、川口渓谷の探勝、薬師岳、真昼岳登山にも好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers delicious meals, especially the luxurious breakfast and tasty rice, and features a spacious hot spring bath and sauna. They also highlight the attentive staff and the comfortable, uncrowded atmosphere, allowing for a relaxing stay.

Other reviews mention the hot springs can be unavailable.
sales_point_en: Nestled in the mountains, this hot spring is in a quiet environment, making it ideal for exploring the Kawaguchi Gorge and climbing Yakushi-dake and Mahiru-dake.

name: 蟹場(乳頭温泉郷)
sales_point: 乳頭温泉郷の一角。温泉の湧出する沢にサワガニが多く棲息していたことから名付けられたと伝えられる。谷場に露天風呂がある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including a spacious wooden bath, a rock bath, and a highly praised outdoor mixed-gender bath nestled in a serene forest setting. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, featuring Akita rice, river fish, and wild vegetables. Guests mention the staff are attentive and provide excellent service.
sales_point_en: Part of the Nyuto Onsen area, this hot spring is said to have been named after the many freshwater crabs that lived in the stream where the hot spring emerges. It features an open-air bath in the valley and is a national health resort.

name: 象潟温泉
sales_point: 象潟町北部の海岸に位置する温泉地。海水浴場が近く、鳥海山の探勝基地となっている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring features a wide, spacious bath with stunning views of the Sea of Japan and Mount Chokai, along with a sauna and various amenities. They also highlight the affordable prices and the unique, skin-softening water quality.

Some reviews mention the service can be unexpected.
sales_point_en: Located on the northern coast of Kikuhama Town, this hot spring is close to a beach and serves as a base for exploring Mount Chokai.

name: 木地山高原温泉
sales_point: 標高700メートルの木地山高原に位置する温泉地。栗駒国定公園の眺望が良い。日本三大地獄のひとつ、川原毛地獄も近く、滝そのものが温泉の川原毛湯は夏季のみ入浴できる。
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of 700 meters in the Kijiyama Highlands, this hot spring offers great views of Kurikoma National Park. Nearby is one of Japan's three major hells, the Kawarahage Hell, where the hot spring river can only be bathed in during summer.

name: 協和温泉
sales_point: 大石岳の南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。協和スキー場が近い。山々に囲まれ、夏は登山客、冬はスキー客で賑わう。近くを流れる淀川では釣りも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located on the southwestern foothills of Mount Oishi, this hot spring is near the Kyowa Ski Resort. Surrounded by mountains, it attracts hikers in summer and skiers in winter, with fishing available in the nearby Yodo River.

name: 金峰山温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ醍醐駅の東方に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり保養・休養に好適。金峰山のハイキング基地にも良い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a spacious main bath with comfortable, warm, salty water that leaves skin feeling refreshed, along with a sauna and cold plunge pool. They also highlight the affordable entry fees, friendly staff, and the convenience of early morning hours.

Other reviews mention there can be a lack of outdoor bath.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located east of JR Daigo Station. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It also serves as a good base for hiking Mount Kinpo.

name: 黒湯(乳頭温泉郷)
sales_point: 乳頭温泉郷の最奥に位置する温泉地。茅葺きの宿は素朴な雰囲気が漂う。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。冬期は休業。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent milky white and black sulfur spring waters, with both gender-separated and mixed-gender baths available. Visitors also highlight the delicious onsen tamago (hot spring eggs) and the beautiful, secluded atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are kind and provide attentive service.
sales_point_en: Located at the innermost part of Nyuto Onsenkyo, this hot spring area features thatched-roof accommodations with a rustic atmosphere. It is designated as a national health resort, suitable for recuperation and therapy. Closed during winter.

name: 金浦温泉
sales_point: 保養センターより約2キロ東側にある温泉地。泉質は良く、近郊の人々の保養場として親しまれている。海の幸が美味。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 2 kilometers east of the health center. Known for its good water quality, it is a popular spot for local residents. The seafood here is delicious.

name: 駒形温泉
sales_point: 富根駅南側の山あいに位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。町内にはスキー場が２ヶ所あり、冬季はスキー客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: Situated in the mountains south of Tomine Station, this hot spring area offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. There are two ski resorts in the town, bustling with winter sports enthusiasts.

name: 駒ヶ岳温泉
sales_point: 田沢湖高原の中腹で、田沢湖を見下ろす高台に位置する温泉地。夏は登山、冬はスキーが楽しめる。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn offers delicious regional cuisine, including kiritanpo hot pot and handmade soba, and features spacious, atmospheric indoor and open-air baths. They also highlight the free shuttle service to Tsuru-no-Yu Onsen, allowing evening visits. Visitors appreciate the reasonable prices for the quality of the food and the relaxing, quiet natural setting.
sales_point_en: Located on a hillside overlooking Lake Tazawa, this hot spring area is perfect for summer hiking and winter skiing.

name: 強首温泉
sales_point: 刈和野駅西方の丘陵地に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・休養に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen ryokan features a rare iodine-rich, highly saline hot spring that warms the body deeply and offers excellent therapeutic effects. They also highlight the beautiful, well-maintained historic building, which is a registered tangible cultural property. Guests mention the delicious local cuisine, including river crab dishes and carp simmered in soy sauce.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the hilly region west of Kawaiwa Station. It offers a tranquil environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 後生掛(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平温泉郷の一角で、アスピーテライン沿いに位置する温泉地。オンドル式の湯治棟があり、長期滞在可。大浴場には箱蒸し風呂等がある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of baths, including mud baths, box steam baths, and a steam sauna, all with excellent water quality. They also highlight the warm ondol rooms and the delicious, thoughtfully prepared meals. Guests mention the friendly staff and the clean, well-maintained facilities.
sales_point_en: Located in a corner of Hachimantai Onsenkyo along the Aspite Line, this hot spring area features a Ondol-style healing facility, suitable for long stays. The large bath includes a box steam bath and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 五の宮温泉
sales_point: 国道282号線沿いに位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 282.

name: 西明寺温泉
sales_point: 名峰森吉山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。西木村を南北に縦断している国道105号線沿いにあり、様々な温泉やプール、体育館が整備されている。羽後中里駅の西方は紅葉のメッカになっている。
review_summary:
The beautiful golden Tatsuko statue stands against the stunning clear blue waters of Lake Tazawa, providing excellent photo opportunities. Visitors also enjoy the fun experience of feeding the numerous ugui fish, and parking is often free with a purchase from nearby shops.

Other reviews mention parking can be difficult and expensive.
sales_point_en: Situated at the southern foot of the famous Moriyoshi Mountain, this hot spring area is located along National Route 105, which runs through Nishiki Village. It features various hot springs, pools, and sports facilities. The area west of Ugo Nakazato Station is a popular spot for autumn foliage.

name: 猿倉温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本庄市
sales_point: 鳥海山の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。鳥海山の登山口にあり、ハイキング、スキーなどを楽しめる。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including indoor and outdoor options, a deep jacuzzi, a sauna, and a cold bath. They also highlight the smooth, thick, and moisturizing spring water, which leaves skin feeling soft and hydrated. Guests mention the affordable 400 yen admission fee and the convenient, ample parking.
sales_point_en: Located at the northeastern foot of Mount Chokai, this hot spring area is at the trailhead for hiking and skiing.

name: 三吉山荘温泉
sales_point: 国道107号線沿いに位置する温泉地。素晴らしい自然と眼下を流れる雄物川を一望できる環境にある。四季折々の素材を生かした料理を食べて憩いのひとときを過ごせる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 107, offering stunning natural views and overlooking the Omorogawa River. Guests can enjoy seasonal cuisine while relaxing.

name: 三内峡温泉
sales_point: 三内川河畔に位置する温泉地。岩見ダム探勝や渓流釣りの拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the banks of the Sannai River, ideal as a base for exploring Iwame Dam and for stream fishing.

name: 潮浜温泉
location: 秋田県 山本郡八峰町
sales_point: 五能線に沿い日本海の砂丘の北端近くに位置する温泉地。八森町には海水浴場もいくつか有り、夏場は海水浴客で賑わいを見せる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers delicious and voluminous meals, including fresh seafood and local beef, and features a wide variety of baths with stunning ocean views. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, the friendly staff, and the convenient location right in front of the station.

Other reviews mention the rule enforcement by staff can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Located near the northern end of the sand dunes along the Japan Sea, this hot spring area is along the Gonou Line. The nearby Hamori Town has several beaches, bustling with visitors during the summer.

name: 志張(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平温泉郷の中で最も標高の低い温泉地。熊沢川沿いに位置し、閑静な環境にある。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent alkaline spring water that leaves skin smooth and warm, and some mention it helps with ailments. Guests also highlight the comfortable, well-maintained rooms and the reasonable prices for a stay. Others appreciate the welcoming, homey atmosphere and the delicious handmade soba noodles.
sales_point_en: The lowest elevation hot spring area in Hachimantai Onsenkyo, located along the Kumazawa River in a quiet environment.

name: 新鳩の湯温泉
sales_point: 宝仙湖の上流に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。冬期は休業となる。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including a famous milky white mixed-gender outdoor bath and several distinct indoor baths with different water qualities. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, especially the mountain potato hotpot and grilled river fish. Guests mention the traditional, rustic atmosphere and the opportunity to escape daily life.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located upstream of Lake Hosen. It offers a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Closed during winter.

name: 千畑温泉
location: 秋田県 仙北郡美郷町
sales_point: 真昼岳の西側山麓、善知鳥川河畔に位置する温泉地。付近の仏沢公園にはスポーツ施設もあり、家族連れにも楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located at the western foot of Mount Mahiru, along the banks of the Zenchirigawa River. The nearby Butsuzawa Park has sports facilities, making it enjoyable for families.

name: 仙北温泉
sales_point: 仙北平野の田園風景の中に位置する温泉地。全面改築中、Ｈ12年6月リニューアルオープンの予定。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a spacious bathing area with a large indoor bath, complimentary shampoo and body soap, and a sauna. They also highlight the friendly staff and the convenient early morning operating hours.

Other reviews mention the water can be too hot.
sales_point_en: Situated in the rural landscape of the Senboku Plain. Currently undergoing renovations, with a planned reopening in June of H12.

name: 銭川(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平温泉郷の一角。熊沢川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kumazawa River gorge in Hachimantai Onsenkyo.

name: 妙乃湯(乳頭温泉郷)
sales_point: 乳頭温泉郷の一角。先達川沿いに位置する温泉地。露天風呂と渓流美を共に楽しむことができる。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers two distinct spring qualities, "Kin no Yu" and "Gin no Yu," and features beautiful outdoor baths with stunning views of the river and waterfall. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, including Inaniwa udon, and the attentive, welcoming staff. Guests mention the clean, stylish, and well-maintained facilities, which create a relaxing and comfortable atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Located in a corner of Nyuto Onsenkyo along the Sendatsu River, this hot spring area allows guests to enjoy both outdoor baths and beautiful stream scenery. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 滝温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本庄市
sales_point: 大内町南部、芋川上流に位置する温泉地。温泉情緒溢れる古湯。交通事故によるケガ・後遺症によく効く。秋は紅葉が美しい。
sales_point_en: Located in the southern part of Onai Town, upstream of the Imokawa River, this hot spring area is known for its traditional atmosphere. It is effective for injuries and aftereffects from traffic accidents. The autumn foliage is beautiful.

name: 滝の沢温泉
location: 秋田県 山本郡藤里町
sales_point: 紅葉の名所、峨瓏峡の下流沿いに新しくできた温泉地。白神山地の登山客、スキー客などに好適。
sales_point_en: A newly established hot spring area along the downstream of the famous autumn foliage spot, Garokyo. Ideal for hikers and skiers visiting the Shirakami Mountains.

name: たざわ芸術村ゆぽぽ温泉
sales_point: たざわこ芸術村の中に位置する温泉地。地ビール工場やわらび劇場があり、工芸館では手作り体験などもできる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and satisfying meals, including a wide variety of breakfast options and local Akita cuisine. They also highlight the attentive staff, excellent value, and well-maintained hot spring baths with ample amenities.

Other reviews mention the public bath can be far from the rooms.
sales_point_en: Located within the Tazawako Art Village, this hot spring area features a local brewery and a theater, with craft experience opportunities available at the craft hall.

name: 田沢湖高原温泉郷
sales_point: 秋田駒ヶ岳の中腹、標高700メートルの高原に位置する温泉地。眼下に田沢湖を見下ろす風光明媚な地にあり、四季を通してスポーツを楽しむことができる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of 700 meters on the slopes of Mount Akita Komagatake, this hot spring area offers scenic views overlooking Lake Tazawa and is perfect for year-round sports activities. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 玉川(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平の焼山西側山麓に位置する温泉地。八幡平温泉郷のひとつに数えられ、岩盤浴と呼ばれる独特の湯治法がある。強酸性の温泉そのものが天然記念物の「北投石」を生成している。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features a unique, highly acidic water quality with various baths, including 100% and 50% diluted options, and a natural outdoor bedrock bath. Visitors also highlight the healthy and varied buffet-style meals, including local specialties like kiritanpo hot pot. Guests mention the staff are kind and helpful, and the overall atmosphere is relaxing.
sales_point_en: Located on the western foothills of Mount Hachimantai, this hot spring is known for its unique healing method called 'ganban-yoku' (rock bathing). The highly acidic hot spring itself generates the natural monument 'Hokutoseki'. Designated as a national health resort.

name: だるま温泉湯沢
sales_point: 湯沢ICから約2分という交通の便利な温泉地。市街地にあり、気軽に温泉が楽しめる。湯沢観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A conveniently located hot spring just 2 minutes from Yuzawa IC. Situated in the city center, it offers easy access to enjoy hot springs, making it a great base for Yuzawa sightseeing.

name: 鶴の湯(乳頭温泉郷)
sales_point: 乳頭温泉郷の一角。泉質の異なる4種類の温泉を同時に楽しめる秘湯。白濁した露天風呂が有名。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including a famous milky white mixed-gender outdoor bath and several distinct indoor baths with different water qualities. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, especially the mountain potato hotpot and grilled river fish. Guests mention the traditional, rustic atmosphere and the opportunity to escape daily life.
sales_point_en: Part of the Nyuto Onsen area, this hidden hot spring allows you to enjoy four different types of hot springs with varying mineral compositions. Famous for its milky outdoor baths. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 戸賀温泉
sales_point: 男鹿半島の西部、戸賀湾を望む高台に位置する温泉地。近くに水族館がある。
sales_point_en: Located on a high point overlooking Toga Bay in the western part of the Oga Peninsula. Close to an aquarium.

name: 戸波温泉
sales_point: 渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。小高い丘陵にあり、見晴らしがよい。閑静な環境にあり保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a unique, warm, and "torotoro" (thick and smooth) alkaline spring water, with some highlighting the sulfurous scent from the cold spring water at the washing stations. They also appreciate the welcoming and friendly staff, who greet guests with a warm "welcome home" and engage in pleasant conversations.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area situated along a mountain stream, on a small hill with great views. It offers a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: トロコ(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: アスピーテラインの秋田側入口近くに位置する温泉地。八幡平温泉郷の一角に数えられる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of baths, including mud baths, box steam baths, and a steam sauna, all with excellent water quality. They also highlight the warm ondol rooms and the delicious, thoughtfully prepared meals. Guests mention the friendly staff and the clean, well-maintained facilities.
sales_point_en: Located near the Akita side entrance of the Aspite Line, this hot spring is part of the Hachimantai Onsen area.

name: 十和田大湯温泉
sales_point: 米代川支流の大湯川沿いに位置する温泉地。十和田湖や奥入瀬渓谷探勝の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Oyu River, a tributary of the Yoneshiro River, this hot spring is a great base for exploring Lake Towada and the Oirase Gorge.

name: 泥湯温泉
sales_point: 高松岳の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。、高松川上流沿いにある秘湯。温泉の色が薄墨色していることからこの名がついた。閑静な環境にある。素朴なたたずまいのこの地には、多くの湯治客が訪れる。
sales_point_en: Located on the northeastern foothills of Mount Takamatsu, this hidden hot spring is along the upper reaches of the Takamatsu River. Named for its light ink-colored water, it offers a tranquil environment and attracts many visitors seeking healing.

name: 中里温泉
sales_point: 川口川河畔に位置する温泉地。のどかな田園風景の中にある。大曲、角館、田沢湖観光の足場に便利。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a clean, newly renovated facility with a sauna that offers automatic löyly and two types of cold baths, including a unique deep one. They also highlight the convenient key-locked drawers in the changing rooms and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the Kawaguchi River, surrounded by peaceful rural scenery. Convenient for sightseeing in Omagari, Kakunodate, and Lake Tazawa.

name: 長瀞温泉
sales_point: 米代川と長木川の合流点に位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にある。
sales_point_en: Located at the confluence of the Yoneshiro River and the Nagaki River, this hot spring is set in a quiet mountain environment.

name: 夏瀬温泉
sales_point: 県立「田沢湖抱返り自然公園」内に位置する温泉地。神代ダム湖畔にあり、抱返り渓谷探勝の基地に好適。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious local cuisine, including Akita beef and Hinai chicken, and highlights the private open-air baths and spacious rooms with river views. They also appreciate the attentive staff and the welcoming atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Situated within the Prefectural 'Tazawako Hugging Nature Park', this hot spring is by the lakeside of Kamiyama Dam and serves as a great base for exploring the Hugging Valley.

name: 滑多羅温泉
location: 秋田県 南秋田郡五城目町
sales_point: 国道285号線五城目街道沿いにある温泉地。ツルツルした湯触りから｢鶴の湯｣と呼ばれることもある。
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 285, this hot spring is sometimes referred to as 'Tsuru no Yu' due to its smooth water texture.

name: なるせ温泉
location: 秋田県 雄勝郡東成瀬村
sales_point: 東成瀬村北部、ジュネス栗駒スキー場内のホテルにある温泉。焼石岳登山基地にも便利。スポーツの後で疲れを癒すのに最適。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located within a hotel at the Juness Kurikoma Ski Resort in the northern part of Higashinaruse Village. Convenient for climbing Mount Iwaishi, it is perfect for relaxing after sports.

name: 南郷温泉
sales_point: 南郷岳の北側山麓、横手川の川畔に位置する温泉地。近くに「筏の大杉｣等の見所がある。薬膳料理が名物。アトピーに特効があると言われる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers two types of hot springs, including a sulfur spring and a simple spring, with many highlighting the skin-smoothing effects. They also mention the delicious and plentiful meals, especially the rice, and the reasonable prices for both stays and drinks. Guests appreciate the quiet atmosphere, the attentive staff, and the availability of rock baths.
sales_point_en: Located on the northern foothills of Mount Nango, by the Yokote River. Nearby attractions include the 'Giant Cedar of Iwa'. Known for its medicinal cuisine, it is said to be effective for atopic dermatitis.

name: 仁賀保温泉
sales_point: 日本海沿いに位置する温泉地。風光明媚な環境にあり、特に夕陽は絶景。海の幸が堪能できる。秀峰鳥海山も眺望できる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers clean, modern rooms with private open-air baths, some featuring a sauna and cold plunge pool. They also highlight the delicious rock oysters available as an option and the attentive staff in the dining area.

Other reviews mention the bath temperature can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Sea of Japan, offering scenic views, especially stunning sunsets. Enjoy fresh seafood and views of the majestic Chokai Mountain.

name: 仁別温泉
sales_point: 太平山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。太平山リゾート公園の中にあり、プール、テニスコート、オートキャンプ場、スキーと各種スポーツ施設も充実している。
sales_point_en: Located on the western foothills of Mount Taihei, this hot spring is within the Taihei Mountain Resort Park, which features a pool, tennis courts, auto camping sites, and various sports facilities.

name: 乳頭(乳頭温泉郷)
sales_point: 乳頭山のふもとに位置する温泉地。乳頭温泉郷の入口にあたる。キャンプ場やテニスコート、スキー場が併設された国民休暇村。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including a famous milky white mixed-gender outdoor bath and several distinct indoor baths with different water qualities. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine, especially the mountain potato hotpot and grilled river fish. Guests mention the traditional, rustic atmosphere and the opportunity to escape daily life.
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Mount Nyuto, this hot spring marks the entrance to the Nyuto Onsen area. It features a campground, tennis courts, and a ski resort, and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 能代温泉
sales_point: 米代川の河口近くに位置する海岸沿いの温泉地。海水浴場が近く、日本海への落陽が見事。
sales_point_en: A coastal hot spring area located near the mouth of the Yoneshiro River. Close to a beach, it offers stunning views of the sunset over the Sea of Japan.

name: 日景温泉
sales_point: 大館市の北端、矢立峠の北西に位置する温泉地。秋田杉に囲まれた閑静な環境にある秘湯。湯治専用の風呂もある。硫化水素を含み、白濁した湯が特徴で、アトピーなどの皮膚病に特効があると言われている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent quality sulfur hot springs, with multiple private baths and a variety of unique, milky white waters. Guests also highlight the delicious, carefully prepared meals, which often feature local ingredients and change daily. They also appreciate the attentive staff and the tranquil, traditional atmosphere of the well-maintained building.
sales_point_en: A secluded hot spring area located at the northwest of Yatate Pass, surrounded by Akita cedar. Known for its therapeutic waters, it features a bath specifically for healing purposes, with milky white water rich in hydrogen sulfide, reputed to be effective for skin conditions like atopic dermatitis.

name: 東トロコ(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平温泉郷のひとつ。サンスポーツランドの近くに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、ゲルマニウムを含む泉質が特徴。湯治もできる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent alkaline spring water that leaves skin smooth and warm, and some mention it helps with ailments. Guests also highlight the comfortable, well-maintained rooms and the reasonable prices for a stay. Others appreciate the welcoming, homey atmosphere and the delicious handmade soba noodles.
sales_point_en: One of the hot springs in the Hachimantai Onsen area, located near Sun Sports Land. It offers a tranquil environment and features waters rich in germanium, suitable for healing.

name: 姫神温泉
sales_point: 雄物川西側の丘陵地に位置する温泉地。肌がつるつるになる「美肌の湯」と言われている。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hot spring facility for its variety of baths, including spacious indoor and outdoor options boasting scenic views of Mt. Iwate, as well as its pleasant sauna. They also highlight the delicious food featuring local produce and appreciate the special discounts offered to local residents.

Other reviews mention the layout can be difficult to navigate.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the hills west of the Omorogawa River, known for its 'beauty skin' waters that leave the skin smooth.

name: 蒸の湯(八幡平温泉郷)
sales_point: 八幡平の北西側山麓、標高1100メートルに位置する温泉地。八幡平温泉郷の一角で、野趣豊かな露天風呂がある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a variety of baths, including indoor, open-air, and wild outdoor baths, with rich, mineral-heavy water that leaves them deeply relaxed. They also highlight the delicious, additive-free local cuisine, prepared with care, and the quiet, rustic atmosphere. Visitors appreciate the stunning natural scenery, especially the steaming rocks and surrounding nature.
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 1100 meters on the northwest foothills of Hachimantai, this hot spring area features rustic outdoor baths and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 船沢温泉
sales_point: 能代市街地の南方郊外に位置する温泉地。静かでくつろげる温泉。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southern suburbs of Noshiro City, offering a quiet and relaxing atmosphere.

name: ふるさわ温泉
sales_point: 大館市街地からくるまで10分程のところに位置する温泉地。大館樹海ドームがすぐ近くにある。
review_summary:
People say this Japanese inn offers comfortable rooms and a nostalgic hot spring experience. They also highlight the excellent value, welcoming atmosphere, and attentive service, including the opportunity to interact with the resident Akita dogs.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be old.
sales_point_en: Located about 10 minutes by car from the center of Odate City, this hot spring area is close to the Odate Jukai Dome.

name: 平兵湯温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本庄市
sales_point: 丁岳の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。丁岳への登山、五階の滝周辺の探勝の基地に好適。
review_summary: People say this inn offers delicious, hearty meals, including seasonal tempura and unlimited refills of gas-cooked rice. They also highlight the excellent value, especially for extended stays with discounted rates and meals served in guest rooms. Guests mention the hot spring baths are very warming and effective for aches, and the owners are friendly and attentive.
sales_point_en: Situated on the northern foothills of Ding Mountain, this hot spring area is ideal for climbing Ding Mountain and exploring the surrounding Gokai Falls.

name: 孫六(乳頭温泉郷)
sales_point: 乳頭温泉郷の一角。先達川に面した露天風呂がある。国民保養温泉地に指定され、湯治場の雰囲気が残る。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen ryokan offers a unique blend of traditional charm and modern comfort, with private open-air baths in some rooms and a rare barrel sauna. They also highlight the delicious local cuisine and the attentive, friendly staff who provide excellent service.

Other reviews mention the indoor bath for day visitors can be overpriced.
sales_point_en: Part of the Nyuto Onsen area, it features outdoor baths facing the Sendatsu River. Designated as a national health resort, it retains a healing atmosphere.

name: 松木田温泉
sales_point: 県道30号線に位置する温泉地。ドライブのついでにちょっと温泉気分。宿泊施設完備の温泉保養施設。低料金でサービス。
sales_point_en: Located along Prefectural Road 30, this hot spring area is perfect for a quick soak while driving. It offers accommodation facilities at reasonable prices.

name: 松木台温泉
sales_point: 秋田北ICからすぐの交通の便利な環境。安らぎ、くつろぎ、旬の味覚でもてなしてくれる温泉地。
sales_point_en: Conveniently located near Akita Kita IC, this hot spring area offers relaxation and seasonal delicacies.

name: 水沢温泉郷
sales_point: 田沢湖高原の中腹で、田沢湖を見下ろす高台に位置する温泉地。夏は登山基地として、冬はスキーなどが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Situated on a plateau overlooking Lake Tazawa, this hot spring area serves as a base for mountain climbing in summer and skiing in winter.

name: 三又温泉
sales_point: 奥羽山脈の山懐に位置する温泉地。大自然に囲まれ、岩魚・山菜料理が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the foothills of the Ou Mountains, this hot spring area is surrounded by nature and offers dishes featuring iwana (rock trout) and wild vegetables.

name: 三六温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本荘市
sales_point: ＪＲ薬師堂駅の東方約2キロ、子吉川河畔の田園地帯の中に位置する温泉地。背後は杉木立におおわれた閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: Located about 2 kilometers east of JR Yakushido Station, this hot spring area is set in a tranquil environment surrounded by cedar trees.

name: 森岳温泉
location: 秋田県 山本郡三種町
sales_point: 石倉山の山麓に位置する温泉地。男鹿半島の眺望が良い。日本有数の塩分濃度を誇る泉質が特徴。秋田の奥座敷として賑わっている。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a delicious yakiniku dinner and a relaxing hot spring experience.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be out of service and the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: Situated at the foothills of Ishikurayama, this hot spring area offers great views of the Oga Peninsula and features one of Japan's highest salt concentrations in its waters, making it a popular retreat.

name: 矢立温泉
sales_point: 青森との県境、矢立峠付近に位置する温泉地。山あいにあり、古くは赤湯と呼ばれた。周辺は秋田杉の産地。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a unique, iron-rich red-brown water that warms the body deeply, with both indoor and open-air baths available. Guests also highlight the delicious breakfast, reasonable prices, and the staff's friendly service.

Some reviews mention day-use bathers can reserve bathing spots.
sales_point_en: Located near the border with Aomori, close to Yatate Pass, this hot spring area is nestled in the mountains and was historically known as Akayu. The surrounding area is known for Akita cedar.

name: 山の手温泉
sales_point: 大曲ファミリースキー場に隣接している温泉地。冬はスキー客で賑わう。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers spacious rooms and exceptional French cuisine, with many highlighting the delicious breakfast featuring local ingredients like kiritanpo. They also appreciate the high-quality alkaline hot springs, which leave skin feeling smooth, and the quiet, peaceful atmosphere. Visitors consistently praise the staff for their warm hospitality and attentive service.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to the Omagari Family Ski Resort, this hot spring area is bustling with skiers in winter.

name: 雄和ふるさと温泉
sales_point: 県道9号線沿いに位置する温泉地。泉質に優れ、アトピーなどに効能が高いと言われる。
sales_point_en: Located along Prefectural Road 9, this hot spring area is known for its excellent water quality, reputed to be effective for conditions like atopic dermatitis.

name: 雪沢温泉
sales_point: 象ヶ倉山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。小雪沢の渓谷沿いにあり、自然環境に恵まれている。
sales_point_en: Situated on the northern foothills of Zogakuzan, this hot spring area is along the scenic Yukizawa Valley, surrounded by nature.

name: 湯沢・湯の原温泉
sales_point: 湯沢駅東方1.5キロ、市街地のほぼ中央に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。湯沢スキー場が近い。湯沢・湯の原は泉質が同じで近接している。
sales_point_en: Located about 1.5 kilometers east of Yuzawa Station, this hot spring area is almost in the center of the city, offering a quiet environment ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Close to Yuzawa Ski Resort, Yuzawa and Yunohara share the same water quality and are in close proximity.

name: 湯瀬温泉
sales_point: 米代川の湯瀬渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。美肌効果が高いと伝えられ｢美人の湯｣として親しまれている。十和田湖・八幡平の探勝基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yuse Valley of the Yoshida River, known for its high skin-beautifying effects and beloved as the 'Beauty Hot Spring'. It serves as a great base for exploring Lake Towada and Hachimantai.

name: 湯ノ神温泉
sales_point: 歴史ある秘湯でゆっくりのんびり。静養や湯治に好適。
sales_point_en: A historic hidden hot spring where you can relax and unwind, ideal for recuperation and hot spring therapy.

name: 湯の越の宿温泉
location: 秋田県 南秋田郡五城目町
sales_point: 小倉温泉の北方、約4キロの渓谷沿いの温泉地。県中央部では数少ない硫黄温泉で湯治可。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a rare milky white sulfur spring with a pleasant scent, offering both hot and lukewarm baths, a sauna, and a cold water bath. They also highlight the reasonable 500 yen entrance fee and the free rest area. Others mention the staff are friendly and kind, and the facilities are clean and well-maintained.
sales_point_en: Located about 4 kilometers along a valley north of Ogura Onsen, this hot spring area is one of the few sulfur hot springs in the central part of the prefecture, suitable for hot spring therapy.

name: 湯ノ沢温泉
location: 秋田県 由利本庄市
sales_point: 鳥海山の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。鳥海山登山の基地に好適。冬はスキーが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Situated at the northeastern foot of Mount Chokai, this hot spring area is a great base for climbing the mountain and offers skiing in winter.

name: 湯の沢温泉
location: 秋田県 山本郡藤里町
sales_point: 藤琴川の支流の沢沿いに位置する温泉地。白神山地の登山基地となっており、温泉地の入口には白神山地世界遺産センターがオープンした。紅葉の名所、峨瓏峡、スキー場も近く、通年楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: Located along a tributary of the Fujikoto River, this hot spring area serves as a base for climbing the Shirakami Mountains. The Shirakami-Sanchi World Heritage Center has opened at the entrance of the hot spring area, which is also close to famous autumn foliage spots and ski resorts, making it enjoyable year-round.

name: 湯ノ沢（杣）温泉
sales_point: 森吉山の北側山麓、小又川の渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。渓流釣りやアウトドアスポーツ等、大自然の中で家族連れも楽しめる。秋の紅葉の名所としても知られる。マルメロの産地として有名。
sales_point_en: Located along the stream of the Komata River at the northern foot of Mount Moriyoshi, this hot spring area offers family-friendly outdoor activities like stream fishing. It is also known for its beautiful autumn foliage and is famous for its quince production.

name: 湯ノ台温泉
sales_point: 鳥海山を北に望む田園地帯に位置する温泉地。Ｈ１２年度にリニューアルオープン予定。
review_summary:
Guests mention this mountain resort offers delicious cuisine made with local ingredients and features a clear, smooth hot spring with scenic outdoor baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, the quiet and relaxing atmosphere, and the attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the bath area can be small.
sales_point_en: Situated in a rural area with a view of Mount Chokai to the north, this hot spring area is scheduled to reopen in fiscal year 2012.

name: 湯の平温泉
sales_point: 横手川の支流、沼山川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にある。湯は天気により色が変化すると言われる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a spacious main bath with comfortable, warm, salty water that leaves skin feeling refreshed, along with a sauna and cold plunge pool. They also highlight the affordable entry fees, friendly staff, and the convenience of early morning hours.

Other reviews mention there can be a lack of outdoor bath.
sales_point_en: Located along the Numayama River, a tributary of the Yokote River, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain environment. The water is said to change color depending on the weather.

name: ユ－スランド（水沢温泉郷）
sales_point: 水沢温泉郷のひとつに数えられる温泉地。観音像では高さ日本一の金色大観音があり、スノーワールドタザワというスキー場に隣接している。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is one of the Mizusawa Onsen District. It features the tallest golden Kannon statue in Japan and is adjacent to the Snow World Tazawa ski resort.

name: 横手温泉
sales_point: 横手市街地の北東部、明永沼の東方に位置する温泉地。美肌効果が高いと言われている。遙かに鳥海山を眺め眺望も良い。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features excellent hot springs with a unique, smooth water quality, along with spacious indoor and outdoor baths, saunas, and cold plunges. Guests also highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, convenient station-front location, and reasonable prices.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be occupied by regulars.
sales_point_en: Located in the northeastern part of Yokote City, east of Meiyo Pond, this hot spring area is said to have high skin-beautifying effects and offers a great view of Mount Chokai.

name: 横手駅前温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ横手駅前に新しくできた温泉地。ビジネスに、観光に便利。湯量も豊富。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features excellent hot springs with a unique, smooth water quality, along with spacious indoor and outdoor baths, saunas, and cold plunges. Guests also highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, convenient station-front location, and reasonable prices.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be occupied by regulars.
sales_point_en: A newly established hot spring area right in front of JR Yokote Station, convenient for both business and tourism, with abundant hot spring water.

name: 六郷温泉あったか山温泉
location: 秋田県 仙北郡美郷町
sales_point: 六郷ダムの下流、湯田沢川沿いに位置する温泉地。優れた泉質で名前の通りあたたかい温泉がが人気。別荘気分が味わえる保養施設もある。
sales_point_en: Located downstream of the Rokugou Dam along the Yudazawa River, this hot spring area is popular for its excellent water quality and warm hot springs, with facilities that allow you to enjoy a villa-like atmosphere.

name: 相乗温泉
sales_point: 平川の支流の相乗川に臨む山間にある。遊びの要素が盛りだくさんの温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers two types of hot springs, including a spacious outdoor bath with forest views and a unique "red water" bath. They also highlight the affordable 350 yen day-use fee and the availability of free dryers.

Other reviews mention the washing areas can be monopolized by some guests.
sales_point_en: Nestled in the mountains overlooking the Aizawa River, this hot spring area is filled with fun activities.

name: 青荷（黒石温泉郷）
sales_point: 黒石温泉郷の一角。青荷川の渓流沿いにある一軒宿の温泉地。露天風呂や川沿いの風呂があり、ランプの宿として知られている。
review_summary: People say this inn offers a unique digital detox experience with no electricity or cell service, providing a tranquil escape. They also highlight the delicious, rustic local cuisine and the relaxing hot springs, with four different baths to enjoy. Guests mention the staff are attentive and helpful, contributing to a pleasant stay.
sales_point_en: Part of the Kuroishi Onsen District, this hot spring area features a single inn along the Aoni River, known for its outdoor baths and riverside baths, and is recognized as a lantern inn.

name: 浅虫温泉
sales_point: 青森湾を臨む国道4号線沿いの温泉地。昔、温度の高い湯で麻を蒸していたことからアサムシと呼ばれるようになったと伝えられる。
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 4, this hot spring area overlooks Aomori Bay. It is said to have been named Asamushi because it was once used to steam hemp with its hot water.

name: 鯵ヶ沢温泉
location: 青森県 西津軽郡鯵ヶ沢町
sales_point: 鰺ヶ沢の駅前に位置する温泉地。アクセスが便利で眼下に日本海を望みながらゆっくりとくつろげる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen hotel offers an all-inclusive plan with a wide variety of drinks and snacks, and delicious meals featuring local seafood and traditional dishes. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, and the hot, salty onsen water that leaves skin feeling smooth.

Some reviews mention the large public bath can have floating debris.
sales_point_en: Located in front of Ajigasawa Station, this hot spring area is conveniently accessible and allows you to relax while enjoying views of the Japan Sea.

name: 暗門温泉
location: 青森県 中津軽郡西目屋村
sales_point: 白神山地を西に望む山あいの温泉地。露天風呂があり、心身共にリラックスできる。
sales_point_en: A mountain hot spring area with a view of the Shirakami Mountains to the west, featuring outdoor baths that allow for complete relaxation of both body and mind.

name: 碇ケ関温泉
sales_point: 矢立峠の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。鎌倉時代に津軽第4代藩主の開湯と伝えられ、歴史が永い。周辺はリンゴの名産地。
sales_point_en: Located at the northern foot of the Yatate Pass, this hot spring area is said to have been established by the 4th lord of Tsugaru during the Kamakura period, boasting a long history. The surrounding area is known for its apple production.

name: 石岡温泉
location: 青森県 五所川原市
sales_point: 近くに少年自然の家やスキー場があり、子供から家族連れまで楽しめる温泉地。打たせ湯も好評。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including open-air, high-temperature, and mist saunas with salt. They also highlight the affordable entry fees and the attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the towels can have water stains.
sales_point_en: Close to a nature house for children and a ski resort, this hot spring area is enjoyable for families and children, with popular waterfall baths.

name: 石川温泉
sales_point: 大鰐弘前ICに隣接した場所にある温泉地。大鰐温泉スキー場まで車で約15分と好立地。
sales_point_en: Located adjacent to the Owani Hirosaki IC, this hot spring area is conveniently situated about a 15-minute drive from the Owani Onsen Ski Resort.

name: 石神温泉
sales_point: 津軽海峡を望む海岸の近くに位置する温泉地。田園の中の一軒宿で心安まる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features very hot, salty water, with a slightly cloudy appearance, and a sauna with a comfortable water temperature. Guests also highlight the kind and friendly staff, and the reasonable bathing fee.

Other reviews mention the baths can be overly hot.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the coast with a view of the Tsugaru Strait. A tranquil inn in the countryside.

name: 板留（黒石温泉郷）
sales_point: 黒石温泉郷の一角。落合温泉の対岸に位置する温泉地。湯治客が多く素朴で静養に好適。近くの中野紅葉山は紅葉の名所。
review_summary: Guests mention this traditional ryokan offers delicious meals made from fresh, local produce, and features a large, luxurious onsen with mineral-rich water. They also highlight the comfortable rooms and the warm, welcoming hospitality from the staff.
sales_point_en: Part of the Kuroishi Onsen district, located across from Ochiai Onsen. Popular among hot spring visitors, it is simple and suitable for relaxation. Nearby Nakano Momijiyama is famous for its autumn leaves.

name: 稲垣温泉
sales_point: 津軽半島南西部に位置する温泉地。津軽富士と呼ばれる岩木山の雄大な眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southwestern part of the Tsugaru Peninsula, offering magnificent views of Mount Iwaki, known as Tsugaru Fuji.

name: 岩崎温泉
location: 青森県 西津軽郡深浦町
sales_point: 世界自然遺産白神山地の麓、主峰白神岳の登山口近くに位置する温泉地。白神岳登山の基地に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring inn features a unique open-air bath right by the sea, offering stunning views of the Japan Sea and beautiful sunsets. They also highlight the rich, iron-rich, brownish-red spring water, which is known for its warming properties. Guests mention the delicious buffet meals, especially the fresh seafood like tuna and sashimi, and the attentive staff.
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of the World Heritage Site Shirakami-Sanchi, near the trailhead of Mount Shirakami. Ideal as a base for climbing.

name: 浦船温泉
sales_point: 国道101号線の近くに位置する温泉地。五所川原、弘前観光の拠点に好適。旅の疲れを癒すのに良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near National Route 101, making it a great base for sightseeing in Goshogawara and Hirosaki. Perfect for relieving travel fatigue.

name: 狼ノ長根温泉
location: 青森県 五所川原市
sales_point: 狼ノ長根公園に位置する温泉地。五所川原の夜景を見下ろすことができる。露天風呂も完備されている。
sales_point_en: Located in Okami no Nagane Park, this hot spring area offers a view of the night scenery of Goshogawara. It also features outdoor baths.

name: 奥入瀬温泉
sales_point: 十和田市南部、奥入瀬川河畔の田園に囲まれた閑静な地にあり、湯治場に好適。
review_summary: People say this resort offers spacious, clean rooms with stunning views of the surrounding nature and features a beautiful outdoor onsen with river views. They also highlight the delicious buffet, which includes a wide variety of apple-themed dishes and local specialties like scallop ramen and apple pie. Guests mention the friendly and attentive staff, as well as convenient free shuttle services to local attractions and train stations.
sales_point_en: Situated in a quiet area surrounded by countryside along the Oirase River in the southern part of Towada City, ideal for hot spring therapy.

name: おいらせ渓流（十和田湖温泉郷）
sales_point: 奥入瀬渓流の入口に位置する温泉地。十和田湖まで車で約20分と言う好立地。十和田湖観光の拠点に好適。湯は猿倉温泉からの引湯。
review_summary: Visitors say this natural destination features stunning, clear streams, numerous dynamic waterfalls, and lush forests with diverse plant life, offering beautiful scenery in every season. They also highlight the well-maintained walking paths, making it easy to explore and enjoy the refreshing atmosphere. Guests mention that early mornings or weekdays are ideal for a more peaceful experience, and shuttle buses are convenient for longer routes.
sales_point_en: Located at the entrance of the Oirase Stream, this hot spring area is conveniently about 20 minutes by car from Lake Towada. A great base for sightseeing at Lake Towada, with water sourced from Sarukura Onsen.

name: 大間温泉
location: 青森県 下北郡大間町
sales_point: 本州最北端の地、大間崎の南方に位置する温泉地。山あいに位置し、閑静な環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this accommodation offers delicious Omagyu beef and Oma tuna dishes, with the tuna course being highly recommended. They also highlight the spacious and clean hot spring baths, which are perfect for relaxing after sightseeing.

Other reviews mention the pricing can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located south of Oma Cape, the northernmost point of Honshu. Nestled in the mountains, it offers a quiet environment.

name: 大湯温泉
sales_point: 青森市街地にあるレジャーランド。大湯公園がある。
sales_point_en: A leisure land located in the city center of Aomori, featuring Ooyu Park.

name: 大鰐温泉
location: 青森県 南津軽郡大鰐町
sales_point: 弘前市郊外、平川沿いに位置する温泉地。湯治場としての歴史が古い。温泉熱を利用して作られる豆モヤシや味噌が名物。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Hirakawa River on the outskirts of Hirosaki City, with a long history as a hot spring resort. Famous for bean sprouts and miso made using hot spring heat.

name: 小沢龍神温泉
sales_point: 由緒ある寺、久渡寺の近くに位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the historic Kudo-ji Temple, in a quiet mountain environment.

name: 恐山温泉
sales_point: 日本三大霊場のひとつ、恐山の宇曽利山湖北岸の菩提寺内に位置する温泉地。昔から湯治場として好評。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers a genuine sulfur spring experience with milky white, strongly acidic water that leaves skin smooth. They also highlight that the hot spring is free to use after paying the entrance fee to the temple grounds. Others also say the hot spring provides a unique and memorable experience in a sacred setting.
sales_point_en: Located within the Bodai-ji Temple on the northern shore of Lake Usoriyama at Osorezan, one of Japan's three major sacred sites. Well-known as a hot spring resort since ancient times.

name: 落合（黒石温泉郷）
sales_point: 「黒石の奥座敷」と言われ、黒石温泉郷で旅館の数が最も多い温泉地。浅瀬石川沿いの閑静な環境にある。津軽こけし館が近くにある。
sales_point_en: Known as the 'back room of Kuroishi', this hot spring area has the most ryokans in the Kuroishi Onsen district. Situated in a quiet environment along the Asaseishi River, with the Tsugaru Kokeshi Museum nearby.

name: 折戸温泉
location: 青森県 北津軽郡中泊町
sales_point: 日本海を一望できる海辺に位置する温泉地。国道339号線の竜泊ラインからの海岸美は絶景。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the sea, offering a panoramic view of the Japan Sea. The coastal beauty from the Ryuhaku Line along National Route 339 is breathtaking.

name: 鶴寿温泉
location: 青森県 北津軽郡鶴田町
sales_point: 田園の中に位置する閑静な温泉地。鶴田町は「国際交流の里」として毎年中学生が姉妹都市から訪れる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with an alkaline hot spring that leaves skin smooth, a spacious sauna, and a reasonably priced ganbanyoku.

Other reviews mention the electric bath can be unavailable and the facility can be dated.
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area located in the countryside. Tsuruta Town is known as 'the village of international exchange', where middle school students visit from sister cities every year.

name: 掛落林温泉
location: 青森県 北津軽郡板柳町
sales_point: 板柳町の西部、国道339号線沿いに位置する温泉地。のどかなリンゴ園に囲まれている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 339 in the western part of Itayanagi Town, surrounded by peaceful apple orchards.

name: 柏木町温泉
sales_point: 平賀町の市街地に位置する温泉地。日帰り入浴も好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Hiraga Town, popular for day-use bathing.

name: 嘉瀬温泉
location: 青森県 五所川原市
sales_point: 国道339号線沿いに位置する温泉地。津軽の大自然の中で心と体をリラックスできる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 339, allowing you to relax your mind and body amidst the great nature of Tsugaru.

name: 上川原温泉
location: 青森県 上北郡六戸町
sales_point: 奥入瀬川沿いに位置する温泉地。八戸でとれた魚介類を楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Oirase River, where you can enjoy seafood caught in Hachinohe.

name: 唐竹温泉
sales_point: 県道28号線沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。リウマチ、神経痛、皮フ病などによく効く。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along Prefectural Road 28, known for its effectiveness against rheumatism, neuralgia, and skin diseases.

name: 河原木八太郎山温泉
sales_point: フェリー埠頭から車で約5分の所に位置する温泉地。北海道への足場として好適。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a variety of baths, including alkaline and carbonated options, along with a spacious sauna and outdoor bathing area with chairs. Guests also highlight the affordable entry fee and the presence of friendly goats that can be fed.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 5 minutes by car from the ferry terminal, ideal as a base for trips to Hokkaido.

name: 寒水沢温泉
sales_point: 八甲田ロープウェイの山麓駅の近くに位置する温泉地。切り傷、火傷、美肌作用などに効果があると言われている。
review_summary: People say this traditional Japanese inn offers an amazing hot spring experience with its massive Hiba-wood "Sennin-buro" bath, featuring both warm and slightly hotter sections. They also highlight the delicious and carefully prepared meals, which often include local ingredients. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, the clean and well-maintained facilities, and the convenient free shuttle bus service from Shin-Aomori Station.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area near the base station of the Hakkoda Ropeway, said to be effective for cuts, burns, and skin beautification.

name: 切明温泉
sales_point: 自然たっぷりの山の中に位置する温泉地。ゆっくりと静養するのに好適。心のこもった料理と効能の高い湯が、訪れる人々を癒してくれる。
sales_point_en: Nestled in a nature-rich mountain area, this hot spring is perfect for relaxation. Heartfelt cuisine and highly effective waters provide healing for visitors.

name: 九十九森温泉
location: 青森県 南津軽郡大鰐町
sales_point: 右手にスキー場を望む山あいの静かな温泉地。ライダーの利用が多い。
sales_point_en: A quiet hot spring area in the mountains with a ski resort visible to the right, popular among riders.

name: 国吉温泉
sales_point: 岩木川の支流、大秋川沿いに位置する温泉地。世界遺産「白神山地」の入口に立地している。周りにはりんご畑が広がる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers large indoor and outdoor baths, a variety of temperatures, and amenities like saunas and jet baths. They also highlight the convenient cashless payment options and the availability of overnight parking services.

Other reviews mention the access road can be narrow.
sales_point_en: Located along the tributary of the Iwaki River, this hot spring is at the entrance to the World Heritage site 'Shirakami-Sanchi,' surrounded by apple orchards.

name: 熊ノ湯温泉
location: 青森県 西津軽郡鯵ヶ沢町
sales_point: 赤石川渓流沿いに位置する温泉地。上流にあるくろくまの滝は日本の滝百選にも選ばれた絶景。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area along the Akakawa River, with the nearby Kurokuma Falls selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls.

name: 剣吉温泉
location: 青森県 三戸郡南部町
sales_point: 岩手県境の名川町の北部、山あいに位置する温泉地。脳卒中や呼吸器病等に効果があると言われる。
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains north of Nagawa Town on the Iwate Prefecture border, said to be effective for strokes and respiratory diseases.

name: 黄金崎不老不死温泉
location: 青森県 西津軽郡深浦町
sales_point: 深浦町の最西端の黄金崎に位置する温泉地。眼前には日本海が広がり、白神山地も遠望できる。自然環境に恵まれた環境にある。露天風呂からの夕陽は絶景。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a unique and breathtaking open-air bath experience right on the Sea of Japan, with many highlighting the stunning sunset views. They also appreciate the high-quality, iron-rich, reddish-brown hot spring water and the delicious buffet-style meals featuring fresh seafood. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and the rooms are clean, spacious, and offer ocean views.
sales_point_en: Situated at the westernmost point of Fukaura Town, with the Sea of Japan in front and views of the Shirakami Mountains. The sunset from the outdoor bath is breathtaking.

name: 小曲温泉
location: 青森県 五所川原市
sales_point: 五所川原の市街地から程近い場所に位置する温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located close to the city center of Goshogawara.

name: 古牧温泉
sales_point: 東北本線三沢駅前の渋沢公園内に位置する温泉地。三沢市と六戸町にまたがる22万坪のレジャーランドとなっている。
review_summary: People say this resort offers a wide variety of delicious local cuisine, including fresh seafood and apple-based dishes, available at the buffet. They also highlight the lively atmosphere with Nebuta festival decorations and engaging shows. Guests mention the excellent hot springs, especially the "floating bath" and the "Motoyu" with its unique, skin-softening water.
sales_point_en: Located in Shibusawa Park in front of Misawa Station on the Tohoku Main Line, this hot spring is part of a 220,000 tsubo leisure land spanning Misawa City and Rokunohe Town.

name: 御所温泉
sales_point: 弘前市の西隣、相馬村に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Soma Village, adjacent to Hirosaki City, in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 五戸まきば温泉
location: 青森県 三戸郡五戸町
sales_point: 昔、牧場だったことから「まきば温泉」の由来となる。訪れたら是非、名物の馬肉鍋や地酒を味わってみたい。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including hot and lukewarm indoor options, a sauna, and a cold plunge pool. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, the relaxing atmosphere, and the friendly cats that visit the outdoor bath.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be cold.
sales_point_en: Named after its history as a former ranch, visitors should definitely try the local specialty horse meat hot pot and sake.

name: 権現沢温泉
location: 青森県 上北郡六戸町
sales_point: 七百駅前に位置していることから「七百温泉」とも呼ばれる。湯はぬるく、ゆったりとくつろげる。家族風呂も完備。
sales_point_en: Also known as 'Nanahaku Onsen' due to its location near Nanahaku Station. The water is lukewarm, allowing for a relaxing soak. Family baths are also available.

name: 桜温泉
sales_point: 岩木町の中心部に位置し、弘前観光や岩木山へも便利な温泉地。閑静な中で心休まる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water, including a variety of indoor baths with different temperatures, a cold bath, and an outdoor barrel bath. Guests also highlight the reasonable 450 yen entry fee and the friendly, helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the showers can be broken.
sales_point_en: Located in the center of Iwaki Town, this hot spring is convenient for sightseeing in Hirosaki and Mount Iwaki, providing a peaceful atmosphere.

name: 猿賀温泉
sales_point: 猿賀神社の鏡ヶ池畔に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。入浴すると肌がスベスベし、美肌効果が高いと言われている。
sales_point_en: A single inn hot spring located by the Kagaru Pond of Saruka Shrine, known for its skin-smoothing effects and high beautifying properties.

name: 猿倉温泉
sales_point: 八甲田山中に位置する一軒宿の温泉地。湯量豊富で十和田湖温泉郷の湯元となっている。紅葉の美しさでも有名。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers high-quality sulfur spring water with abundant "yu no hana" (mineral deposits), and features both hot and warm indoor baths, as well as scenic outdoor rotenburo. Visitors also highlight the reasonable 700 yen day-trip fee and the welcoming, English-speaking staff. They also appreciate the well-maintained facilities and the option to relax in the open-air baths while enjoying the surrounding nature.
sales_point_en: A single inn hot spring located in the Hakkoda Mountains, abundant in hot water and the source of the Towada Lake hot spring area, famous for its beautiful autumn leaves.

name: 沢里温泉
sales_point: 住宅街の中にありながらゴルフやテニスなど、スポーツを楽しむことができる。露天風呂も完備。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor baths, jacuzzis, jet baths, and open-air rotenburo, as well as a hot sauna and cold plunge pool. Guests also appreciate the comfortable relaxation spaces and the staff's diligent efforts in the dining area.

Other reviews mention the price can be high.
sales_point_en: Located in a residential area, this hot spring offers sports activities like golf and tennis, along with outdoor baths.

name: 沢田温泉
sales_point: 十和田湖町の最東部の田園の中に位置する温泉地。地元の人々の利用も多く、素朴な雰囲気がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the eastern part of Towada Lake Town, frequented by locals, offering a rustic atmosphere.

name: 三内温泉
sales_point: 青森市郊外に位置する温泉地。日帰り入浴も好評。車の便が良い。湯治の利用も可能。
sales_point_en: Located on the outskirts of Aomori City, this hot spring is popular for day-use bathing, easily accessible by car, and suitable for therapeutic use.

name: 下久保温泉
location: 青森県 上北郡六戸町
sales_point: ゴルフ場内に位置しており、プレーの後にゆっくりとくつろげる温泉。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers two types of baths, including a hot option, and features a floor that is warmed by the spring water. Guests also highlight the reasonable price and the fact that it's not crowded.

Other reviews mention the water temperature can be overly hot.
sales_point_en: Located within a golf course, this onsen offers a relaxing experience after a round of golf.

name: 下風呂温泉
location: 青森県 下北郡風間浦村
sales_point: 津軽海峡に面した海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。井上靖の小説「海峡」の舞台になった。風光明媚な地で、イカ釣りの漁り火が眺望できる。
sales_point_en: This onsen is situated along the coast facing the Tsugaru Strait, known as the setting for Inoue Yasushi's novel 'Kaikyo'. It offers scenic views, including the fishing lights from squid fishing.

name: 白萩平温泉
location: 青森県 三戸郡田子町
sales_point: 国道104号線沿いの山間部に位置する温泉地。鉄分・カルシウムの入った赤い湯で神経痛・リウマチ等に効くと評判。
sales_point_en: Located in the mountainous area along National Route 104, this onsen is famous for its red water rich in iron and calcium, reputed to be effective for neuralgia and rheumatism.

name: 尻内（八戸）温泉
sales_point: 八戸駅前に位置する温泉地。ビジネスにも便利。八戸沖でとれた海の幸を堪能できる。風呂も多種完備。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers a variety of baths, including alkaline and carbonated options, along with a spacious sauna and outdoor bathing area with chairs. Guests also highlight the affordable entry fee and the presence of friendly goats that can be fed.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Conveniently located in front of Hachinohe Station, this onsen is ideal for business travelers and offers a variety of baths, along with fresh seafood from Hachinohe.

name: 新八（八戸）温泉
sales_point: 八戸市街地に位置する温泉地。24時間いつでも入れる風呂が好評。ゆったりとくつろげる。
sales_point_en: Situated in the city center of Hachinohe, this onsen is popular for its 24-hour access to baths, providing a relaxing atmosphere.

name: 城ケ倉温泉
sales_point: 八甲田の主峰大岳の西側に位置する温泉地。八甲田ロープウェイ駅の近くなので、登山やスキーの拠点として好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious kaiseki dinners and breakfast buffets featuring local ingredients, with some changes to the buffet spread daily. They also highlight the wonderful and healing indoor and outdoor onsen, which are clean and rarely crowded.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dim.
sales_point_en: Located on the west side of Mount Hakkoda's main peak, this onsen is close to the Hakkoda Ropeway station, making it a great base for hiking and skiing.

name: 城ケ沢温泉
sales_point: 陸奥湾沿いに位置する温泉地。すぐ近くに海水浴場があり、風光明媚な環境。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring offers a free, open-air bathing experience with clear, odorless water and scenic views of the surrounding nature. They also highlight the well-maintained facilities and the option for longer soaks due to the slightly cooler water temperature. Guests mention the importance of checking the designated bathing times, as they are separated by gender.
sales_point_en: This onsen is located along Mutsu Bay, with a nearby beach, offering a picturesque environment.

name: 城東温泉
sales_point: 弘前駅の北東、約1キロの市街地に位置する温泉地。ショッピングセンターの中にあり、プールなども併設。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers clean and well-maintained baths, including a spacious sauna and comfortable open-air baths with varying temperatures. Guests also highlight the relaxing atmosphere, affordable pricing, and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the amenities can be lacking.
sales_point_en: Located about 1 kilometer northeast of Hirosaki Station, this onsen is situated within a shopping center and features a pool.

name: 水明（上北町温泉郷）
location: 青森県 上北郡東北町
sales_point: 小川原湖から車で5～10分の場所に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、ゆっくりと過ごすことが出来る。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring inn offers excellent alkaline hot springs with a pleasant, slippery texture, and many rooms include private baths. They also highlight the reasonable prices, helpful amenities like in-room microwaves and water servers, and the delicious, freshly cooked rice for breakfast.

Some reviews mention the family baths can lack basic amenities.
sales_point_en: This onsen is located 5 to 10 minutes by car from Lake Ogawara, in a quiet mountain setting, perfect for a leisurely stay.

name: 酸ヶ湯温泉
sales_point: 八甲田の主峰大岳の西側中腹、標高約900メートルに位置する温泉地。300年程前に鹿が傷を癒しているのを発見されて以来湯治に利用され、酸度の強い泉質が特徴。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this traditional Japanese inn offers an amazing hot spring experience with its massive Hiba-wood "Sennin-buro" bath, featuring both warm and slightly hotter sections. They also highlight the delicious and carefully prepared meals, which often include local ingredients. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, the clean and well-maintained facilities, and the convenient free shuttle bus service from Shin-Aomori Station.
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of about 900 meters on the western slope of Mount Hakkoda, this onsen has been used for healing since deer were discovered bathing here 300 years ago. It is known for its highly acidic waters and is a national health resort.

name: 園沢温泉
sales_point: 三沢市中心部から東へ1キロ程行った所に位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen has incredibly soft, high-quality water that leaves skin smooth and warm, and appreciate the spacious indoor bath. They also highlight the charming, quiet, and retro atmosphere, as well as the reasonable price for a day visit.

Some reviews mention there can be no outdoor bath.
sales_point_en: Located about 1 kilometer east of Misawa City center, this onsen is easily accessible.

name: 高増温泉
location: 青森県 北津軽郡板柳町
sales_point: りんご畑が広がる津軽平野の中央部に位置する温泉地。のどかな風景を見渡しながらの入浴は、心安まる。
review_summary: People say this public bath offers a unique, slightly brownish, and slippery hot spring water that leaves fine bubbles on the skin. They also highlight the clean and well-maintained changing rooms and bathing areas, despite the building's age. Visitors appreciate the relaxing, retro atmosphere and the reasonable entry fee.
sales_point_en: This onsen is located in the central part of the Tsugaru Plain, surrounded by apple orchards, providing a tranquil bathing experience with scenic views.

name: 宝温泉
sales_point: 黒石IC近くに位置する温泉地。黒石市街地からも近く観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen features excellent quality alkaline hot springs with a smooth, "silky" feel, and some rooms include private baths. They also highlight the exceptional value, clean facilities, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the mist sauna can be overly hot.
sales_point_en: Close to Kuroishi IC, this onsen is conveniently located near the city center, making it a great base for sightseeing.

name: 田代温泉
location: 青森県 中津軽郡西目屋村
sales_point: 西目屋村の北東部に位置する温泉地。ジャグジーやサウナなど7種類の風呂が楽しめ、日帰り入浴もできる。
sales_point_en: Located in the northeastern part of Nakasatsunai Village, this onsen offers seven types of baths, including a jacuzzi and sauna, and is available for day-use.

name: 龍飛崎温泉
location: 青森県 東津軽郡三厩村
sales_point: 津軽半島の最北端に位置する温泉地。灯台付近からは津軽海峡を隔てて北海道を遠くに望むことができる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious meals, especially fresh sashimi and seafood bowls, and features spacious rooms with stunning views of the Tsugaru Strait. Guests also highlight the relaxing hot spring baths and the convenient on-site parking.

Other reviews mention the breakfast options can be limited.
sales_point_en: Situated at the northernmost tip of the Tsugaru Peninsula, this onsen offers views of Hokkaido across the Tsugaru Strait from near the lighthouse.

name: 田子温泉
location: 青森県 三戸郡田子町
sales_point: 町の名産品、こんにゃくや山菜を使った料理が楽しめる。渓流釣りや登山の愛好者に好評。
sales_point_en: Enjoy local specialties such as konnyaku and mountain vegetables. Popular among enthusiasts of stream fishing and hiking.

name: 大坊温泉
sales_point: 津軽の田園地の中に位置する温泉地。高速道路からのアクセスが良く、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located in the rural area of Tsugaru, this onsen has good access from the highway, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 嶽温泉
sales_point: 岩木山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。徳川時代から湯治場として栄えてきた。湯量豊富でリウマチ、皮フ病などに効果がある。
sales_point_en: Located on the southern foothills of Mount Iwaki, this onsen has been a popular healing spot since the Tokugawa era, known for its abundant hot water effective for rheumatism and skin diseases.

name: 中央町温泉
sales_point: 三沢市市街の中心部、市役所のすぐ側に位置する温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this day use onsen offers hot and cold baths, a sauna, and a variety of tubs with different water temperatures and jets. They also highlight the affordable price, the clean and spacious facilities, and the relaxing, retro atmosphere.

Other reviews mention the water temperature can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Located in the city center of Misawa, right next to the city hall.

name: 長寿温泉
sales_point: 国道102号線沿いに位置する温泉地。車の便が良く、十和田湖観光の帰りなどに立ち寄れる。
sales_point_en: Located along National Route 102, this onsen is easily accessible by car, making it a convenient stop after visiting Lake Towada.

name: 蔦温泉
sales_point: ブナの原生林に囲まれた閑静な環境の温泉地。一周1時間ほどの散策路があり、野鳥の自然観察もできる。ハチミツが名産品。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring inn features rare "foot-source" hot springs where water bubbles up directly from the tub's bottom, and they highlight the high ceilings and fragrant cypress wood in the bathing areas. They also mention the delicious meals, which use local ingredients, and the attentive staff.
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area surrounded by a beech primeval forest. There is a walking trail that takes about an hour, perfect for observing wild birds. Honey is a local specialty.

name: 椿山温泉
location: 青森県 西津軽郡深浦町
sales_point: 日本海沿いに位置する温泉地。自炊施設もあり保養・療養に好適。長期滞在可能。浴場の窓から漁り火が見える。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Sea of Japan. It has self-catering facilities, making it suitable for recuperation and therapy. Long-term stays are possible, and fishing fires can be seen from the bathhouse windows.

name: 鶴田温泉
location: 青森県 北津軽郡鶴田町
sales_point: 鶴田町で一番古い温泉地。名産のぶどう「スチューベン」を使ったワイン、ジュースや純米酒「鶴の恩返し」「花ふぶき」が味わえる。
sales_point_en: The oldest hot spring area in Tsuruta Town. You can enjoy wine, juice, and pure rice sake made from the local grape variety 'Steuben'.

name: 東北温泉
location: 青森県 上北郡東北町
sales_point: 国道394･県道8号線沿いに位置する温泉地。地元の人の利用が多い。
review_summary:
Reviewers praise this onsen for its unique dark brown "moor" spring with a smooth texture, alongside hot, electric, and cold spring water baths, and a spacious sauna. Guests also highlight the reasonable 380-yen admission fee and the accommodating staff.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be unavailable.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 394 and Prefectural Route 8. It is frequently used by locals.

name: 斗南温泉
sales_point: むつ市街地に位置する温泉地。効能の高い湯は主にリウマチ、神経痛、胃腸病に効くとされている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide and hot sauna, a cold water bath, and spacious indoor and outdoor baths with comfortable temperatures. They also highlight the reasonable prices, ample parking, and the smooth, skin-softening quality of the spring water.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Mutsu. The highly effective waters are said to be beneficial for rheumatism, neuralgia, and gastrointestinal diseases.

name: 戸山温泉
sales_point: 青森駅から東南方向へ約8キロの閑静な地に位置する温泉地。主に地元の人々に利用されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious baths with hot water, a wide and cold *mizuburo*, and a large sauna. They also highlight the friendly staff, convenient early morning to late night hours, and affordable prices.

Other reviews mention guests can be inconsiderate.
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area located about 8 kilometers southeast of Aomori Station, mainly used by local residents.

name: 十和田温泉
sales_point: 官庁街のすぐ近くにあり、ビジネスに便利。24時間入れるお風呂で心身共にくつろげる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including open-air, electric, and source-fed options, with a clean and well-maintained facility. They also highlight the reasonable price and the enjoyable sauna with auto-löyly.

Other reviews mention the other bathers can be inconsiderate.
sales_point_en: Conveniently located near the government district, making it ideal for business. The bath is open 24 hours, allowing for relaxation of both body and mind.

name: 十和田湖（十和田湖温泉郷）
sales_point: 奥入瀬渓流の入口に位置する温泉地。十和田湖まで車で約20分と言う好立地。十和田湖観光の拠点に好適。湯は猿倉温泉からの引湯。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the entrance of the Oirase Stream. It is conveniently located about 20 minutes by car from Towada Lake, making it a great base for sightseeing. The water is sourced from Sarukura Onsen.

name: 十和田ポニー温泉
sales_point: 十和田湖町の手前の山あい、国道102号線沿いに位置する温泉地。リウマチ・神経痛・によく効く。
review_summary:
People say this hotel's hot springs have an excellent, smooth, and moisturizing water quality, with both large public baths and private open-air options. Guests also highlight the delicious and generous portions of local cuisine, including horse meat dishes, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the outdoor baths can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 102 in the mountains before Towada Lake Town. It is effective for rheumatism and neuralgia.

name: 中柏木温泉
location: 青森県 五所川原市
sales_point: 広々とした津軽平野を見渡すことができる温泉地。眺望の良い大浴場が好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a spacious view of the Tsugaru Plain. The large public bath with a good view is popular.

name: 中小泊山温泉
location: 青森県 北津軽郡中泊町
sales_point: 日本の二大名岬と言われる権現崎の近くに位置する温泉地。6月～10月末までイカ釣りを体験できる。
